Road Rash, the franchise which defined the combat racing genre during the 1990s, returns in the first ever digital release of the 1996 PC version.

Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored to deliver a must-see experience.

 30th Anniversary Edition key improvements: 

 Relicensed Soundtrack - A fully relicensed soundtrack featuring Soundgarden, Paw, Hammerbox, Monster Magnet, Swervedriver, and Therapy?, with the ability to now play their songs during the racing gameplay.

 Source Master FMVs - In 2022, the Source Master tapes were discovered in the EA physical media vault. These tapes have been digitized and meticulously re-edited frame-by-frame to restore the dozens of FMV scenes, and integrate them back into the game.

 Upscaled FMVs - As an optional enhancement, the FMVs have been further elevated to sharper quality using the latest in video upscaling technology for the best Road Rash cinematics ever seen.

 Gameplay Optimizations - Enhanced for modern systems, enjoy improved framerates up to 60 FPS, native controller support, windowed mode, cloud saves, and more

This 30th Anniversary Edition is the ultimate way to enjoy one of the most important franchises in gaming history.

 CONTROL VS CHAOS

 UNDER THE SYSTEM

Weapons & power-ups spawn on the map and then you lose them on death.
5 arenas to start: Volcano Crater, SOS Factory, Flight 747, Pyramid, Tower

 You’re a team of emergency responders.
 In practice, that means you’re at least trying to be one.
 Someone’s putting out a fire, someone’s carrying a cat, someone accidentally drops a teammate off a roof, and someone else has no idea what the objective is — but they’re doing their best. 
 Physics is the thing you’ll either love us for or absolutely hate us for.
 It breaks plans, creates ridiculous situations, and turns even the simplest actions into a chain of failures, shouting (and sometimes… victories). 
 No boring tutorials. No tedious tasks.
 This game was made by ADHD people, for ADHD people. Just fast-paced missions, constant movement, and a lot of falling over.
 Grab a team of up to 4 players and dive into the city chaos, where success isn’t measured by completed levels — but by how loud you’re laughing.

store.short: Main Sequence is a first-person space-sim factory builder where you design spaceships, build space stations, and automate everything. Start with a single ship and grow to become an interstellar industrial empire as you leave your mark on the galaxy.
store.about:
You are at the frontier of human-charted space in a small mining ship, tasked with expanding humanity's footprint amongst the stars. To succeed, you’ll need to collect resources, automate production, expand your base of operations, and research new technologies.

 You start out with a single mining ship in a resource-rich asteroid belt. Use your scanners to find the best places to mine, and then refine the resources on your ship. Build a space station to set up a permanent base of operations which you can begin to expand and automate.

 Onboard your stations, the factories you build are the heart of your industrial operation . Build machines, connect them with conveyor belts, and plan your production lines to keep everything flowing at full efficiency. Once that's running, that same logic extends across systems - automated supply routes between stations , and a fleet that keeps everything provisioned while you focus on expanding your operations.

 Every ship and station is yours to design, inside and out . Module by module, you decide cargo capacity, reactor placement and weapons - whatever the situation calls for. Save designs to use again, share them with friends, or build freely in creative mode.

 Research new technology with the items you produce. Each unlock opens up new ships, station modules, items and upgrades -...

 Each delivery is different. Arriving in bags, boxes, or stuffed into mattresses, it's your job to retrieve it all, identify any problems like dirt, blood, or counterfeit bills, and get to work. Your clients expect results! Do your job well, or do whatever it takes, and reap the rewards.
 In your downtime, order new tools to increase your efficiency, and scale up your operation. Or just buy stuff to cozy up your place!
 Take on jobs at your own pace, expand your cleaning services to gold bars, different currencies, and more. Explore your lab...you may need more than just your eyes to discover its secrets. And maybe ask yourself how you got here...and why can't you leave?

 Use washing machines, dryers, counting machines, and other tools to clean dirty cash. After cleaning, don’t forget to count it and send it to your handlers! Maybe not all of it; the money pile doesn’t grow by itself! Progress through the jobs to upgrade your gear and unlock new ways to handle the money! 

 Your phone is the center of your operation. Surf the darknet to find new jobs, order useful (and not so) tools, take pictures, and scan your surroundings for helpful tips. Just put it on mute when you’re working. You don’t want any distractions! 

 All the satisfaction of having lots of money without any shootouts! Leave the danger to the others; you’re here to relax and clean the cash, and you don’t really care...

store.name: Clue/Cluedo
store.short: Experience a fresh take on the classic crime-solving board game. Step into new mysteries and use your skills of deduction to find out whodunit, with what weapon and where.
store.about:
🔎🗡️ Join fellow detectives all over the world in the official digital board game version of Clue/Cluedo! Gather crucial evidence, interrogate suspects and solve the original murder mystery. 
 Follow Miss Scarlett, Colonel Mustard, Professor Plum, Chef White, Solicitor Peacock and Mayor Green through the iconic Tudor Mansion, unlocking their motives and alibis as you go. 
 Enjoy Clue/Cluedo the way you remember it in Classic Mode, or jump in for a quick game with Clue Cards mode. Alternatively, if you want to really test your sleuthing skills, try a new investigation format available exclusively to Clue/Cluedo – Ultimate Detective.
 In Ultimate Detective Mode, everyone answers suggestions at the same time…but secretly! 
 Face your suspects in a direct interrogation as you rely on your skills of deduction to get to the truth. Experience the mystery, solve the murder and become a top-tier detective!

 HOW TO PLAY CLUE/CLUEDO: 
 Three cards are dealt face-down and set aside – this is the solution to the crime!

 Everyone is dealt three Clue Cards. These are automatically crossed off your clue sheet, as they can’t be part of the solution. 

 Roll the dice and move around the board. 

 When you enter a room, you can make a suggestion – select who you think the murderer is, what weapon they used and where the crime happened. 

 Other players will then aim to disprove your suggestion; if one of your suggestions matches a card in their hand, they show you that card to disprove it. 

 Use your clue sheet to keep track of which characters, weapons and rooms have been disproven. 

...

store.name: Delta Force
store.short: Play for free in operator-based extraction and full-scale combined arms warfare. Become elite Operators, customize an ever-expanding arsenal of weapons, and deploy into thrill-packed missions across multiple modes.
store.about:
OPERATOR-BASED EXTRACTION SHOOTER 

 Join the G.T.I. and select from elite Operators, each equipped with unique tactical gadgets and traits. Whether you favor Detection Arrows, Magnetic Bombs, or Motorized Exoskeletons, coordinate your squad's abilities to outmaneuver rivals in high-stakes missions.
 LOOTING HAS NEVER BEEN THIS FUN 

 Rediscover the thrill of looting. Explore dynamic maps to decipher entry codes, scale heights for Bird Nests, or dive deep to salvage Clams. Every raid offers a new treasure hunt, turning simple looting into an adrenaline-fueled adventure.
 OUTSMART BOSSES. OUTGUN THE PLAYERS 

 Take on heavily armed mercenaries and ruthless bosses guarding high-value loot. But stay sharp—the deadliest threat comes from rival Operator squads hunting the same prize. Fortune awaits those who can survive the crossfire and extract. No risk, no reward.
 CHOOSE YOUR EXIT STRATEGY 

 Extraction is an art form. Forget standard exit zones—launch a massive Rocket Extraction, base jump with a wingsuit, or crawl through long sewer pipes to slip away unseen. Adapt your escape plan to the chaos and exfil in spectacular style.
 EXFIL AND UPGRADE YOUR OPERATIONS CENTER 

 Survival is just the beginning. Put your loot to good use-upgrade your Operations Center to enhance physical attributes, expand stash capacity, and unlock new gear. Every improvement opens more tactical possibilities, ensuring you return to the field stronger and better equipped
 DOMINATE LAND, SEA & AIR IN ALL-OUT WARFARE 

 Dive into Warfare, where 64 players clash in massive battles. Command tanks and...

store.name: CrisisX
store.short: Immerse yourself into a realistic open world experience and find your way out in the ruins of a dying world. Survive the threats from the Infected, the living and most importantly, the wilderness. Fight or cooperate with others, and establish your territory. Build your own new post-apocalyptic world
store.about:
Massive Multiplayer Map
 Explore a massive 1,200 km² open-world map on an epic journey with 5,000 other players on a single server. Travel through 12 distinct terrains and bio-environments, finding, collecting, and hunting hundreds of unique items, vegetation, resources, and wild animals. Endure hot and cold environments, facing their harsh effects on your body.
 From western-style towns to hidden laboratories where mysteries unfold, from snowy mountaintops to rushing rivers. Every inch of the world contains opportunities but also danger. Region specific mutants and resources require you to put more effort to deal with or to get.

 Versatile Fighting Dynamic
 Wield weapons ranging from the iconic machete and crossbows to the common pistol and sophisticated sniper rifle. Killing a single Infected might only require a machete or hunting bow, but a horde of them? Machine guns, RPGs, and grenades are your best choices. A Titan mutant? You’ll need a group of teammates armed with your best firearms.
 The real challenge, however, comes from other survivors. They might build armored vehicles like modified M113, M2 Bradley, or even a WWII-era M4 Sherman tank to battle you for a single oil well. What's your counter by then? Your own tank? Land mines? It all depends on your strategy.

 Survive The Post-Apocalyptic Chaos
 Even in a post-apocalyptic world, hunger, thirst, disease, poison, or wild animals can still harm you. Eating too much gains weight, eating too little gets you killed. These rules never change, even in an apocalypse. On the other hand, lumbering, mining, fighting,...

store.name: Airframe Ultra
store.short: There's only two types of racers in Megacity West: The winners and the dead. Down here, you’ve got a chop shop Airframe, a rusted machete, and blood on the motorway. Welcome to the violent underground world of Ultra Circuit racing!
store.about:
Three feet above the blacktop lies another city. Its citizens are the desperate, the thrill-seeking, the dangerous and the mad. At this height, the legends of the street are made.

 Airframe Ultra is a fast-paced battle-racer where you compete with friends and foes in split-screen and online multiplayer. You can thrash with pipes, chains and plasma torches or leave them in the dust with boosts and pure white-knuckle cunning. Whatever it takes to win. So load up, make your racer, and settle things like a legend on the cracked asphalt streets of Megacity West!

 You are gutterborn. Squatters. Smugglers. Pickpockets. Thieves. But with a second hand Airframe, a few custom mods, and a big heavy baseball bat you can become the one thing with freedom in a city of billions: A racer. It won't be quick and it won't be clean but if you've got the will and the wits, you can win a circuit. One circuit becomes two, two becomes ten, and all of a sudden street rats from Ellay to the Bay are chanting your name. Infamy is its own reward. Your key to a new world where first place is all that matters.

 From the rusting shipyards of Slabtown to the sleek 'scrapers in Vantac... from the dune dens of the Ysidro edgelands to the hulking arcologies of the Texicali ZEGO zone, Airframe racers from all across Megacity West compete for fame, fortune and a chance at glory... three feet above or six feet below. You can have everything you've ever wanted. All you need to do is win.

 Surviving your first race is just the beginning. You'll rack up kills and cross finish lines. New helmets, new clothes....

store.name: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered
store.short: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.
store.about:
Shrek, Fiona, Donkey and friends are back! 
 DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics. 

 Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise.
 Improved graphics: Everything has been rebuilt with better textures, enhanced UI, 4K resolution and cutscenes.

 New features: Create timeless snapshots using the new Photo Mode and unlock cheats in Cheat Mode to make your playthrough a seamless experience.

 Up to 4-player Couch Co-op, Online or Mixed: A cozy, team-based co-op action-adventure game, playable solo or up to 4-Player Couch Co-Op, Online Multiplayer, and Mixed Online Multiplayer & Couch Co-Op.

 Immersive levels straight out of a fairytale : From Shrek’s swamp to the castle of Far Far Away, relive iconic moments from the movie featuring beloved characters and hidden Easter Eggs.

 Swap heroes at any time : Swap your hero to battle enemies, conquer bosses, and solve environmental puzzles using their unique abilities to advance in the story.

 Travel back to a nostalgic era of gaming for some pick-up-and-play casual fun.

store.name: The God Slayer
store.short: Enter an Eastern-inspired steampunk metropolis where gods known as Celestials reign with a divine fist. In this open-world RPG, you are an Elemancer who refuses to bow. Infused with elemental powers and a heart of vengeance, you will dethrone them all. You will rise to be the God Slayer.
store.about:
A long time ago, the Celestials created the world and all its inhabitants. They designed the creatures to cultivate an energy known as qi throughout their lifetimes. Upon death, this enriched qi would be passed to the Celestial realm, empowering them and granting them eternal life.

However, some curious humans discovered how to harness qi for themselves, transforming it into elemental powers—fire, water, earth, metal, and wood. These practitioners became known as Elemancers. The Celestials were outraged, viewing this as a misuse of what was rightfully theirs. To send a message, they launched a swift and brutal assault on the Zhou Kingdom, the mightiest in the land. In one night, the king and many Elemancers were hunted down and slaughtered. This day became infamously known as the God Fall.

You play as Cheng, whose family was brutally slain by the Celestials during the God Fall. Now, you must embark on a quest to save your people and avenge your loved ones.

To achieve this, you will learn to harness and enhance your elemental powers, acquire new skills from ancient scrolls and elemental masters, and refine the flow of qi within you. With dedication, you will gain the power to challenge even the mightiest Celestials.

In this world, elemental powers interact dynamically: fire consumes wood, water extinguishes fire, steam rises from boiling water, and earth can obstruct. Your approach to utilizing these elemental interactions in battle is entirely up to you!

Although the Celestials have long been revered as creation gods by the people, their actions during the God Fall...

store.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
store.short: Explore the world with our largest fleet of aircraft and take simulation to new heights while pursuing your aviation career within Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.
store.about:
Fly with Purpose 
Launch your aviation Career wherever you choose in the world. Gain experience, build your reputation, and complete certifications to gain access to authentic aviation activities ranging from Medevac, Remote Cargo Ops, Aerial Firefighting, Search & Rescue and more, all the way to becoming an Airline Passenger Transport Pilot. Set out on a truly global aviation adventure with virtually unlimited missions across the planet.

Compete against other pilots in the all-new Challenge League mode or hone your skills in dozens of Activities ranging from exciting Rally Races and Precision Landings to Low-Altitude challenges and more. Fly head-to-head in the iconic Red Bull Air Races and the legendary Reno Air Races, including the new Roswell courses.

Be a World Photographer and travel across our beautiful planet to capture awe-inspiring natural vistas, visit famous landmarks, and record these adventures with pictures in your travel book. Unique photo challenges test your creative eye along with your piloting skills while you strive to capture the perfect moment.

 Advanced Simulation 
Enhanced physics system allows 10,000+ rigid-body surfaces that enable the simulation of any shape of aircraft. Soft body physics supports cloth, ropes, balloons, and more. Improved ground and water handling further enhance realism.

New, highly accurate aircraft systems including electrical, pneumatic, fuel and hydraulic systems, payload and passenger systems, and avionics like the Universal UNS-1 FMS and Primus Epic 2. Preflight inspections and walkaround checks add to immersion.
...

store.name: POPUCOM
store.short: Venture together with your friends on an unknown planet. Use color switching, match-3 shooting, and artifact powers to overcome challenges and keep advancing. What lies ahead of you is an adventure filled with wonder, hope, and much more to discover!
store.about:
POPUCOM is a multiplayer co-op platform adventure game. As an adventurer, you are summoned to an unknown planet to embark on an exoplanet adventure with your friends. You will face various enemies and use engaging items and techniques to eliminate threats and restore the world to its former glory.

 Work together with your friends to take on a variety of challenges. Effective cooperation and strong teamwork are the only ways forward. Whether it's facing powerful enemies or tackling complex puzzles, you'll need to work together to triumph!

 Color plays a crucial role in this fantastical world. It is key to everything from puzzle solving to combat. You'll need to switch colors to activate mechanisms and solve puzzles, and shoot Pomu gel in different colors to change the surroundings and impact enemies. Master the techniques of color switching and match-3 shooting to overcome puzzles and defeat enemies!

 During the journey, you will acquire items known as super artifacts. Examples of these wondrous artifacts include Rollo the Bomb, Captain Kitty, Barrier Bot, and Power Kid. Each of them grants you a unique ability that helps remove obstacles and solve puzzles in your adventure.

 The adventure isn't just about combat; it's also about showcasing your style! Pick from a selection of gear and cosmetics in the Closet and combine them to create your unique looks. Then you can set off on the journey in your personalized style!

 In addition to the exciting battles and engaging puzzles, the game includes a number of enjoyable mini-games. Head to the in-game arcade room for some...

store.name: The Legend of California
store.short: The Legend of California is an open world, action-survival shooter set on the mythical Island of California during the gold rush era. Explore a vast, untamed frontier and forge your legacy alone or with friends.
store.about:
The Legend of California is a  multiplayer, action-survival FPS set on the Island of California during the gold rush era. 

 Explore, gather, craft, build, hunt, and fight your way across a vast untamed frontier. Whether you choose to travel alone or work together with friends, your mission on this mythical island is not just to survive, but thrive.

 Stay strong, stake your claim, and become the true Legend of California. 

 Discover an expansive, ever-changing open world inspired by the gold rush era that features distinct biomes, challenging PvE encounters, and iconic California landmarks 

 Master FPS combat that rewards precision and skill—whether you’re hunting wildlife to stay alive, taking down hostile encampments for some quick coin, or defending your territory against enemy players in optional PvP 

 Leverage robust gathering and crafting systems to transform the Californian wilderness into everything you need to survive, from weapons for protection and tools for expansion to delicious meals to stay fed and ready 

 Establish and expand your own ranch ; build a mine, add stables, and unlock powerful new crafting stations to further customize your slice of the wild 

 Play online on persistent multiplayer servers where you can forge your legacy solo or form a company with up to three other players, sharing resources, buildings, progress, and more

store.name: One-armed robber
store.short: One-armed robber is a chaotic first-person heist game that centers around a uniquely challenging premise. Players take the role of a determined robber equipped with only one arm, tasked with pulling off daring heists on banks, shops, and various establishments.
store.about:
Experience the challenge of robbing banks, but now with only one arm! Grab a friend and you'll have two arms in total.

Unlock and buy new guns, which can be customized to fit your playstyle. If you are trying to go stealth, the optimal choice might be a suppressor, but if you're going loud, damage and bullets is all that matters, so put on an extended mag and get going!

Each heist is suited for any playstyle, whether you want to sneak in and take out guards quietly, or you go in guns blazing shooting everthing in your sight until you reach the vault, the choice is yours. 

As you become a more experienced robber new tools will be unlocked, which will make it easier for you to complete the heists. Each tool has a special purpose, and unique tools make it possible to complete heists in new ways you couldn't do before. 

Whether you go loud or stealth, once you are in the vault, the objective is the same: Gather as much loot as possible, and get out alive!
If you can't fit all the loot in the vault in your duffel bag, you can either run back to the truck and get a new one, or get your friends to help you carry out everything!

store.name: Goodbye Seoul
store.short: Six months remain before an asteroid hits Earth. And a new leaf is about to turn. A narrative puzzle adventure unfolds in a bleak yet beautiful Seoul. Will you uncover the truth in time?
store.about:
As news of an impending asteroid strike looms over Earth, the once bustling city of Seoul has turned into a wasteland.
 Play as Rion, a student who ventures into the ruined city, trailing the leads for what might be humanity's last thread of hope—a covert evacuation program destined for outer space.
 Follow Rion's journey across a bleak yet beautiful Seoul in this story-rich puzzle platformer.
 Make use of your surroundings to solve puzzles, and find hidden clues that will help piece together the full picture of the covert project.
 But beware, as this city is not a welcoming place.
 Between crumbling ruins and hostile survivors, every step Rion takes is rife with danger.

 The planet has only six months before it meets its end. Will you uncover the truth in time?

 With six months left until the impact, hope was the first to fall. 

 Uncover the truth behind the secret space evacutation project. 

 Face the doubts within, and find a purpose to keep on living. 

 Team up with desperate survivors and unlikely allies as you explore Seoul. 

 Use the environment to avoid direct confrontation. 
 Observe, think, and survive—every detail is part of the puzzle.

store.name: KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-
store.short: KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- is an HD remastered collection of 6 unforgettable KINGDOM HEARTS experiences. Take up your Keyblade to save the Disney worlds from darkness.
store.about:
KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- is an essential collection of the first six stories in the KINGDOM HEARTS series, a collaboration between Disney and SQUARE ENIX. Wield the legendary Keyblade and unlock the true power of friendship as you explore Disney worlds and defend them from darkness.

 KINGDOM HEARTS FINAL MIX

 KINGDOM HEARTS Re:Chain of Memories

 KINGDOM HEARTS II FINAL MIX

 KINGDOM HEARTS 358/2 Days (HD cutscene compilation)

 KINGDOM HEARTS Birth by Sleep FINAL MIX

 KINGDOM HEARTS Re:coded (HD cutscene compilation)

Enhanced backgrounds make this collection more stunning than ever before. Start your KINGDOM HEARTS journey now!

This game is available in two versions: Japanese and International.
Select your preferred language via the Steam launcher by right-clicking the title, then selecting "Properties" followed by "General".

NOTICE: Save data cannot be transferred between the Japanese and International versions.

store.name: Burning Sword: Death Sun
store.short: Burning Sword: Death Sun is a wuxia action game set in 12th century China. Play as Zhang Yixiang, cast down by the Elder of the Northern Mountain, and carve a bloody path back to him. Hardcore combat, epic boss battles, roguelite progression, and an arena built for high scores.
store.about:
Burning Sword tells the story of Zhang Yixiang (张逸羡) and his pursuit of power and vengeance for the death of his master. Hardcore action combat meets epic boss battles and careful customization, intermixed with subtle environmental storytelling and worldbuilding. Burning Sword emphasizes challenge, progression, and deep combat systems.

 The story is told subtly, but is full of character, political intrigue, and power dynamics. Starting in the year 1139 during the Southern Song Dynasty (南宋), you play as Zhang Yixiang just as he's cast down and nearly killed by the Elder of the Northern Mountain. The martial arts emerged during moments in history like this, when tyranny and brutality must be met with strength and passion.

 Enter the Burning Sword. Key combat features include:

 Yixiang's fury and anger give birth to a fiery Qi and the ability to wield a burning sword. Qi restores vitality, fuels techniques, and augments combat abilities. It is a scarce but critical resource.

 This martial art also emphasizes agility, speed, lightness and ease of traversal, letting Yixiang jump, wall-run, glide, and explore an expansive world.

 Wuxia-based swordplay and bodily attacks combine into a fierce and flexible combat style that leaves lots of room for experimentation.

 Players will dodge, parry, strike, combo, and acquire powerful techniques to carve a bloody path through mobs of enemies and make their way back to the Elder to finish the job. The combat rewards skill and timing, and punishes mistakes harshly.

 Finally, because the combat is this fun and rewarding, the game also...

store.name: Chained Together
store.short: Climb up from the depths of Hell. Scale various worlds solo or chained together with your friends in the 1-4 player platforming sensation.
store.about:
Climb or die! 
 Take on the challenge of the infamous hardcore platformer either alone or chained together with up to three friends.
 Climb as high as possible to escape Hell. Coordinate your clambering and perfect your jumps to scale punishing platforms and outrun the scorching heat. Every layer threatens your ascension with unique challenges, each tougher than the last.

 Will you make it to the summit or perish before glory? 
 Features 
 Choose your difficulty: Brave the punishing Normal Mode, play with checkpoints in Beginner Mode, or race against constantly rising flames in Lava Mode. It's masocore heaven!

 Local and online co-op:  Play together in person or online

 2v2 Race mode: Run for your life and climb higher than the other team in timed races 

 Realistic chain physics: The chain is fully simulated and wraps around platforms. Use this power to your advantage

 Leaderboards: Compare your climbs with the world

 Meaningful rewards: Leaderboards and Achievements are only valid in Normal and Lava Modes

copies.name: Carry the Glass Together! [2 Player Obby]

store.name: NAKWON: LAST PARADISE
store.short: NAKWON is a multiplayer zombie survival game set in urban South Korea. Venture into the city in the dead of night, and manage your shelter by day. Scavenge resources in a city crawling with the infected and hostile survivors. Survival is the only rule - trust no one, not even the living.
store.about:
Realistic Zombie Survival Where Every Day is a Fight to Stay Alive 
 NAKWON (or "Paradise") is an immersive zombie survival game where your only goal is to stay alive. Begin your life as a refuge in a safe haven built by survivors. Head out to scavenge for food and supplies in a city overrun by the infected to manage your shelter. Every little thing counts in your fight for survival. Kitchen tools become weapons, small wounds can be fatal, and stress will eventually break your mind if left unmanaged. All these elements come together to deliver an authentic and immersive zombie apocalypse experience.

 High-Risk Urban Expeditions Filled with Survivors and the Infected 
 Expedition areas are packed with the infected and other survivors who are desperate for resources. In this crumbling world, danger lurks around every corner and you'll never know what you're walking into. Survive the intense PvPvE expeditions in the ruins of a fallen city. Face the raw tension that grips your senses. Immerse yourself in the struggle to stay alive.

 Strategic Survival Action Through Any Means Necessary 
 Confrontation is not the only option—survival comes in many forms. Hide, run, betray, or cooperate. Do whatever it takes to make it out alive. Other survivors can't be trusted and the infected are deadly. In this world, your survival depends on the strategy you choose. 
To survive in the face of unpredictable threats, you must stay alert to everything around you.

 Bringing Together Extraction Looting and Survival Simulation 
 As a NAKWON citizen, you must maintain your shelter during the...

store.name: Mortal Shell II
store.short: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.
store.about:
Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel to Mortal Shell that significantly expands on the original with unrestricted, adrenaline-charged combat, extensive weapon upgrades, and free exploration. 

The forgotten Shells of eight lost warriors are scattered throughout Mortal Shell II’s ravaged world. Seek and possess these Shells, unleash their innate abilities, and discover the story of each by unravelling their secrets.

 Mortal Shell II offers a clean, agile and grounded combat system, with options to think strategically about upgrading melee and ranged weapons.

Unrestricted by stamina, players exploit multiple tactics to shatter enemy posture and strike critically.

 Mortal Shell II’s open world is compact, tightly interconnected and immersive. It is designed with respect for the player's time. 

Those who wander from the golden path can discover new Shells, weaponry, upgrades, curiosities and more.

store.name: METRO 2039
store.short: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.
store.about: Receive 10% off your Digital Deluxe Edition pre-order if you purchased any qualifying digital game from the METRO series.

store.name: Dispatch
store.short: Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero. All episodes out now!
store.about:
From the writers & directors of  Tales from the Borderlands and  The Wolf Among Us , 
 Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy set in modern day Los Angeles. 

 You play as Robert Robertson, AKA Mecha Man, whose mech-suit is destroyed in a battle against his nemesis, forcing him to take a job at a superhero dispatch center: not as a hero, but a dispatcher. In charge of rehabilitating a group of ex-supervillains, you must manage your roster while navigating office relationships and rebuilding your suit for a shot at revenge. 

 In Dispatch , every decision you make influences the unfolding narrative. From banter in the breakroom to life-or-death situations in the field, your choices affect your relationships with the heroes, their allegiances, and the path your own story takes.

 Use the strategy map to review ongoing emergencies and deploy the right (or wrong) heroes to deal with them. Balance the risks and rewards as you make tactical decisions, knowing that each choice can have lasting consequences for your team and the city.

 Managing heroes sometimes goes beyond their powers. Each hero comes with quirks, flaws, and baggage you’ll need to navigate to keep the team together. Upgrade their skills and unlock abilities to boost their effectiveness in the field.
 Blending narrative, strategy, and humor, Dispatch  explores what it means to be a hero, whether you're wearing a cape or behind a desk.

 Featuring an all-star cast from every corner of entertainment
 Aaron Paul ( Breaking Bad, Westworld, Black Mirror )

 Laura Bailey ( The Legend of Vox Machina, The Last of Us...

store.name: RECUR
store.short: A time-bending journey to the end of the world and back. Run, jump, and manipulate time to solve puzzles as the apocalypse unfolds. Can you stop the clock on disaster?
store.about:
You’re just an average postman, but today is anything but average. It’s the end of the world and you suddenly have the power to control time itself. By moving forwards or backwards, you alone control the flow of time to solve problems, change outcomes, and discover secrets as you try to save the world.

 You need more than just reflexes to save the world: you’ll need to use your time-bending abilities to solve puzzles and traverse gargantuan obstacles. Explore a world falling apart in your quest to put things right. Or left.

 How did you get your powers? Why is the world ending? Unravel the secrets of RECUR as you discover a rich and engaging story, brought to you by the brilliant team behind A Juggler’s Tale.

store.name: Dust Front RTS
store.short: Dust Front is a classic RTS with grand strategy elements and a non-linear campaign. Lead strategic maneuvers, overwhelm your enemies with cannon fodder, or stomp them into the stone age with carpet bombing on the lifeless fields of Dust Front.
store.about:
Dust Front is a classic RTS with elements of grand strategy, procedural world and non-linear campaign. The action takes place on a planet devastated by many wars and upheavals, where under a thick layer of soot and concrete buried remnants of humanity's former might.

 Army creation. Arsenal of tanks, aviation, infantry and vehicles of various purposes.

 Base construction and resource gathering. Factories for the production of vehicles, refining minerals and barracks with storage facilities. All buildings are important on the global map as well.

 Procedural. Missions are combined with procedural map generation and external rules.

 Challenge. Asymmetrical gameplay. Battles with an enemy superior in number and strength. 

 GLOBAL MAP
 There will be no peace on Earth while the Empire's enemies roam it. Countless mutants, robots with far superior technology, rebels attacking us from the rear, and conspiracies we know nothing about. Do we have anyone more loyal than the army, or do we have no allies at all? 
 In the game, you will discover the value of your power on the global map .

 Global Economy. Mining and production within territories affects the economic situation in a strategic mode.

 Events. In the captured regions, news happens, in which you will participate through mini-dialogs. Merchants with resources and mercenaries with unique units can also appear.

 Technology branches. Unlock new units and buildings, improving and equipping them with more modern ways of destruction will lead to quick victories.

 Garrisons. Your troops gain ranks and can be moved from...

store.name: VOID/BREAKER
store.short: Fast paced Bullet hell Roguelite FPS 🔴 Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through enviro destruction /BREAK THE SYSTEM /BREAK FREE

You are trapped in an endless sequence by the all-seeing, hostile AI. 
You are its prisoner - forced to fight, die, and repeat.

 The machines think you'll never escape. The system is designed to keep you here.
 B̷̫̬̗̈́Ȕ̸̲̾̕T̸̛̮͌̀ ̴̢͕̊͋̚ͅ ̵̠̪͙̥̄ ̸̡̼̦̬̎ ̸̣̟̺̘̀͛ ̶̛͚͔͍̍̀Ẽ̷̥͉͑̈S̷͓̑C̵̰͍̬̆̔͐A̷̡̓̀̌P̸̺͇̰͐̊͜E̷͕̼̘͇̾ ̴͚̻͎͙͋̿̂̾ ̷̡̲̗̅̋̇͘ ̸̝̖̗̀̀͒̈ ̸̛̲͌̋I̸̢̟̠̓̃ͅS̷͈͋̇̕ ̴̳̺͋̍̊̿ ̵̲̩̾ ̶̧̙̯̓͑̏ ̸̢̿̀̈́ ̵̗̦͎͂̍̓ ̸̼͎͋̕P̷͙̟̔̚Ő̵͓S̴͉̞̝̟͌S̷̜͔̤͗̿̽Ȋ̴̩̠͉̲̚Ḃ̶̙͉L̵̺̔́͝Ę̶͙̩͆̌

 Lightning-Fast Gunplay & Flawless Movement 
 This isn’t just shooting - it’s pure velocity.
 Run through relentless gunfights with fluid movement designed for high-paced action. 
Outmaneuver your enemies and dominate every firefight with agility and speed.

 Infinite Weapons. Infinite Possibilities  
 Discover limitless weapon combinations using the ultimate gun-modding system. 
Strategically combine mods to create devastating loadouts. 
Unlock wild synergies that turn you into an unstoppable force.

 Destruction is your Advantage. 
 Why just shoot your enemies when you can tear down the world around them? 
Environmental destruction isn't just for show - it's a core gameplay mechanic.
Blast through walls, collapse structures, and stagger enemies to survive.

 New Run. New Choices. New Paths 
 Every run presents decisions. Which fights do you take?
 Which paths push your limits?
 Do you take the dangerous route for bigger rewards or play it safe? 
 The choice is yours

 A Passion Project by a Solo Developer 
 VOID/BREAKER is a solo project from developer Daniel Stubbington, known as Stubby Games.

store.name: Terminator: Survivors
store.short: Judgment Day has come. As the rare survivor of this catastrophic event, fight and help the Resistance rise from the ashes of civilization. But beware, Skynet's machines patrol relentlessly the surface and the legendary T-800 is on your trail.
store.about:
Play as a survivor in this open world return to the iconic Terminator universe set in the aftermath of Judgment Day. 

Four years have passed since the day humanity almost disappeared. The truth behind this apocalyptic event has yet to be uncovered. You emerge from a shelter to try and re-establish a semblance of society, only to discover a world ravaged by Skynet, who seem hell-bent on eliminating you and the last remnants of humanity. 

Fight the first Skynet prototypes and help the Resistance rise from the ashes of civilization. But beware, the legendary T-800 is after you, and staying in one place for too long could prove fatal.
Investigate and discover the truth behind the nuclear apocalypse, Skynet and the Terminator threat.

 Meet iconic characters of the franchise as well as original ones and immerse yourself in a meticulously crafted world set in the post-apocalyptic future of James Cameron’s masterpiece.

 Fight formidable sophisticated machines and stop skynet from eradicating humanity again, but never forget: The fearsome and deadly Terminator is out there, hunting you, and a constant threat.

 Learn more about what happened on Judgment Day in an unexplored storyline and try to change humanity’s fate.

 Grow from the remnants of the old world at a home base you’ll use to establish a new foothold for humanity and stand tall against the machine threat.

 While you’ll be armed to attack up close and at range, stealth and caution may be more intelligent approaches with Skynet’s machines and scavengers lurking.

store.name: Astral Party
store.short: Astral Party is a multiplayer party game populated by cute anime girls! Choose your favorite character, strategize skills & cards, and roll the dice to destroy friendships in this unique board game.
store.about:
Astral Party is a board party game that supports online multiplayer with up to 4 players. This is a free to play game, with in-app purchases like skins, dress-ups that do not affect the gameplay balance.

 Board Party Game with Suspenses 
 A board game like no other! 15 different panel effects, random effects and events make every game full of suspense and unpredictability. With the roll of dice, you always have chances to turn the tables at the last minute.

 Over 10 Cute Anime Girls 
 This is an exciting dicing battle with vivid Characters, each with unique skills and beautiful illustration. 10 characters are available as the game launches, and will have more as updates add.

 4-Person Online Matches or Single Play with AI 
 Play how you want. Astral Party allows 1 to 4 players to compete online, or single-person play with AI. It's all the same friendship ruining fun.

 Dices & Cards & Battles & More 
 The crux of Astral Party lies in its one-on-one dice-based combat system, with a myriad of cards, effects, skill, events, and more. Card plays can augment your attack, and the dice decides if it is dodged. Every attack is like a small gamble, and nothing is more chilling than the moment you presume victory is within your grasp.

 Monsters Spice Up the Game More 
 As the game advances, monsters will surface on the board, some attacking players and others merely stealing coins. In the end, a formidable Boss will appear and relentlessly target the richest player. If it is you, be wary of other players’ "backstabs". (PS: Try beat the Boss to find out if there is reward...

store.name: ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN
store.short: ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN is a standalone adventure within the ELDEN RING universe, crafted to offer players a new gaming experience by reimagining the game’s core design.
store.about:
ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN is a standalone adventure within the ELDEN RING universe, crafted to offer players a new gaming experience by reimagining the game’s core design.

 RISE TOGETHER.
Join forces with other players to take on the creeping night and the dangers within featuring 3-player co-op. Three Nightfarers will have two full days to explore the land of Limveld as they hunt one of the terrifying Nightlords. Find new companions or invite friends to join in an ever-changing 3-player co-op experience.

 BECOME A HERO.
Take command of eight uniquely skilled heroes, each possessing their own abilities and distinct flair. Each Nightfarer has three unique capacities: a passive ability, a character skill, and an ultimate art. These tools of survival and combat reflect each hero’s history and background. While individually formidable, their skills create powerful synergies when they unite as a team.

 TAKE ON THE NIGHT.
Your hunt takes place in Limveld, a transitory land, buffeted by the raging might of the Nightlords. These enormous beings lurk beyond the reach of most mortals and only reveal themselves when their commanders are defeated after two consecutive nights.Overcome a relentless environmental threat that sweeps through a land that changes between each game session and defeat the magnificent boss of that night.

Each Nightlord must be faced and defeated before the reign of night can be ended!

store.name: Annihilated
store.short: A story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.
store.about:
Annihilated is a story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. 

 You will play as the last survivor of the rescue party sent after the hero's party, who went missing deep in a cursed dungeon. When you finally reach the party members, you find:

 The Hero who lost the ability to speak.
 The Mage who lost the gift of magic.
 The Warrior who lost his mighty body.
 … and the Priest who lost ██.

 You can only carry one of them out. Choose your partner, and escape together.

 ■ Explore, fight, and lean on your partner 

 Choose your route, then fight in turn-based card battles. Every item you carry becomes a card with a limited number of uses, and enemies show you their next move before they act. Your partner fights beside you: the Hero shrugs off death, and the Priest heals like no one else.

 ■ Weapons hit hardest the moment they break 

 You get new gear by taking it from your enemies. Stagger a foe, then land a weapon's final use to trigger a Fatal Strike, which kills the enemy instantly and steals its equipment. Every weapon is at its strongest on its last use, so it often pays to shatter them on purpose, even when supplies run thin.

 ■ Bad roll? Spend a Curse and make it never have happened 

 Every shattered item leaves behind a Curse, and Curses let you Defy fate. Rolled the worst possible result? Spend a Curse, and it never happened. If you die, you retry from the floor where you fell. Stored Curses can be forged into the items you need, and the rest becomes experience. Every death makes the next...

store.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
store.short: An Oni Gauntlet-wielding samurai makes a stand in Kyoto against the encroaching Genma menace. Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?
store.about:
An all-new entry in the Onimusha series! 

Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-period Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice.
With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.
Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.
Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path? The Protagonist, Miyamoto Musashi 

An ardent samurai who arrives in Kyoto looking to prove that he is unmatched in the way of the sword. However, the path before him takes a strange and unexpected turn.

The protagonist of this game is a fierce young samurai, constantly moving from one bloody and gritty fight to the next. To cement this image of a striking samurai, Capcom has turned to none other than the late, iconic Japanese samurai movie legend Toshiro Mifune to star as the face model for this rendition of Miyamoto Musashi. Action 

Equipped with an Oni Gauntlet, Musashi is granted power beyond human limits. Besides giving him the strength needed to cut down the Genma, it also holds numerous other abilities, such as being able to absorb Genma souls and convert them into a power source to further enhance its wearer. But who is behind the voice that rings out from the gauntlet? Genma 

Usually found dwelling in the lowest depths of hell, the Malice enveloping Kyoto has brought...

store.name: Wildsite
store.short: Crash-land in a sci-fi survival craft game set on a planet plagued by toxic plasma storms. Alongside Bob, your sarcastic Virtual Sidekick, build and shrink your base to move it anywhere. Fight with primitive or plasma weapons, solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op!
store.about:
TAKE YOUR BASE WITH YOU 
 Construct a base to call home, providing shelter from the harsh elements and a secure place to store your belongings. Design your base however you see fit, then use the Shrink Device to pack up your entire base, with everything inside, and instantly redeploy it anywhere you want! 

 A NEW WAY OF TRAVERSAL 
 Why walk when you can catapult yourself? Throw a Grappling Grenade across any distance or reach impossible heights in seconds. Just make sure you don't miss the throw... or gravity will immediately remind you that it's there.

 RESOURCE GRENADES 
 Who said explosions are only for destruction? Throw special grenades that burst into valuable resources that you can mine using your Multitool (with specific attachments).

 CRAFT WEAPONS AND GATHER RESOURCES 
 Use your Multitool to mine resources and craft essentials at different stations from a basic Stone Axe to sci-fi tech.

 HUNT 
 Survival is simple: kill or be killed. Hunt local predators for meat and cook your kills to stay alive. Stay sharp! the fauna is always hunting you back. 

 PLASMA WEATHER THREAT 
 Watch the skies. High-energy atmospheric events trigger lethal radiation storms,  forcing you to seek immediate shelter or pop A-Rad pills to prevent cellular damage.

 BOB THE VIRTUAL SIDEKICK 
 Meet BOB , a sarcastic, peanut-shaped Virtual Sidekick in a cowboy hat with a heavy drawl and an even heavier superiority complex. Equal parts Space Cowboy and arrogant survival coach, he considers himself a high-tech masterpiece stuck babysitting a carbon-based disaster (aka a meat bag). 
 He's...

store.name: Persona 6
store.short: The iconic RPG series returns! The highly anticipated next chapter delivers a bold, new standalone story blending heartfelt daily life and new characters with pulse-pounding, supernatural adventure. Whether it’s your first Persona game or you’ve been here since the beginning, this one’s for you.
store.about:
With over 30 million copies sold worldwide, the Persona series has defined a generation of RPG storytelling. Now, after years of anticipation, the next installment is finally revealed.
 Persona 6 brings everything beloved about the series into a bold new story. The signature blend of heartfelt daily life and pulse-pounding supernatural adventure returns, wrapped around a completely fresh, standalone story and new cast of characters. Whether you've been with the series since the beginning or this is your very first Persona experience, you belong here.
 Unleash Your Persona. Forge Unbreakable Bonds. 
 Awaken the power of Persona, a manifestation of your innermost self, and discover others who share this extraordinary ability. Every relationship you nurture makes you stronger. Every bond you forge becomes a weapon against the darkness lurking within.
 Live a Double Life in Modern-Day Japan. 
 Navigate the rhythms of everyday school life and build friendships, pursue romance, and cultivate memories that matter. But beneath the surface of familiar streets and quiet neighborhoods lies something darker: strange rumors, unsettling urban legends, and occult incidents that only you and your closest allies can face.
 New to the Series? Learn about the journey. 
 The Persona series has over 30 years of history, but every numbered entry tells its own complete, standalone story - no prior experience required!
 Beginning in 1996 with "Revelations: Persona" as a spin-off of the Shin Megami Tensei franchise, Persona has since become a flagship RPG series for ATLUS.
 Now, Persona 6 promises...

store.name: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
store.short: Be Greater. Together. The incredible power of the symbiote forces Peter Parker and Miles Morales into a desperate fight as they balance their lives, friendships, and their duty to protect in an exciting chapter of the critically acclaimed Spider-Man franchise on PC.
store.about:
Edition includes:
 Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 

 Spider-Sense tingling…
 Mask-up for more thrilling web-slinging heroics as Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 swings onto PC. 
 Developed by Insomniac Games in collaboration with Marvel, and optimized for PC by Nixxes Software. 

 A city under siege! 
 Spider-Men Peter Parker and Miles Morales face the ultimate test of strength inside and outside the mask as they fight to save the city, each other and the ones they love, from the monstrous Venom and the dangerous new symbiote threat.

 Traverse an expanded Marvel’s New York 
 Explore a larger Marvel’s New York than ever before, featuring two new boroughs – Brooklyn and Queens – as well as locations like Coney Island, and more.
 Swing, jump, and utilize the new Web Wings to travel across the city, switching between Peter Parker and Miles Morales in open world exploration to experience different stories and epic new powers.

 Experience two playable Spider-Men 
 Wield Peter’s new symbiote abilities and Miles’ explosive bio-electric venom powers, and discover upgradeable, high-tech equipment that enhances the combat experience for extensive gameplay depth and variety.

 Battle iconic Marvel Super Villains 
 Fight against a variety of new and iconic villains, including an original take on the monstrous Venom, the ruthless Kraven the Hunter, the volatile Lizard, and many more!

 A more accessible Spider-Man experience 
 Support for a range of accessibility features strives to create a Marvel’s Spider-Man experience without barriers, that can be enjoyed by more players of different abilities.

 PC...

store.name: Aviassembly
store.short: Build and fly your own airplane! Complete missions to earn money, upgrade your plane, and discover new locations in an open world.
store.about:
Build A Plane 

 Create your own plane . Balance fuel capacity, weight, speed, cargo space and more. Choose parts carefully to optimize your plane for the desired flight characteristics. 

 Complete Missions 

 Test your plane, complete missions, and earn money. You'll need to haul different cargo types, each with unique requirements, so plan your trips carefully and avoid running out of fuel.

 Research and Upgrade 

 Research new parts and improve your designs to fly farther, faster, and carry more cargo. Upgrade your plane to handle bigger missions and explore new areas. 

 Explore 

 Explore an open world and find new airports and islands, each offering new challenges to test your plane designs and piloting skills.

 Features 

 Build your own airplane and optimize its performance. 

 Takeoff, fly and land your plane with physics based controls. 

 Explore and discover new biomes, each offering unique challenges and cargo types. 

 Transport and sell different cargo types. Each cargo type offers its own unique challenge. 

 Get creative in creative mode. Use your infinite resources to build anything you can imagine.

store.name: Grounded 2
store.short: Shrunk again, but the world is much larger. In this open-world, single-player or co-op survival adventure, craft weapons and armor, build your base, and traverse the playground on your buggy. But something else is out there—and it hasn’t forgotten you.
store.about:
When you've been shrunk to the size of an ant, what was once familiar is now a wild, uncharted frontier. Traverse sprawling manmade spaces overgrown with nature with buggies that can fight alongside with you, uncover hidden secrets, and fight to survive in a world much larger than the backyard. The playground may seem familiar, but beneath its bright colors and towering structures lie mysteries hidden in plain sight. Are you ready to uncover them?  

 Survive, Adapt, Overcome   
 The world is relentless, but so are you. Shape your adventure with unique archetypes, each offering distinct abilities to match your playstyle. Whether you rely on precision, cunning, or sheer strength, you’ll need every advantage to survive against the threats lurking in the park.  

 Stronger Together   
 The perils of the park are daunting alone, but with friends, every challenge becomes an adventure. Work together to build, fight, and uncover the secrets buried beneath the grass. Whether you’re facing danger side by side or continuing your journey in a shared world, survival is always better with allies.  

 Walking is Bogus - Introducing Buggies  
 They scurry, they fight, and now—they help you survive. Hatch, raise, and ride your own insect friends - buggies! Saddle up and ride through the park, command them in battle, or have them help gather resources. The right partner could mean the difference between thriving and barely surviving.  

 Big Baddies of the Park 
  The park is home to creatures other than the bugs you know and love. AXL, the tarantula, and the Lizard stand as apex predators...

store.name: Red Dead Redemption
store.short: Experience the story of former outlaw John Marston as he tracks down the last remaining members of the notorious Van der Linde Gang in the PC debut of the critically acclaimed predecessor to Red Dead Redemption 2.
store.about:
This product includes the digital version of Red Dead Redemption and Undead Nightmare for PC.

 Featuring the complete single-player experiences of both games, including bonus content from the Game of the Year Edition. Red Dead Redemption does not feature multiplayer content.

 Experience the story of former outlaw John Marston as he tracks down the last remaining members of the notorious Van der Linde Gang in the PC debut of the critically acclaimed predecessor to Red Dead Redemption 2.

Red Dead Redemption and its iconic zombie-horror companion story, Undead Nightmare, can now be enjoyed on PC in stunning detail together in one stellar package. Red Dead Redemption includes new features to bring the game to life on PC, with HDR lighting, native 4K resolution at up to 144hz on supported hardware, monitor support for Ultrawide (21:9) and Super Ultrawide (32:9), adjustable draw distances, shadow quality settings, and more.

store.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 25
store.short: EA SPORTS FC™ 25 gives you more ways to win for the club. Team up with friends in your favourite modes with the new 5v5 Rush, and manage your club to victory as FC IQ delivers more tactical control than ever before.
store.about:
Introducing Club Membership – the next phase of loyalty in EA SPORTS FC™ 25. Available to fans that have played EA SPORTS FC™ 24 before 27 September 2024 and play EA SPORTS FC™ 25 before November 1st, 2024*.

FC 25 Club Members will receive a host of exclusive benefits across the year, including a badge and kit to represent their status and rewards across all your favourite game modes.

Once again, all Founders will be able to unlock their Founders exclusive cosmetic items.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

store.name: My Child New Beginnings
store.short: My Child New Beginnings is a parenting simulator where you go through everyday life of growth. After a series of traumatic events that you and your child went through, you now get to rebuild life together in a new region of Norway.
store.about:
A new chance, a new school, and a new village. It's time for a new beginning with you and your child.

 When things go badly for you and your adoptive child, Karin or Klaus, two years ago, you both move to a tiny apartment in a new village where you meet friendlier neighbors and try to start a new life. Life was challenging but you had each other, as you both moved on from the trauma you encountered. Now you have the opportunity to move into a proper home and Karin begins in a new school, but not everything is as it seems as your child is holding back about their past and its up to you to discover what it means to heal together.

 This new emotional successor, inspired from the BAFTA award-winning, My Child Lebensborn, places you and your child in a new timeline and in a new setting where you both learn to heal in a life after trauma. You’ll discover why some bad memories don’t go away and encounter new challenges as Karin or Klaus deals with intense trauma responses brought on by the past.

 My Child New Beginnings on Steam comes with up to 34 chapters ready to play from start to finish. Your child will brave a new school, learn to make new friends, and finally take the first steps to confronting their traumatic past. As you grow with your child, you will explore topics of mental health and wellbeing and discover new ways to help calm and guide your child through the challenges of life.

 The adventure won't end here either as we look forward to bringing new adventures in the years to come. You can even bring over your child that you raised in My Child Lebensborn and...

store.name: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure
store.short: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a pixel-art precision platformer. Fire your floating cannon to trigger switches and move platforms. Grab items to dash with varying charges, directions and distances. Chart a path underground, restart power stations, and uncover the AI Deus's secrets.
store.about:
Move with one hand. Aim with the other. Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a hardcore precision platformer that puts both to work: shoot mechanisms and move platforms with your floating cannon, then collect ability items to dash. Limited charges and different launch directions challenge you to connect each shot, jump, and landing into a route through the ruins. And after waking up underground, you have another question to answer: why are you a robot?

 Created by a team bringing together a level designer and veteran Celeste player, a former miHoYo worldbuilding designer, and a former Sunborn technical-audio creator.
 Why play Dashoot: ABYA’s Adventure? 
 • Control ABYA and the floating cannon independently, combining movement, aiming, and mechanisms.
 • Collect different items to chain dashes, launch along the line to a device, or dash backwards over long distances. Plan around their charges, directions, and landing points.
 • Turn a first clear into a faster route, experimenting with shortcuts and ways to skip past obstacles.
 • Cross a nuclear plant and a geothermal station, discovering subway stops, Chinese signs, and clues in a pixel-art underground world.
 • Follow AI Deus and a trail of banter and dialogue to uncover who you are and why you became a robot.

 Read the landing. Make the jump. 
 Start with the jump itself: judge the gaps, avoid hazards, and time each takeoff and landing. Compact stages make every move count. Retry from checkpoints and turn a difficult stretch into a route you know by heart.

 Pick it up. Chain your dashes. 
 Shoot switches and move platforms...

store.name: Decrepit
store.short: Decrepit is a first-person action game with souls-like combat where every death drags you back into the depths. Learn the dungeon, master the combat, and find your way out of the forsaken castle.
store.about:
Decrepit is a first-person action game with souls-like combat about fighting your way out of a forsaken castle. Every death strips your gear and drags you back to the dungeons, restarting in a different cell each time.
 Your only advantages are the knowledge you gain from each attempt and whatever gear you can loot from the undead. Learn the castle and its inhabitants well enough, and what once felt impossible becomes manageable.
 Stamina-Based First-Person Combat 
 Combat is about positioning, timing, and reading enemy telegraphs. Each weapon has distinct attack patterns - light attacks, heavy strikes. Spells slot naturally into melee openings for strategic combinations. Manage your stamina, read patterns, and exploit openings. Mistakes are punished.
 Master the Castle 
 Each run begins in a different cell. Memorize winding corridors, unlock elevators that stay active, and discover passages that shorten your route. Learn which threats might appear where. Early runs feel endless. Later, you're heading straight for the boss that stopped you last time. The castle compresses as you learn it.
 Equipment Defines Your Build 
 You can carry one weapon, one staff, and one armor piece. These three slots define your playstyle. Find matching gear from the same archetype - Mage, Warrior, Rogue, or Shaman - and unlock set bonuses and unique abilities. Every slain enemy drops their gear. Adapt to what you find, or commit to hunting down a complete set.
 A Decaying Medieval Prison 
 From suffocating dungeons to rain-soaked courtyards, fight your way up through interconnected areas....

store.name: Ale & Tale Tavern
store.short: Get ready for a thrilling mix of genres: a cooperative, first-person, open-world fantasy tavern simulator, action, fishing, hunting, exploration, and completing fun and diverse quests. And, of course, COOKING! Play with friends, feed and quench the thirst of the entire world!
store.about:
You are in for a stunning mix of genres: a coop first-person fantasy tavern simulator in an open world, action, fishing, hunting, exploration, fun and diverse quests. And, of course, COOKING! Play solo or with friends and feed the entire world!

The game unfolds in a cozy and beautiful fantasy world. Step into the role of the owner of an abandoned tavern. Work alone or together with your friends to restore the former glory and popularity of the Ale & Tale tavern. 
Explore new recipes, participate in hunting and fishing, breed animals, grow plants, complete quests involving unique and amusing characters. Decorate your tavern. Fight against dangers. Cook dishes and drinks that will delight your visitors, and they will repay you with ringing coin! 
And remember: owning your own tavern is fun!! And if you want something else - just explore the world, enjoy its beauty and your complete freedom! Key Features:

 Play solo or with other players 
Coop mode for up to 6 people

 Owl Helpers – Automate Your Tavern! 

 Enjoy superior graphics and a dynamic game world 

 Explore a small, handcrafted open world full of adventures and activities 

 Complete a variety of diverse story quests and meet unique characters inhabiting the game world 

 Engage in whatever your heart desires 
Tavern management, cooking, decorating your tavern and crafting, delivering orders, growing plants, breeding animals, hunting, fishing, and much more

 Fight against a variety of enemies and monsters using different types of weapons 

Dive into an ocean of fun and complete freedom of action. Play the way you...

store.name: Planet Coaster 2
store.short: Build and customise thrilling roller coasters and incredible water slides, manage the ultimate theme park experience, and share your epic creations. Are you ready to ride the wave?
store.about:
Create a splash with Planet Coaster 2 - sequel to the world’s best coaster park simulator!   

 Reach new heights of creativity, management, and sharing as you construct the theme parks of your dreams combining epic water rides and coasters to delight and thrill your park guests.  

 Dive in now! 

 Expand your imagination:
 Enhanced and improved building and pathing tools let you create spectacular, true-to-life theme parks, complete with sprawling plazas. Make your mark on the world as you shape terrain and populate your park with stunning swimming pools and thrilling rides. It’s never been easier to bring your dream park to life.
 Create the ultimate theme park:
 Dive into a world of creativity with nine distinct themes, from returning classics like Pirate and Western, to exciting new additions in Viking and Mythology. With thousands of themed customisable pieces at your fingertips, every creation will be truly unique.
 Next-level customisation:
 Embark on the coaster park experience of a lifetime as you push the boundaries of creativity like never before!  Unleash your imagination as you build the most awe-inspiring themed creations with unparalleled customisation tools! For the first time, intuitively add scalable scenery and objects to every ride to elevate your park and give your guests a day to remember.  
 Combine epic water and coaster rides:
 Create the ultimate experience for your thrill-seeking guests using piece-by-piece construction. Build a vibrant array of exhilarating rollercoasters and jaw-dropping thrill rides. Design a seamlessly interconnected park...

store.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027
store.short: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!
store.about:
Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now with co-op gameplay!
 Car Mechanic Simulator 2027 returns with new features while staying true to the series’ proven formula. This installment introduces the long-awaited co-op mode, allowing you to run your workshop together with friends.
 Repair cars and expand your collection, with over 500 available vehicle configurations.
 Start your journey in any mode — gameplay is now fully customizable. Day and night cycle, deliveries, limited workspace, and job difficulty — everything can be tailored to match your preferred playstyle.
 The revised skill progression system offers even greater freedom, while the all-new garage customization mode lets you create a space exactly as you imagine it.

 Key Features: 
 Co-op multiplayer mode – build and manage your garage together

 150+ cars in over 500 configurations, with availability based on vehicle rarity

 8,000+ car parts to discover, repair, and install

 New modular engine system – easily swap and mix individual engine components

 Free driving around the garage and its surrounding area – drive and park wherever you want!

 Day & night cycle with time skip functionality

 Fuel system – consumption depends on engine type and driving style

 Advanced garage customization – decorate with tools, furniture, and lighting

 Dynamic part deliveries – delivery time and cost depend on time of day and game mode

 Limited availability of classic car parts – search the used parts market to find what you need

 Repair jobs with time-based bonuses – complete tasks faster to earn higher...

store.name: Path of Exile 2
store.short: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading.
store.about:
Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players. Path of Exile 2 takes place in the land of Wraeclast, a dark continent populated by unique cultures, ancient secrets, and monstrous dangers. A sinister threat, long thought destroyed, has begun creeping back on the edge of civilisation, driving people mad and sickening the land with Corruption. 
 Path of Exile 2 features a brand new campaign with six acts, 100 distinct environments, 600 monsters and 100 bosses. 

 Key Features
 Twelve Character Classes 
Path of Exile 2 features twelve character classes, two for every combination of Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence. While each of the class variants focuses on a different playstyle, they're just a starting point. You can combine skills from many classes together to create your ideal character build.

Each of the twelve character classes has its own three Ascendancy specialisations, resulting in a total of 36 Ascendancy Classes to pick between.

 New Skill Gem System 
Path of Exile 2 features 240 Skill Gems that grant devastating active skills and 200 Support Gems that modify their behaviour. Combine these together to create your perfect build.

This is the next generation of Path of Exile's famous skill system. Support Gems are now socketed directly into Skill Gems, removing many of the frustrations present in the old system while maintaining all the previous depth. It's now possible to six-link every skill your character uses.

 Dual-specialise your Passive Skill Tree 
Path of Exile's iconic Passive Skill...

store.name: MINDWAVE
store.short: MAKE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP OF MINDSCAPE TOWER. DELVE INTO THE MINDS OF YOUR OPPONENTS IN THIS MICROGAME FRENZY. BE CONSUMED BY THE TRUTH THEY SPEAK TO YOU, IN THE CEREBRAL BATTLE OF SIGHT AND SOUND HIDDEN WITHIN EACH OF US.
store.about:
Cerebral Microgame Frenzy
 Play through collections of rapid-fire microgames formed from the minds of multiple colorful opponents in this cerebral story-driven take on games like WarioWare.

 MAKE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP OF MINDSCAPE TOWER.  
 DELVE INTO THE MINDS OF YOUR OPPONENTS.  
 BE CONSUMED BY THE TRUTH THEY SPEAK TO YOU, IN THIS CEREBRAL BATTLE OF SIGHT AND SOUND HIDDEN WITHIN EACH OF US. 
 Climb the Tower
 Blackout City— home to Mindscape Co., creators of the world's most played cognitive reality game: MINDWAVE. A game where players link their brains together and go head-to-head in an onslaught of feelings and memories.
 The time has come for Mindscape Co.'s annual MINDWAVE Tournament, hosted at Mindscape Tower. A young girl named Pandora finds herself with a Platinum Ticket, granting her entry. The only thing standing between her and the large cash prize is several rounds of nonstop mental mayhem.
 Out of Your Shell
 In between rounds of the tournament, you can chat with other contestants. Get to know your opponents, analyze the competition, and maybe make a few friends.
 Mind Over Matter
 In Endless Mode, you can rematch the minds you've endured in Story Mode.
 Survive for as long as you can while the speed, difficulty, and weirdness get cranked up.

Exoborne is an open-world, tactical extraction shooter set in a world torn apart by extreme forces of nature. Customize powerful exo-rigs to gain strategic advantage in ever-changing weather conditions. Face hostile factions, enemy players, and Mother Nature herself in intense high-stakes sessions.

In its aftermath the fury of Mother Nature was unleashed and our society collapsed. Now Tar calls us to uncover the truth and finish the fight. But beware - not everyone can be trusted.

 Since the collapse, the world has been turned to ruin with scarce resources and enemies lurking everywhere. Explore the vast open land of Colton County, scavenging for valuable loot essential for your survival in this hostile environment overtaken by warring factions, enemy players, and extreme forces of nature.

 Earth has changed into an emergent battleground where rules are set by a dynamic weather condition system. Prepare to take on unpredictable tornadoes, lightning strikes, apocalyptic storms and other hazards that will significantly impact your gameplay experience, resulting in no two sessions ever feeling the same.

 Exo-rigs are the ultimate platform of survival. Customize your loadout, use and combine their unique abilities to fit your playstyle and team strategy. As you progress, you'll expand your tactical toolbox with new mods, allowing additional synergies with forces of nature and using them to your advantage. Scavenge, craft, or...

 Live Your Fantasy Dream Life 
 Dive into a world rich with adventure and lore. Complete quests that reveal the secrets of Ancient Humans, deepen your connections with Palia’s Villagers, raise adorable animal companions on your Ranch, and help shape the story around you. 

 Craft, Build, and Make Memories Together 
 Design your ideal space with near limitless possibilities! Craft items, place Building Blocks, and landscape with Yardwork Decor to create a home that’s uniquely yours, both inside and out. Display your creativity and join Home Tours to get inspired by the community's incredible designs. 

 Journey to the Royal Highlands, a Land of Ancient Majesty 
 Step into the Royal Highlands, a sprawling region surrounding the ruins of an ancient palace lost to time. Meet new Villagers, encounter unique flora and fauna, and uncover long-forgotten secrets hidden across these beautiful, sun-kissed lands.

 Saddle Up for New Adventures 
 Meet your very own horse and journey side by side across Palia’s gorgeous landscapes where every mounted adventure becomes faster, farther, and full of possibilities.

 Discover the Secrets of Elderwood, an Ancient Magical Forest
