store.short: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.
store.about:
Embrace the role of an Inquisitor in the grim darkness of the far future in a cRPG set in the rich Warhammer 40,000 universe. Start your service as an acolyte of the Inquisition: Investigate heresy, command a diverse warband, and shape the fate of the Calixis Sector in a story-rich experience where every decision has weight, justice is non-existent, and the line between salvation and damnation is razor-thin. Explore an in-depth depiction of the Inquisition as an organisation and the vast force it commands: its power, bureaucracy, and inner conflicts laid bare like never before. 
 As an Inquisitor, you have one primary goal: to protect the Imperium, whether that be from the taint of xenos, the betrayal of heretics, or the scourge of mutants, by any means necessary. Be the conduit of the Emperor’s will in a place where all hope was lost decades ago, explore the mysteries of the maddening Tyrant Star, and overcome the worst horrors thrown at you by the Noctis Aeterna.

 Your duty is to investigate heresy deep within the Calixis Sector. Your craft is to expose the hidden rot in places where no one else dares to look, to be the final defense of Humanity in the face of annihilation. Uncover nefarious plots, interrogate suspects, and piece together conspiracies in a deep investigative system. The only question is, how far are you willing to go on the path of damnation in the name of salvation?

 Every Inquisitorial warband is unique, and yours is no exception. Ranging from loyal Imperial subjects, such as a veteran Guardsman from the death world of Catachan, to nefarious xenos,...

store.name: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons
store.short: Play as Kaatri in Warlock, a single-player, third-person action-adventure set in a D&D-inspired open world. Wield forbidden magic to bend the rules around you. Across exploration and combat, every challenge is a test of creativity, preparation, and cunning.

store.name: Shift At Midnight
store.short: An online co-op detective horror for up to 3 players. Work together across randomly generated shifts to investigate your customers, as some are only pretending to be human. Make one mistake, and you’ll be forced to board up, set traps, and hide.
store.about:
Managing a gas station is tough work, keep your stock shelves full and sell enough products to meet your quota each night, take deliveries and keep your store nice and clean.
 Oh, and make sure to interrogate each customer as you serve - as some are not human and are in fact doppelgangers – miss one and they will return later that shift to try and kill you and your friends… Execute on site if you think they are not human – just be sure to clean up after.
 If you mess up, be prepared to set traps, barricade the doors and hide as the doppelgangers return as horrible monsters.
 Manage your gas station 
 Stock the shelves, take deliveries, keep your store clean & serve customers. Each shift is randomly generated… meaning no 2 shifts are the same.

 Not all customers are human… 
 Managing a gas station these days also means you have to be a detective… examine their ID, cross-check their details in the computer, and observe their behaviour. Make sure they are human before you let them leave, or they will come back…

 Board Up, Lay Traps and Hide 
 If a creature manages to leave the store, all hell breaks loose. Barricade the doors, place traps, and find a place to hide. Survival is no longer guaranteed.

 Better with friends! 
 Multiplayer is where the game thrives, work together or at least be together… proximity chat enhances the experience.

 Features: 
 Multiplayer

 Proximity chat

 Interrogate customers

 Story Mode with 13 Randomly Generated Shifts

 Gas Station Management

 Character customisation

 Endless Mode (BETA): 
 A free, major ENDLESS MODE update is planned for...

store.name: Toto's Journey
store.short: Toto’s Journey is a cozy adventure inspired by the world of The Wizard of Oz. Play as Toto, a brave dog lost in a magical world after a mysterious cyclone. Explore enchanted lands, meet unusual creatures, and solve environmental puzzles as you search for a way back home.
store.about:
In Toto’s Journey, you play as Toto — a brave and loyal dog who has been swept away into a magical world by a mysterious cyclone. Separated from his owner Dorothy, Toto sets out on a dangerous journey to find his way back home, meeting new allies and uncovering the secrets of this enchanted land along the way. 
 You will explore a variety of unique locations — from dense forests hiding the Lion to mechanical ruins once inhabited by the Tin Woodman. Each area presents its own challenges, combining exploration with environmental storytelling. 
 Along the journey, you will face a range of puzzles that test your logic and creativity. Open new paths, restore broken mechanisms, and interact with light and shadows to progress. With each solved challenge, Toto grows stronger, unlocking new magical abilities that help him overcome obstacles and continue his search for Dorothy. 
 Toto’s Journey is a heartfelt adventure about friendship, discovery, and the desire to return home. Explore a mysterious world, meet unforgettable characters, and uncover its hidden truths.

store.name: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand
store.short: Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day - while battling ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other. Will you be able to hold it together while everything around you falls apart?
store.about:
When Chris David unexpectedly inherits a dilapidated English hotel, he has exactly 30 days and 30 nights to restore the crumbling edifice before it… or something else… claims HIM. 
 Nothing is as it seems in the Grand Hotel, lurking beneath the veneer of paper and paint he applies during the day, something horrible shivers and slithers during the night. Don’t believe them when they tell you that There Are No Ghosts at the Grand . 

 While the daylight lasts, restore the hotel’s faded grandeur by wielding friendly, talking power tools, a sandblaster, paint sprayer, furniture cannon, and daisy-chain gun. When night falls, however, those same tools transform into weapons against the supernatural. Unleash the vacuum on vengeful spirits, expose invisible assailants with the paint sprayer, or subdue slithering spooks with a well-aimed bookcase to the face using the furniture cannon. 

 It's not just the hotel that needs help. Explore the surrounding village to find buildings in need of renovation, and maybe discover a few secrets along the way. You’ll shoot paint and paper onto the walls of the old fish and chip shop, blow out broken windows at the florist, and smash old furniture in the bookshop. At other times, you’ll need to slow down to consider light environmental puzzles, using the hotel’s dark past to unravel cryptic clues. 

 At the heart of the game lies a rich, supernatural mystery – one that winds through the Grand Hotel’s storied history, its former owners, and the player’s own buried past. The hotel and its surrounding village hold more than meets the eye, with...

store.name: Horses of Hoofprint Bay
store.short: Horses of Hoofprint Bay is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D barn buildup and simulation game. Take care of your horses, train them to build up their strength and confidence and compete for prize money! Breed adorable foals, explore beautiful trails, hire and manage staff and build the stable of your dreams!
store.about:
Your very own barn  

 You’ve finally saved up the money to get a plot of land with a run-down shack of a stable – It’s not much but it’s yours. Time for you and your trusted mare to start training, so you can participate in tournaments in the nearby town and grow your ramshackle yard into the stud farm of your dreams!
 Take Care of your Horse(s) 

 Groom and comb your horses in crisp, satisfying care interactions that are grounded in realism without being tedious. Use your brush and hoofpick to avoid saddle sores and abscesses, and treat scrapes and injuries appropriately when they happen. 
 Train, Compete, Explore 

 Complete training exercises and build up your horse’s strength and confidence to qualify for competitions and earn prize money in show jumping and cross country. Take your horses out on trail rides for a change of pace and scenery – Whether it's in the forest, along the beach or through the mountains, you get to enjoy beautiful vistas and you never know what you might find along the way!
 Breed & Evolve 

 Breed adorable foals to improve your stock over time. Foals will inherit a mix of their parents' coloring, white patterns and even personality traits. Carefully plan your stallion and mare pairings to bring out the best in your offspring, whether you’re going for looks or stats.
 Upgrade & Manage  

 Save up for upgrading your buildings to make space for more horses and better meeting their needs. Hire staff to stay on top of care and training for a growing herd. Advanced building stages will unlock new training courses, staff applications and a high tech...

store.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
store.short: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.
store.about:
By the 24th century, humanity has conquered the cosmos. However, life has remained anything but easy. In The Expanse: Osiris Reborn, a story-driven sci-fi Action RPG, you play as a Pinkwater Security mercenary whose brief shore leave on the asteroid Eros spirals out of control. Trapped in a deadly lockdown and drawn into a solar system-wide conspiracy far beyond your control, you’ll have to adapt, survive, taking command of the most advanced ship in the whole of the solar system.
 Create and customize your own captain — Earther, Martian, or Belter — and lead a crew of highly-skilled specialists as you face off against escalating threats, political pressure, and a relentless enemy that will stop at nothing to see you dead. In a solar system held together by fragile alliances, every decision leaves its mark. 

 Your companions are more than just mission assets — they are people with their own scars and loyalties. Some chase redemption. Others hide their truths. Over time, your relationships will flourish or deteriorate depending on the choices you make and how you choose to lead. The ship becomes your home — a place where trust is earned, not given.

 Fight in third-person utilizing cover-focused gunplay and abilities. Two companions will accompany you into the field while others will support from a distance: disabling systems or drawing the enemies’ attention. You will issue real-time commands and have to adapt quickly to survive the manifold threats the system will throw at you.

 Visit iconic locations like Ganymede, Ceres, Mars, and Luna. Walk through ruined habitats and...

store.name: Kaiju Cleanup
store.short: Relax and unwind by cleaning up the world’s biggest corpses either solo or co-op. In a Cleaning Sim like no other, your job is to slice up and tidy away Kaiju carcasses, leaving the city clean and serene. Until the next Kaiju attack, obviously.
store.about:
When colossal alien titans run rampant until getting domed by a railgun, the world finds itself in need of a true hero. That’s you: a Kaiju Cleaner who won’t be perturbed by petty concerns like “workplace injury” or “life expectancy”.

 After another bastard Kaiju attacks another crowded city, you must use your tools to clean up vast piles of dead monster until the zone is safe for reconstruction. The Kaiju may be dead, but its corpse is leaking radiation, seeping acidic fluids, concealing explosive organs, and generally making the area inhospitable to any other form of life. You’ll probably die as you go about your work, but that’s fine; send another clone, mop up your corpse, and carry on.

 When dealing with Kaiju this big, the detritus warrants calling in a team. Up to 4 cleaners can tackle the monstrous mess left behind via online co-op.

 Enjoy therapeutic tasks with your own methodology and a selection of helpful tools. Work at your own pace; that giant corpse isn’t going anywhere. Extract and launch Kaiju innards with a meat-wrenching claw, slice them into manageable chunks, slurp up its various jellies, and power-wash detritus until the hazard zone is sparkling clean.

 Turn KaijuCorp from a scrappy band of outcasts and delinquents into Earth’s best Kaiju Cleanup firm either solo or as part of a team of up to four reprobates. Complete missions to upgrade your equipment and customize your base, van, and outfit.

 Explore environments the Kaiju have rudely died in and figure out what they have against skyscrapers anyway. Pick apart audio logs, chat with your crew,...

copies.name: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals

store.name: Guns of Eschaton
store.short: This soulslike FPS pulls you into an apocalyptic Western by the legendary Viktor Antonov: a land of dust, blood, and horror. Study your enemies, count your bullets, forge your own style with gunpowder and prayers. Solo or in co-op—go West, gunslinger, go West and die with the country!
store.about:
The Old South is burning, but its legends are not quite (un)dead.
 Guns of Eschaton is a first-person soulslike shooter set in an apocalyptic Western by legendary art director Viktor Antonov (Half-Life 2, Dishonored, Prey, Fallout 4, Wolfenstein: The New Order). It is a land of dust, blood, false saints, broken history, and occult horror—a wasteland where the road to salvation is narrow and paved with spent shells and bodies that remember your name.

 You are almost ordinary: fragile, outmatched, and surrounded by a dying world full of monsters.
 However, you have everything you need to survive the horrors of the burning world: a Colt, the instincts of a killer, and the will to make it home, no matter how long the road becomes.
 This is not a fast-paced shooter where victory comes from reflexes alone. Every bullet matters. Every gun has its own character. Every monster has a weakness. 
 You cannot rely on old shooter instincts—you will have to learn how to shoot all over again.
 Study your enemies. Identify their weaknesses. Commit to every action with intent. Surviving this frontier takes more than just a steady aim: adapt your tactics with different bullet types, calculated parries and dashes, mystic abilities granted through occult means, and anything else you can find to keep yourself alive.
 And when the road becomes too arduous to walk alone—call your posse.

 This is a personal journey through a world-scale catastrophe.
 You are a man who has lost almost everything, trying to return home before the last scraps are taken from him. The road ahead runs across the Old...

store.name: Danganronpa 2x2
store.short: While on a school trip to Jabberwock Island, students are ensnared in Monokuma’s deadly game, forced into mutual killing and Class Trials to expose the culprit. Break through contradictions with high-speed detective action. Includes both a brand-new scenario and the enhanced original!
store.about:
Jabberwock Island—once a bustling tourist hotspot, now an uninhabited island that remains strangely well-kept.
 You and your classmates from Hope’s Peak Academy visit this island for a school trip, but the pleasant getaway is short-lived. Monokuma’s scheme forces everyone into yet another deadly game. As the curtain rises on a new cycle of mutual killing, the only path to escape lies in uncovering the island’s secrets.
 But remember: what awaits at the end of the truth is not always hope...
 <Game Overview>
 Investigate murders by gathering testimonies and evidence, then identify the "Blackened" during the Class Trial. Debate with your classmates in high-speed detective action as you shoot through contradictions using Truth Bullets. Trials feature voice acting by a celebrated cast.
 Each case is divided into three primary parts:
 ■ Daily Life
 Explore Jabberwock Island freely and interact with the Ultimate Students. When a murder occurs and a body is discovered, the game transitions into the Investigation phase.
 ■ Investigation
 Examine crime scenes, interview other students, and collect the evidence needed to crack the case. The clues you find become Truth Bullets used to refute contradictory statements. Once all evidence is gathered, the Class Trial begins.
 ■ Class Trial
 Use the evidence you’ve collected to expose the "Blackened". Students debate the case from various angles, and their statements flow across the screen in real time. Fire the appropriate Truth Bullets to break through contradictions and advance the debate. Unravel the case’s truth in nonstop,...

store.name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
store.short: The iconic solo pirate adventure returns. Sail the Caribbean as Edward Kenway during the Golden Age of Piracy in this faithfully enhanced remake featuring stunning visuals, upgraded gameplay, and new content.
store.about:
Strike fear in your foes as you board and sink enemy vessels as Edward Kenway, captain of the Jackdaw. Whether blending into crowds or leading daring assaults, switch between silent takedowns and fierce brawls as you effortlessly wield swords, pistols, and the Hidden Blade. With a cast of historical pirate legends at your side, defy empires amidst the age-old conflict opposing Assassins and Templars.

Combat has been rebuilt for more dynamic encounters, emphasizing parries and takedowns, while stealth and parkour have been improved for smoother escapes and assassinations. Continuously upgrade the Jackdaw to face powerful enemy ships with enhanced naval mechanics featuring new alternate fire modes. Quality-of-life additions also address previous pain points, ensuring your experience is improved.

Whether you’re sailing the open seas or journeying across untamed lands, discover a seamless open world built with the latest Anvil engine. Take in sweeping vistas as you brave stormy waters, dive into underwater shipwrecks, or push through dense tropical jungles. Enhanced by features such as Dolby Atmos and ray tracing, every scene feels more immersive, bringing the world’s beauty to life.

Building on top of the original story, Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced introduces exclusive new content. Familiar faces will return, with new storylines dedicated to fan-favorite characters such as Blackbeard and Stede Bonnet. Unexpected allies will also cross your path, as three officers join you on your journey as part of the main narrative. More surprises await such as new sea shanties,...

store.name: Tale's Edge
store.short: Tale's Edge is a dark fairytale action-RPG set in a shared world of fables from the Brothers Grimm. You play as Red Riding Hood 8 years after her tale, searching for the Huntsman who raised her. Every choice shapes who you become, and the world learns from how you play.
store.about:
Survive an ancient, unforgiving world based on the original dark fairy tales of the Brother’s Grimm. Outmatched and alone, your wits become your greatest ally. 
 You play as Red Riding Hood, 8 years after her original tale, raised by the Huntsman who cut her from the wolf. When he leaves one morning and does not return, Red sets out on an epic journey to find him.

 Discover an incredible cast of characters, villains, and creatures where factions shift, NPCs remember, and events unfold with or without you. How you play, interact, and survive encounters changes their behaviors. Some may be grateful. Others may seek revenge.

 Whether you choose to end the lives of defeated enemies or spare them, it shapes who Red becomes and how her character plays. Players who fight with honor will grow to become a dangerous hero, while players who kill mercilessly will literally watch Red’s attacks and behaviors become more violent and savage as she descends into darkness.

 Explore a dense world with metroidvania-like exploration, rich stories, and immersive environments that reward player curiosity. Branching narratives with multiple solutions create new challenges based on how you choose to play.
 Customize your gear, abilities, and evolve your playstyle through a unique progression system. Whether you favor stealth, combat, or crafting, every build influences Red’s path.

 Early in the game, Red receives a mysterious amulet from the Fairy Godmother to protect her from lethal damage. As you progress, the amulet reveals new abilities. Connect threads between characters and objects to...

store.name: Of Peaks and Tides
store.short: Step onto this vast ancient land shaped by intuitive physics, and form a new world born of your imagination. Explore solo or team up online with friends. Reforge the mortal realm devastated by divine wrath. Feel the world shift with your every move. Your lands await. Will you answer?
store.about:
The ancient spark has not yet faded. Whispers echo through the mountains and seas, stirring memories long buried in the earth. Of Peaks and Tides is an Open-world Crafting Survival game developed by CyancookGames, weaving Eastern Mythology into a vast, living world.Powered by an intuitive physics system, the world responds to your every touch. Gather your friends, and shape your own legend in a land where creation knows no bounds.

 Everything reacts. Everything can be a resource. Emergent gameplay lets your choices spark unexpected consequences. From chaos come opportunities. Shifting seasons, unpredictable weather, and calamities demand smart, responsive choices. Build wisely, read the skies, and turn disasters into power. The world lives, and you will shape it by your will.

 Faced with a powerful enemy, will you charge head-on with sheer skills? Or leverage the environment to strike unexpectedly?Will you set fire, flood the battlefield, lay traps, or stir their hatred to turn enemies against each other in chaos?There is no "correct answer" — only your unique path to victory.Break the rules! Define your legend!

 One journey, countless paths. Your choices shape the world.From surviving the wilds to reviving civilization, from brittle twigs and scattered stones to roaring engines of war—this long-silent land shall once again witness the epic rise of humankind, forged by your hands.With a stone axe in hand, you will fell trees for palisades, stack stones into walls, and raise an unyielding stronghold beneath the shadow of calamity and colossal beasts.What you build is...

store.name: Death at Fleming Manor
store.short: "Your job is to write the death certificate." Investigate a mysterious death in a British manor in 1959. Explore eerie scenes, analyze evidence, and complete death certificates and emergency reports. A forensic mystery with art inspired by 1960s European detective comics.
store.about:
Over 120,000 wishlists before launch!

 Taipei Game Show 2027 – Best Design Finalist

 Media Reviews 
 "Death at Fleming Manor is overwhelmingly a love letter to some of the OG detective writers." — Grace Dean, The Wand Report (8/10) 
 "An excellent indie game that beautifully succeeds in its unique approach of blending forensics with a thriller mystery adventure." — 쿠타르크, This Is Game (8.4/10) 
 "Experience the satisfying feeling of being outwitted, just like in a classic mystery novel." — 本丸猫左衛門, 4Gamer 
 "Murderously Good. Between the clever deductions, varied investigations and unexpected twists, Death at Fleming Manor had me hooked." — Sonia Heng, QuestDaily (9/10) 
 "A unique art style and smart ideas that expand on the concept of playing as a coroner." — James Gregory, Play Save Repeat (8/10) 

 If you unraveled Return of the Obra Dinn and The Case of the Golden Idol to the very end... 
 It is time to pick up your pen. 
 Your job is to write the death certificate. 

 England, 1959 
 A series of unexplained deaths has occurred at Fleming Manor, a country estate outside London.
 As the investigator assigned to the cases, you will examine each scene, study the condition of the body, question the people involved, and review the available evidence. You must identify the victim, determine the cause of death, and decide whether the death was accidental, self-inflicted, or the result of murder. 

 When you believe you understand what happened, record your conclusions in a death certificate or emergency report. Choosing a suspect is not enough. Missing or incorrect...

store.name: Kick
store.short: Kick is a nostalgic tale of making your way to school, all the while honing your soccer skills throughout challenging levels packed with unique challenges. Do you have what it takes to Kick it?

store.name: Resident Evil Requiem
store.short: Requiem for the dead. Nightmare for the living. Prepare to escape death in a heart-stopping experience that will chill you to your core.
store.about:
Requiem for the dead. Nightmare for the living.

A new era of survival horror arrives with Resident Evil Requiem, the latest and most immersive entry yet in the iconic Resident Evil series. Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core. Raccoon City

Return once again to the city of disaster and despair.
A midwestern city in the United States and the headquarters for the former global pharmaceutical company, Umbrella.
In the face of the zombie outbreak in 1998, the government approved a sterilization operation, a missile strike on the city in an attempt to quickly bring the situation under control—but this was swiftly covered up.
 Grace Ashcroft

An intelligence analyst for the FBI who demonstrates intense focus and insight in deductive reasoning and analysis. Her mother's death shook her to the soul, making her an introvert who immerses herself in work. So she heads to the abandoned hotel alone to investigate this mysterious death.
 Leon S. Kennedy

One of the survivors of the Raccoon City Incident. With a strong sense of justice and physical capabilities to match, he has responded to numerous outbreaks since that fateful day. Now, as a seasoned DSO agent combatting bioterrorism, he has returned to investigate the latest string of deaths in the Midwest.
 Gameplay

Experience the series' classic survival horror through combat,...

store.name: Car For Sale Together
store.short: Car For Sale Together is a co-op car trading simulation where you and your friends build a dealership from scratch. Explore the town, find cars, negotiate deals, complete side activities, uncover mysteries, and grow your shared business together.
store.about:
Start Your Automotive Journey 
 Car For Sale Together is an online car trading simulation that brings together exploration, story-driven elements, and free-form gameplay as you and your friends build a car dealership from scratch. The story begins with an unexpected opportunity from your uncle: running a small car dealership in a town full of hidden opportunities. At the start, you only have a limited budget, a few chances, and big ambitions. But this journey is about much more than simply buying and selling cars. As you explore different areas of the town, you will encounter new opportunities, discover hidden locations across the map, and find yourself involved in unexpected events. Around every corner, there may be a new story, a new deal, or an unexpected adventure waiting for you.

 Explore the Town 
 Exploration is an important part of the experience. The map includes special locations you will need to reach, areas waiting to be discovered, and unique places that open the door to new activities and opportunities. During this journey, you will not only focus on trading but also on exploring the world around you, uncovering new possibilities and finding different ways to grow your business. The game world is designed to give players the freedom to move around, visit the places that spark their curiosity, and create their own stories.

 Repair, Customize and Upgrade 
 The vehicles you purchase can be worked on in detail. You can repair mechanical issues, customize performance and appearance through the tuning system, and increase a car’s value with washing and painting....

store.name: Animula Nook
store.short: Shrink down and reimagine your desk as a whimsical world in Animula Nook, a cozy miniature life sim. Craft your homes from odds and ends, grow giant crops, style your OOTD, and explore the enchanting Wupa Woods. Just remember, Minies are always by your side.
store.about:
Shrink down and reimagine your desk as a whimsical world in Animula Nook, a cozy miniature life sim. Craft your homes from odds and ends, grow giant crops, style your OOTD, and explore the enchanting Wupa Woods. Just remember, Minies are always by your side.
 Use your shrink gun to miniaturize desk clutter into building materials! Craft a house from chocolate bars, turn a glasses case into a sofa, or make rooftops from bottle caps. Everything in Starside Homestead is yours to create—what will you make next?
 Bloom your balcony into a lush planting paradise. Plant tiny seeds and watch them grow into giant roses. And when you’re tired, just let the petals hold you gently.

 Choose your OOTD to kickstart a brand-new day, and dress up Minies and friends in outfits you’ve prepared for them. Every new look is a little spark of joy you share with Minietopia.

 Grab Wupa’s tail and journey through the enchanting Wupa Woods, discovering the vibrant Floral Sea and the mysterious Tunnel in the Woods. Bottle the sun, brew the dew, and pluck the lucky four-leaf clover to let its fortune guide your path.
 Meet unique Minies, invite them home, and share a life filled with music, dance, and laughter. With 8 instruments to play, you can form a little band and let melodies weave your moments together—the best memories are the ones you share.

store.name: Embers of the Uncrowned
store.short: Embers of the Uncrowned is a dark fantasy MMORPG where fast-paced, satisfying isometric view combat meets brutal, gory visuals. In an epic tale drenched in human blood at the hands of elven invaders, embark on a journey to reignite the house's last ember of hope.

Born illegitimate, you left home to become a mercenary, only to find that destiny has called you back. Now, as the rightful lord, you must reclaim your lost domain and rebuild your house. Fight back against the corrupted creatures and elven forces that plague the continent.

 Victory is not won by strength alone. Your skill and strategic judgement will determine the outcome of every battle. Master unique classes and dominate the battlefield with the help of your trusted companions.
 Unique Classes: Choose your path. The Spectral Blade carves through her foes using her longsword and swift swordsmanship. The Executioner annihilates his enemies with a single crushing blow from his giant axe. The Stormbringer calls down the storm's fury, striking her enemies with powerful wind and lightning magic.
Each class offers unique skills and attributes, allowing you to create diverse combat styles and experiment with different skill trees.

 Loyal Companions: You are not alone in your fight. Your companions will always stand by your side. Recruit them, grow stronger together, and create powerful synergies to bolster your forces.

 Some enemies are too powerful to be faced alone. Band together with other players to defeat the colossal threats plaguing the land and obtain valuable rewards.
 Domain Bosses: Join forces with other players to reclaim your land from the mighty bosses that occupy them....

store.name: 007 First Light
store.short: Earn the Number. 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training programme, and discover an origin story of the world’s most famous spy.
store.about:
Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training program, and discover an origin story of the world’s most famous spy.

 After a heroic act, young Naval air crewman James Bond is offered to join the newly revived Double 0 program. But when a mission to stop a rogue agent ends in tragedy, he must join forces with his reluctant mentor Greenway to expose a deep conspiracy and stop a looming coup at the heart of the State.

store.name: Celeste Blue Wizard Luna

 In a faraway, skyborne land...

 Perched high above the surface realms lies the lovely floating continent of Jupiterno. Princess Lucia, hailed as a "True Wizard," rules in the king’s stead.

 A True Wizard’s power far surpasses that of ordinary wizards. If the average wizard is an ant, a True Wizard is the queen ant—possessing innate magic that operates on an entirely different scale.

 Princess Lucia, a rare prodigy said to appear only once among billions, wields an almost divine might. Yet when her heart grows dark, she imposes tyranny across the land, slaughtering anyone who dares defy her.

 Amid this reign of terror, Luna—celebrated as one of the most brilliant wizards in all of Jupiterno—finally decides to confront Lucia. Encouraged by her allies, Luna takes a stand against the dreaded True Wizard.

 To bring down Princess Lucia and her allied nations, Luna and her companions form a resistance, vowing to challenge the royal capital head-on!

 A JRPG from veteran doujin creators

 Turn-based combat

 An expansive world

 10+ hours of story

 CHARACTERS

 Luna 
 Rima Nemurine 
 A top-tier wizard in Jupiterno, Luna was poised to graduate head of her class at the elite Valentina Magic Academy before unforeseen circumstances forced her to leave. Recruited by Becky, an axe-wielding housewife from the same village, she joins the resistance to take down Princess Lucia—a tyrant who recognizes Luna's exceptional abilities. Alongside her revolutionary efforts, Luna harbors a deep affection for Noah, her childhood friend.

store.name: Killer Aces Volleyball

Kill the competition in this thrilling, 6v6 indoor volleyball game, built for players craving all the fast paced action and strategic depth the sport has to offer!

Streamlined controls are intuitive for new players while offering the layered, strategic depth savvy veterans will need to dominate from pin to pin! Edition includes:
 MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls

Assemble your team of legendary Marvel characters in the ultimate 4v4 tag team fighter from PlayStation Studios, Arc System Works and Marvel Games.

It’s time to build your dream team and break some spirits in blistering 4v4 fighting action. Choose from an expanding roster of 20 iconic Marvel characters at launch, each rendered in a bold new anime-inspired art style and members of their own unique teams of equally impressive heroes and villains.

store.name: Atomic Heart 2
store.short: The Atomic Heart sequel brings you back to the retrofuturistic universe, full of new characters and dangers. The game immerses you in events on a global scale and raises the bar for what an open-world action RPG can do.
store.about:
Atomic Heart 2 is an action-adventure role-playing game set in a living world, rich with possibilities and a heavy emphasis on the story, role-playing elements, and player freedom. The sequel to Atomic Heart relates new events unfolding in the retrofuturistic universe of an alternate history. This time, the action takes place on a global scale.

 Get ready for dangerous new adventures that will redefine the gameplay experience and raise the bar for the genre's capabilities!

 Dystopia and retrofuturism with realistic graphics.

 An expanded RPG system allows you to immerse yourself in the living game world full of various activities.

 A continuation of the story with an enthralling plot brimming with mysteries and high stakes. Our beloved characters return, while new ones help reveal a different side of the game world.

 The re-engineered and enhanced combat system lets you use both hands at once. Glove abilities can be combined with various melee and ranged weapons.

 Return to the magnificent world of science and technology, and find out what the next chapter has in store for you!

store.name: Abyssal Lapidary
store.short: A gothic management sim set in a Victorian-inspired underground metropolis. Appraise raw ores, cut exquisite gems, and craft unique jewelry for strange clients. Some stones are worth a fortune. Others stare back.
store.about:
Beneath the underground city of Fathomholm, the stones are alive.
 Inherit the declining Vermilion House and work as a lapidary in a Victorian world of strange minerals, forgotten memories, and abyssal horrors. Appraise raw ore, cut precise facets, and craft exquisite jewelry while uncovering the secrets buried deep beneath the city.
 Some stones are worth a fortune. 

 Others stare back. 

 Master the Craft 
 Examine rough minerals, remove impurities, carve intricate facets, and transform raw ore into precious gemstones.
 Every mineral behaves differently. Every cut matters. 

 Craft for the Stranger 
 Set polished gems into jewelleries for the mysterious citizens of Fathomholm.
 The higher your reputation climbs, the stranger your clients become. 

 Touch the Abyss 
 Certain minerals should never have been unearthed. 
 Crimson veins pulse beneath the stone. Impossible flowers bloom from solid rock. Some ores seem to breathe beneath your tools.
 The longer you work, the sharper your perception grows.
And with it, so do the hallucinations.
 Shapes begin appearing inside the stone.
Whispers echo through empty rooms.
Something waits within the dark.

 Explore the Vermilion House 
 Hidden passages, sealed chambers, forgotten ledgers, and a room that beats like a living heart...
 Piece together the truth behind the Vermilion House and the crime buried within its walls.
 The deeper you carve, the more the abyss reveals.

store.name: Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake
store.short: Rediscover the critically acclaimed turn-based strategy classic and its two expansions, faithfully rebuilt in full 3D and 4K. Explore a vibrant fantasy world and lead mighty heroes in epic battles.

Rediscover the most popular and critically acclaimed Heroes of Might and Magic title, along with its two expansions, in this stunning remake of the turn-based strategy classic.

Choose from nine distinct factions, each with its own unique playstyle and fantastical creatures. Explore the world, secure resources and artifacts, expand your towns, and shape heroes and armies for endless tactical gameplay.

Experience the original campaigns as one unified story, enhanced with a new prologue, epilogue, and cinematic scenes.

Face up to eight players online or compete locally in turn-based matches where alliances shift and rivalries form.

Play community maps from day one, or create your own. Use editing tools that let you adjust balance and design maps or campaigns.

store.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs

Talk to customers, hear their stories, and see how your decisions impact both their lives and your shop.
store.about:
ReStory is a chill, narrative-driven shop management simulator from the creators of I Am Future, set on the bustling streets of mid-2000s Tokyo and featuring an in-depth device repair system. 
 In this game, you run an electronics repair shop, meticulously restore nostalgic Y2K-era devices, including officially licensed Atari consoles, and interact with customers to experience a branching storyline with multiple endings that depend on your choices.

 Greet customers, take their devices in for repairs, manage your finances, and surf the web for spare parts. Relax and enjoy running your own small shop in a game created with love and respect for the one-of-a-kind vibe of the Japanese urban life in the mid-2000s.

 Fix a variety of nostalgic devices inspired by iconic game consoles, handhelds, phones, cameras, music players, and home appliances. Carefully take each gadget apart, clean it, replace faulty parts, and assemble it back together using your trusty toolset.

 The way you interact with each customer can change their lives forever. Will you report on a disturbing find inside the former gangster’s phone, or help a lovestruck student confess to his crush? Make your own choices and see how they impact the branching storyline.
 Key Features 
 Relaxing electronics repair shop management

 A wide range of nostalgic 2000s devices to repair

 In-depth device cleaning and restoration system

 Y2K-era web browser to hunt for spare parts

 A variety of in-person and online orders to fulfill

 Multiple tools for device repairs

store.name: 组长！怨念请查收！
store.short: 玩家将扮演一位刻薄的组长，从危险重重受到诅咒的公司里逃脱。在这里，不仅要躲避危险想办法完成10个“愿望”，还得小心那些针对你的、出乎意料的陷阱。

《组长！怨念请查收！》 
 是一款轻松像素探索解谜游戏，含有少量的血腥表现和大量黑色幽默。

 【剧情介绍】
 你是自命不凡待人刻薄的组长。你从不觉得自己有错，不过你的下属们可能并不这样想……
 终于，这帮“牛马”的怨气将你卷进了公司的异空间！
 公司吉祥物「吉宝」告诉你为了离开这里，就得完成10个下属怨念体的愿望，不可一世的你不得不去做一些平时绝对不愿意做的事情……！
 是忍气吞声地出尽洋相，还是……另想他法？ 

 【主要人物介绍】

 李拜天 
 以自己为中心的刻薄组长，本作主人公。
 他就是传说中「领导我奶奶死了要请假。」然后他会回复「关我什么事?」的那种人。
 认为自己能做到的事情别人做不到就是在偷懒，也认为自己比大部分人都要优秀。
 出现问题的时候不会从自己身上找原因，不喜欢替别人着想。
 不过对于工作倒也绝对是认真的，认真到不近人情。

 吉宝 
 自称是公司的智能AI，来帮助李拜天逃出被诅咒的公司。
 说话很聒噪，但是似乎对李拜天抱有百分百的敬仰态度。
 可以生成一些预测图片来回避危险，也会提供灵魂保存的服务。

 【背景介绍】

 神愈康奇保健公司 
 是一家主要以研发各类正经（？）保健品，并进行保健品贩卖的公司 。

 【特色介绍】
 *富有个性的人物立绘

 *扮演让人讨厌的上司的独特体验

 *大部分谜题有多种解决办法。

 *丰富的cg与意想不到的陷阱

 【游戏时长】
 预计4-5小时
 【游戏结局】
 3个
 【其他信息】
 制作：神经传达室x鸬鹚鱼塘
 b站：神经传达室、鸬鹚鱼塘制作组
 资讯群：718808444

Get to know the Masters that hone their craft. From legendary tuners, to street-racing legends. The art of Vector Racing is a unforgiving one.

store.name: DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Complete Edition Remastered
store.short: A warrior worth a thousand reforged. A remake of DYNASTY WARRIORS 3 and DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends with modern graphics and even more thrilling action.
store.about:
A striking revival of DYNASTY WARRIORS 3 and DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends, which established the foundation of the entire series. The complete cast of more than 40 officers and numerous battlefields beautifully recreated using Unreal Engine 5. Experience even more enjoyable and thrilling action as you aim for the peak of 1 vs. 1,000! About DYNASTY WARRIORS 3
Play as more than 40 different officers in the world of the Three Kingdoms, taking on thrilling and tactical battles of 1 vs. 1,000 on vast battlefields. "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3" was the first game in the "DYNASTY WARRIORS" series to feature mechanics that would become a mainstay for the series, such as True Musou Attacks, two-player simultaneous play, and the officer development system. It was also the first game in the series to sell more than one million copies.
The "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends" expansion featured new stories for seven officers, including Lu Bu, Meng Huo, and Yuan Shao, as well as bodyguard customization, new weapons, and four types of challenge modes, providing even more gameplay to enjoy. PC Version Features:

- Fully customizable mouse and keyboard controls. The following are supported based on hardware specifications:
- 4K Ultra-HD
- Ultrawide Monitors
- Multiple upscaling features
- HDR

store.name: Wild n Chill
store.short: Wild n Chill is a laid-back wilderness escape where ya forage, hunt, and craft the off-grid cabin of your dreams. Far from the noise and nonsense, it’s just you, your trusty companion, and a pal or two.
store.about:
Wild n Chill’s a cozy wilderness survival game for folks who’d rather build a cabin than fight over one, solo or with a few good pals by your side. From the makers of Cast n Chill, this time you step onto land to hunt, fish, trap, gather and craft your way through the wild - all while keepin’ your belly full, your firewood dry, and the wolves outta camp.
 Whether you’re throwin’ together a leaky little lean-to or buildin’ the finest dang cabin this side o’ Blackbear Hollow, life out here moves at your pace.
 Survive the Wild
 Keep an eye on your food, water, and energy while livin’ off the land. Catch fish, gather berries, chop wood, set traps, and hunt for supper while the wilderness tries its best to keep ya humble.
 Most critters’ll leave ya be... but bears and wolves ain’t exactly known for their manners. 
 Meet the Locals
 There’s a couple strange ol’ hermits livin’ deep in the wilderness. Friendly enough... once they stop starin’ at ya.
 Bring ‘em the right supplies and they might just trade ya somethin’ special.

 Play Solo or With Ya Pals
 Grab a few buddies and build a life together in online co-op for up to 4 players.
 Split up the chores however ya like. One friend hunts while another fishes, someone gathers firewood, and the fella who “knows carpentry” accidentally puts the window in backwards again.

 Build Yer Dream Cabin
 Start with nothin’ but cold hands and bad ideas, then slowly turn the wilderness into home sweet home.
 Craft shelters, cabins, smokehouses, wood sheds, traps, food stores, hunting hides and more. Discover new buildin’ styles as ya explore...

store.name: About Fishing
store.short: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.
store.about:
About Fishing is a fishing mystery game that blends the calm, meditative rhythm of fishing with the quiet tension of discovery. It drifts between serenity and unease, as every catch brings you closer to uncovering what lies beneath.

 FISHING IS EVERYTHING

 Each catch feels distinct, with its own patterns and behaviors waiting to be learned. Cast your line, trade your catch, upgrade your gear and explore new depths.

 FISHING FOR CLUES

 Every cast is a chance to uncover something unexpected. The fish you catch become your guides, helping you reach fragments of a long-forgotten mystery hidden beneath the surface. You can lose yourself in the calm of fishing or follow the clues the water offers.

 A PLACE WHERE YOU BELONG

 The world around you moves with time and weather. Fish linger beneath the surface, people follow quiet routines, and the town changes with each passing day. Each person you meet carries their own memories and small joys. Their lives unfold around you, drawing you closer to the peace of a place that slowly begins to feel like home.

 About Fishing is developed by Kevin (The Water Museum), creator of Arctic Eggs. Made out of love for Shenmue and Sega Bass Fishing
 Artist: Angel Perez Guzman Composer: Cameron Ginex

 IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER: 
 No fish were harmed in the making of About Fishing. Can’t say the same for the curly fries.

store.name: Football Manager: Auto Chess

store.about:

Read the situation and drag Coach Skill Cards onto specific areas or players to trigger pressing, forward runs, quick counterattacks, and more. Time slows while dragging a card, giving you a moment to read the field before making your move.

Grassroots village players, Tang Dynasty poets, heroes of Liangshan, Three Kingdoms warlords, Knights of the Round Table, Vikings, and wuxia legends can all join your team. Recruit, train, and rotate players, then build lineups around their traits and synergies to create a team truly your own. 

 Away from the pitch, you'll manage the club's daily schedule. Train players at the training grounds, recruit and socialize in the reception hall, handle club affairs in the administration building, and prepare for the next match. As the season progresses, lead your team from the lowest leagues toward bigger stages. 

 Life at the club is just as exciting off the pitch!
Enjoy a variety of fun and relaxing activities with your players, such as playing cards and trying your luck with scratch-off lottery tickets. Beyond tactical planning and competitive matches, the game offers plenty of everyday activities that make managing your club even more lively and entertaining. 

 Club management × near-real-time auto-battler matches

 Drag-and-drop Coach Skill Cards that directly influence the match

 Collect players across eras and cultures to build unique squads

Welcome to the world of the ultimate wheeler-dealer, master of quick fixes and king of car lot hustle!
 You run your own used car lot on the edge of nowhere. Buy for pennies, sell for dollars, and let smooth talk and carefully retouched photos seal the deal.

 Keeps working while you're away

The world is a wild ocean, filled with monsters and danger. After a betrayal, a young King awakens an ancient Leviathan - a living island capable of carrying an entire city. Together, they must build a kingdom, travel between islands, and face the horrors rising from the mist. 
 TWO PLAYERS, TWO PLAYSTYLES

The other player, as the King, acts on the ground with a third person isometric view. The King fights enemies, gathers resources, listens to villagers' needs. 
 ASYMMETRIC CO-OP 
 Two players share one goal, but have different roles. The Fish sees the full picture, manages the city layout, production, and incoming threats. The King acts on the ground and sees what the Fish can’t spot, the details: villagers’ needs, nearby dangers, the fight itself. Coordination between the King and the Fish is key. 

 UNIQUE VILLAGERS 
 Every villager in the KingFish is unique, with their own perks, weapons and preferences. The unique abilities of the villagers are a cornerstone of both the kingdom's defense and its economy. Level up and equip your villagers to turn them into powerful warriors or skilled artisans.

Explore the lands, discover rare artifacts, and fight alone or with a group — in Dark Craft, your path is defined by your choices and your ability to endure in a harsh world.

 A World Shaped by Game Masters
 The world of Dark Craft lives independently: enemies patrol territories, locations breathe dark-fantasy atmosphere, and events unfold regardless of player actions. But above all this operates a unique layer — a system controlled by our game masters, members of the team who can directly intervene in gameplay. They can command enemies and set up unexpected ambushes, appear in the form of world bosses, issue unique quests, or trigger events that will never happen again. This creates the feeling of a truly living world, where every adventure is unpredictable and one-of-a-kind.

 Gameplay
 Each venture into the world is a true trial for the player. Expect grim locations filled with deadly enemies, hidden dangers, and other hunters chasing after artifacts. Combat is built around timing, stamina management, and the ability to predict your opponent’s moves.
