store.name: EA SPORTS™ College Football 27
store.short: Step into the modern era of college football, where personal ambition meets program pride. Balance expectations, identity, and everything Saturday demands while immersed in traditions and pageantry of game day.
store.about:
In EA SPORTS™ College Football 27, step into the modern era of college football where personal ambition meets program pride. Engineer your program with Dynasty Blueprint, build your player and take on new positions in Road to Glory, and play as your favorite mascots in Mascot Mashup while immersed in the iconic traditions and pageantry of game day.

 DYNASTY 

All-new Dynasty Blueprint puts you in control of your program’s future. Navigate Athletic Director Expectations and use Dynasty Points for recruiting, NIL, staff, and facilities to build your College Football powerhouse.

 ROAD TO GLORY 

Define your path in Road to Glory, and experience new customization options and positions as you build your player. Earn NIL deals, chase the Heisman, develop your Draft Stock, and raise your Legacy Score with each decision you make.

 MASCOT MASHUP 

Play as your favorite mascot in Mascot Mashup. Collect over 120 larger-than-life icons, and bring the chaos to wild 11-on-11 matchups packed with over-the-top celebrations and mascot antics fueled by pure school spirit.

 STORYTELLING & PRESENTATION 

Feel every moment of game day, and experience college football at its height. Dynamic weather, expanded pageantry, and a new broadcast package delivers deeper immersion as dynamic storytelling connects your journey to the sights, sounds, and stakes of Saturday.

 GAMEPLAY 

Turn every touch into a highlight. Feel the difference of standout athletes impacting every play, from smarter route running and coverage to explosive WR vs. DB battles, while more streamlined, customizable pre-play...

store.name: Drawquarium
store.short: Draw your very own fish and build a cozy little aquarium. And if you like, set it as your animated desktop wallpaper! Watch your drawings come to life. Feed them, raise them and collect golden scales to unlock new decorations. There's also some handy tools to help you focus and unwind.
store.about:
Hi, I'm Kaleb! I work as a 3D artist in the film industry, but my heart kept pulling me toward a small, very personal game idea. One of the reasons I started developing this game was that I wanted to bring my children’s drawings to life 💖. 

 Drawquarium is a relaxing aquarium sandbox where your drawings come to life! Draw your own fish and plants, feed them, raise them, and collect golden fish scales to unlock new decorations and tools. Create your own cozy little underwater world and bring it to your desktop as an animated wallpaper!

 And don't worry, you don't have to be an artist to create something beautiful! You can always choose from a variety of ready-made fish and simply enjoy watching your little aquarium come to life. 

 Draw Your Own Fish COMPANIONS 
 Draw anything you want and watch your creations come to life inside your aquarium. Start with simple shapes, use templates for a little inspiration, or get as creative as you like. There are no rules, just you and your imagination!

 When you place new creatures in your fish tank, they will interact with the others, forming friendships, rivalries and even relationships. They can become enemies and quibble or find their soulmate and have cute little babies 🥰.

 Decorate With Your Own Plants 
 Any decent aquarium will need an abundance of thriving plants. Create the perfect habitat by drawing your own vegetation and placing it wherever you want. Of course, if you’d rather be drawing sea mines or skyscrapers… Who are we to stop you?

 Wallpaper mode!
 Miss your babies whenever you go and close the game? Simply...

store.name: Squadron 42
store.short: Enlist in the UEE Navy in a cinematic, single-player space adventure. Pilot combat ships, fight on foot, and explore capital ships, space stations, and frontier outposts. Live and work alongside your crew as you battle on the front lines of a galactic war.
store.about: Enlist as a rookie in the UEE Navy and step into a cinematic, single-player space adventure where you are at the center of the action. Live, work, and fight alongside your crew, brought to life by an all-star cast, as the story unfolds across fighter cockpits, capital ships, space stations, frontier outposts, and the front lines of a galactic war. Through intense combat, sacrifice, and the choices you make when it matters most, you will earn your place, your rank, and your legacy. You don’t watch the rise of a hero. You become one.

store.name: SlashZero
store.short: SlashZero is a side-scrolling action roguelike game. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?
store.about:
SlashZero is a 3D anime-style side-scrolling action roguelike game. In this game, you can unleash flashy moves, dive into thrilling combat and customize endless builds to suit your playstyle. Fight, power up, collect items and uncover the hidden truth beneath this stunning cyberpunk world!

 Master rich movesets and in-depth combat combos featuring signature aerial strings. Dash, vault, and fight across multi-layered maps for smooth, parkour-style action!

 Feel every strike with precise hit feedback. Diverse level designs keep every battle fresh and challenging. Dominate foes by blending acrobatic finesse with tactical combat strategy to claim victory!

 Try out different Timehackers and find the combat playstyle that suits you best. Are you a melee expert? A ranged specialist? Or do you prefer something more flexible in both offense and defense? Find your style as you experience each character's unique movesets and explore their stories!

 Mix and match a wide range of in-run and out-of-run systems to shape your own combat build. In every run, you can choose a path and grow stronger as you follow it. Combine the power of Blessings from different Authorities, harness the run-changing effects of Temporal Fragments, and equip Upgrade Chips that can fundamentally reshape how your character plays. Back at the base, unlock permanent progression options to prepare for what comes next. Increase your stats, acquire Dual Blessings, gain additional rerolls, and more! You may even get to bring your own preset builds into future runs!

 As the timelines collapse, HIEROS-I descends,...

store.name: PUBG: Black Budget
store.short: PUBG: Black Budget is an extraction shooter built around tension, survival, and the unknown. Join a classified operation and uncover the secrets of a mysterious island trapped in a time loop.
store.about:
※ This footage is from a version still in development and may differ from the actual game. 

 About PUBG: Black Budget   
 Designed as an FPP-first experience, PUBG: Black Budget is a tactical extraction shooter built around tension, survival, and the unknown.
 You are a Contractor, a hardened veteran hired for a classified operation on an island at the edge of the world. Your mission is to recover top-secret technology from an abandoned research facility. But there’s a catch: the island is trapped in a time loop, consumed by a supernatural phenomenon known as the Anomaly. Extract artifacts, research your findings, and uncover the truth behind the black-budget initiative, SAPIENS.
 In between missions, you’ll expand your personal Base, craft new equipment, and improve your character’s skills and proficiencies. Prepare to face PvPvE threats in an environment that grows more unpredictable with every loop – and the longer you stay, the harder it is to make it out alive.

 Key Features    
 2.5 × 2.5 km open-world island featuring varied biomes, points of interest, and underground facilities

 Up to 30-minute sessions combining exploration, combat, and extraction

 Persistent inventory: keep what you extract, lose what you bring if you die

 Level- and squad-based matchmaking for up to 3-player squads and 45 players per session

 Dynamic PvPvE encounters against other Contractors and various hostile entities

 The Anomaly gradually shrinks the playable area, creating tense and unpredictable scenarios every loop

 Difficulty scaling that increases with player level and time...

store.name: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™
store.short: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ is a ​runs-based, ​high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.
store.about:
​​​​​Star Wars ​​: Galactic Racer™ is a ​​runs-based​​, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim of the ​​ Star Wars​​ ™​​ galaxy.​​​​

 The Empire’s grip on the galaxy has finally broken, and with its fall comes a new obsession: speed. As the New Republic struggles to rebuild, gambling, entertainment, and glory fuel a booming underground.  

 Out of this chaos, the Galactic League is born: an unsanctioned racing circuit where syndicates sponsor pilots, fortunes are won and lost in seconds, and only the bold survive. 

 No Force. No prophecy. Just skill, strategy, and the will to rise.  

 Slam, shunt, and takedown rivals across varied circuits as you pilot landspeeders, speeder bikes, skim speeders, and podracers. The greater the risk, the greater the reward.

 Join the Galactic League - an unsanctioned racing circuit born in the lawless Outer Rim. Become Shade, a lone racer chasing revenge and glory. 

 Pilot different classes of repulsorcraft each with distinct physics and playstyles. Build a ride that showcases your style and gives you a competitive edge.  

 Ride solo through a story-driven campaign of shifting alliances or brave strategic PvP grudge matches where reputation rides with you. 

 Prove yourself through intense rivalries and escalating challenges. Every choice shapes your prospects as you build your status in the Galactic League .

store.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 27
store.short: Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC™ 27. Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay.
store.about: This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

store.name: Barbie™ Rewind
store.short: Decorate the DreamHouse™ through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games. In Barbie™ Rewind, Barbie invites you into her cozy, creative world and entrusts you to customize her DreamHouse. Barbie also left you her game collection, so you can revisit your favorite Barbie video games.
store.about:
Decorate the DreamHouse™ through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games in this cozy and creative game. Barbie™ Rewind pulls you back in time through iconic eras of Barbie with stunning pixel art and retro style. Your bestie, Barbie, invites you into her world and entrusts you to update her DreamHouse with your unique style, using items from 65+ years of Barbie history. 

Choose from three retro DreamHouse designs for your exterior facade, walls, and floors. You can even mix-and-match them from room to room. Style each room with a fabulous collection of furniture, decor, and accessories, inspired by real Barbie playsets throughout the decades. From a classic pink vanity to a ‘90s inflatable chair, make the DreamHouse unique to your style and creativity. 

Barbie has also left you her game collection of 16 Barbie video games from 1991 through 2007. Titles include Barbie™Pet Rescue, Barbie™ Horse Adventures™: Blue Ribbon Race™, and the never-before-released game, Barbie: Vacation Adventure. Play through the collection to complete additional quests and unlock more items. 

Plenty of familiar friends (Ken, Teresa, and Christie!) pop in to get your help with designs for them, too. You can also flip through the pages of Barbie history in the beautiful digital Lookbook. 

FEATURES

- Decorate the DreamHouse! Help Barbie decorate with furniture, decor, and accessories inspired by Barbie playsets throughout the years. 

- Express Yourself. With 250+ pieces of furniture, decor, and accessories to unlock, the possibilities are endless. 

- Play 16 classic Barbie video games....

store.name: Rayman Legends Retold
store.short: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or in up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!
store.about:
Pre-purchase any edition of Rayman Legends Retold and receive the exclusive Hoodlum Havoc Pack, containing 2 costumes for Rayman and Globox inspired by Rayman 3: Hoodlum Havoc.

Includes: the base game + Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition.

Embark on a bold reimagining of the acclaimed platformer, filled with new content and narrative twists. When a shadowy villain spreads corruption across the Glade of Dreams, journey through its charming worlds solo or in up to 4‑player couch co‑op in a fast‑paced, side‑scrolling adventure where every stumble and surprise adds to the delightful chaos.

Leap, glide, and punch your way through worlds bursting with charm and delightful surprises. Craving a change of pace? Dive into unforgettable musical stages, where every move must sync with the beat for a rhythm‑powered thrill.

Immerse yourself in a world brimming with life, reimagined with stunning visuals. A rich selection of iconic levels returns alongside a mysterious sixth realm and 4 new musical stages. Saddle up for epic dragon rides and test your skills in the Cave of Trials.

Join Rayman and his friends on their most ambitious adventure yet, facing a new foe stirring trouble from the underworld. Voiced cinematics and an expanded soundtrack by Christophe Héral and Grant Kirkhope bring the journey to life, blending original themes with new compositions.

Play the entire adventure in up to 4-player couch co-op, racing for Lums or knocking each other off to claim every last Teensy. Kung Foot also returns with improved controls, power-ups, and customizable rules for hours of frantic...

store.name: Funeral for the Sun
store.short: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.
store.about:
“One of the most unique environments and world building I've seen in the mystery genre.” 
 - Robin Ward (The Roottrees are Dead)
 "Making surprising connections and unfolding such a layered story was a wonderful experience." 
 -Jeremy Johnston (The Roottrees are Dead)
 "This game is really really good, I really enjoyed it." 
 -Jason Schreier (Triple Click Podcast/Bloomberg)
 "My overall pick of Next Fest."
 -Lucy James (Lookingfor.game)
 How do 700 people vanish in a single night? 
 The official story says that a fire had destroyed the town, along with all but one of the town's 724 residents.

 The official story is false.

 You'll search the ashes of the town, and travel through its past to find out what really happened.

 Funeral for the Sun is an 8 hour long detective game rooted in Latin American history that lets you travel back in time and deduce secrets beyond your wildest imaginations.

 Explore 400 years of history 
 70+ memories cling to the ashes of Cerro Milagroso. Each one of them is but a small part of a much larger tapestry.

 Validate your findings 
 Build out your web of connections, one clue at a time.

 Assign each character their correct name.

 Establish relationships in a web of connections.

 Sometimes a character's appearance changes over different parts of their life. Combine portraits together when they represent the same person.

 Over 100+ Portraits to find!

 SOMETHING SLUMBERS UNDERNEATH THE TOWN

store.name: Beastfolk Barber
store.short: You're a barber in a city full of beastfolk. Chat with your customers, style their look, help them see something new in the mirror... and in themselves.
store.about:
Beastfolk Barber is a narrative game where every haircut is a conversation. You play as Freddie, a barber running a small shop for beastfolk of all shapes and sizes. With every cut and chat, learn what your customers like, what they need, and who they want to be. 

 One day, a demon appears in your mirror with an offer. Give her the perfect haircut, and she'll undo a past regret. But first, you'll need to keep serving customers, gather resources, and find a way to cut a demon's hair. Along the way, you'll come face to face with what you've been trying to avoid.

 Features 
 The Mysterious Mirror 

 Created by Freddie's late friend, this mirror can show customers their new hairstyle before you make the first cut. But previews are limited, so watch their reactions and make every choice count.
 Haircuts and Conversations 

 Every customer brings a different challenge to the barber's chair. Listen, observe, and find the look they're really after. As you cut their hair, customers open up about everyday worries unique to their species. And every haircut brings you closer to who they really are.
 Life Around the Barbershop 

 When the day ends, review customer feedback and scroll through the city's social feed. Local news, festivals, and the latest from your customers may all come in handy the next time someone sits in your chair. As the story unfolds, a citywide celebration will bring every familiar face back to your little shop.
 Keep Them Coming Back 

 How well you handle each haircut affects your customers' stories and the chances you'll see them again. Get it wrong, and...

store.name: Soulframe
store.short: From the creators of Warframe emerges a new Fantasy Action RPG. Forge your legend with blade, bow, and magick as you lead the charge against a world-devouring corruption.
store.about:
Rise as an Envoy in a living world besieged by conquerors. Live alongside your Ancestors and manifest primal aspects of the natural world in your defense. Combine the strength of your Pacts, Weapons and Virtues solo or with friends to take back Midrath and free the Omen Beasts from the Ode. Rise, Envoy
The Spellsong, that enchanted melody that sounded over Alca on Ode'n Descent, caused all to forget. Forget their rites, their divine Omen Beasts, themselves. Now, the people of Alca can only believe their rulers have always been so: their right to rule as sure as the rising of twin suns Mora and Saphene. The Omen Beasts they worshipped lay defiled, corrupted by Ode'n Ichor. Their pact may have granted strength enough to rebel against Alca's invaders, yet none remain to free them of their bindings. None but you, Envoy. 

Your blood is that of ancient Fey, not so easily swayed by the Ode'n Magicks draped over the land. It falls to you to dam the steady flow of ichorous corruption and heal the worldflesh of Alca. For none are beyond saving, and it is never too late to be redeemed. Feybled Arms 
The bonds you forge with Omen Beasts manifest as Pacts, granting Arcanic abilities in your shared rebellion against the Ode. Whether you favour Courage, Grace, or Spirit, embody your chosen Virtues to match your approach. Courage, a heroic charge into the fray. Grace, the sly stealth of roguish tricksters or the patient aim of marksmen hunters. Spirit, attuned to the flows of magick deep in Alca's roots. Wield blade, bow, and magick to great effect as you craft and master your chosen...

store.name: The Missing Tail
store.short: The Missing Tail is a cozy co-op adventure where you play as two cats exploring a lively medieval courtyard and castle.
store.about:
The Missing Tail is a cozy co-op adventure where you play as two cats exploring a lively medieval courtyard and castle. Explore a bustling medieval courtyard and castle, complete quests, interact with townsfolk, and uncover secrets together. Choose between the royal palace cat or the clever stray and shape your own adventure!

 Once upon a time, a royal cat lived a peaceful, rich life until one disastrous event turned its life upside down. On the other hand, a stray cat tried to save its food from menacing forest creatures. Suddenly, both their lives became intertwined in one epic journey. Join both cats on a fun and emotional adventure trying to find a path home.

 Team up with a friend and explore the world together in split-screen third-person gameplay. Solve co-op puzzles and platform your way through the adventure, help other animals in their troubles, and interact with the surroundings as a true feline duo.

 Play as a noble royal palace cat or a clever stray. Each path offers its own personality and perspective on the world.

 Don’t forget to have fun and make people's lives a bit harder! Be a dual mini-chaos team and enjoy breaking and pushing annoying objects where they disturb your peace.

 Explore a vibrant castle environment filled with lively streets, charming courtyards, and rooftop pathways. Roam freely, leap across buildings, and uncover hidden corners waiting to be discovered.

store.name: 1999TOKOYO Building
store.short: 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.
store.about:
*This game contains occasional depictions of violence, frightening scenes, and suicide. If you are sensitive to such content, please enable “Hide Graphic Content” in the Settings menu. 
 Welcome to TOKOYO Building!!! 

 "1999TOKOYO Building" is a visual novel & adventure game where you deepen relationships with peculiar employees and aim to escape from a crumbling indoor amusement park.
 Play the Entire First Chapter in Our Free Demo! 
 The demo lets you experience the entire first chapter, just as it appears in the full game.

 TOKOYO Building is full of "Secrets"! 
 The TOKOYO Building, rumored to make people vanish, is an indoor amusement park surrounded by massive water tank. Though practically a ruin, it never closes, and live-in employees still work there today.

 A diverse cast of characters is thrilled to welcome you! 
 The protagonist, Akira, becomes an employee of this building after getting lost inside it.

 Uncover their "Secrets" and become friends! 
 Use the information you've gained through your lock-picking skills to build rapport with the employees.

 However, please be extremely careful with...

store.name: Machine Party
store.short: Machine Party is a collection of violent party games where failure is lethal. Gather your friends and endure high stakes situations to prove your life is worth more than theirs. Survival is unlikely.
store.about:
Welcome to Machine Party. In this series of dangerous, and some would say highly illegal, party games you will have to use every trick in the book to survive. Play through classic party game formats and new twists on the genre for sessions of fun, screaming, and horror. 

 Features 
 A collection of uniquely violent party games 

 Support for 2 - 4 players 

 An industrial soundtrack by Alex Peipman

 Customize your test subject

 Multiple devious ways of screwing your friends over

store.name: StateOS: The Political Sandbox
store.short: The political sandbox game where you build a career from state rep to the presidency. Authentic electoral systems, government departments, pass legislation, and a unique news landscape. Create custom scenarios, parties, and politicians in this data-driven democracy simulator.
store.about:
Rise Through the Ranks of Power 
 Start as a local politician and build your career through authentic electoral systems, legislative battles, and more. Every decision you make can shape the world and your history.
 A Living Political Ecosystem 
 Hundreds of politicians with unique views and ideologies will vote and behave differently. Metrics affect party popularity, which creates different election results over time. Regions that used to be more likely to vote for one party may shift to another party instead.
 Deep Legislative Simulation 
 Draft legislation that matters. Propose bills on everything from minimum wage to healthcare reform, and watch as AI politicians vote based on their ideology, personal stances, and political party. These bills, policies, and laws affect the metrics of the city, state, or nation, and can make the difference if you want to win re-election or help your party gain popularity.
 Key Features: 
 Government & Legislation 
 Draft and propose bills across dozens of policy areas

 Watch policies create real effects on demographics, economy, and public opinion

 Manage government budgets at the state, and national levels

 Appoint cabinet members and department heads

 Veto or sign bills as the executive

 Campaign & Elections 
 Build name recognition and raise campaign funds through events and donations

 Respond to polling data showing your support across different demographics

 Navigate primary elections and general elections

 Choose starting positions from the state rep the governor to the president, or even as an unelected individual

...

store.name: Phantom Blade Zero
store.short: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.
store.about:
Framed for murdering his master, Soul suffers a devastating wound to the heart, leaving him just sixty-six days to live. Alone and hunted, he roams the Wulin, determined to unravel a conspiracy that has ensnared the martial world.
 Through rain and blood, kindness and vengeance, he embarks on a journey where love and hatred intertwine in search of a heart.

 Explore the mysterious Phantom World, where shifting light and shadow conceal mysteries at every turn.
 Memory Flowers, the Wulin and the Discordance, Transcension, the Lady of the Veil, Inanis' Dreamscape...
 Every secret leads to another, and every corner hides a new story.
 When one path ends, another begins. Hidden passages and intricate mechanisms await those who dare to explore.

 In the Wulin, your weapon is your life.
 Master over 30 primary weapons and more than 20 unique Phantom Edges, wrested from the hands of fallen foes.
 Rooted in traditional martial arts, combat flows through seamless combos that are easy to learn yet rewarding to master. Only true masters will uncover the deadly intricacies within every technique.
 Blades clash in showers of sparks. Dodge, deflect, counter, and strike in one seamless flow, where victory and defeat are decided in an instant.
 Will the next turn leave the sands stained with blood, or lead you back from the brink of death?

 The golden age of wuxia cinema collides with punk fantasy in Phantom Blade Zero.
 Martial arts, cold steel, mechanical prosthetics, crumbling industrial ruins, traditional Chinese aesthetics, and modern rock music. 
 Together, they create the dark,...

store.name: Give Us A Sign
store.short: Give Us A Sign is a 1-4 player co-op psychological horror simulation. As an investigator, use specialized equipment to detect entities and gather evidence in haunted locations. Every word you speak shapes the haunting around you. Once you ask for a sign, there is no turning back.
store.about:
Reactive Environmental Design
 In the world of Give Us A Sign, the environment is far more than just a backdrop; it reacts to your very presence. With every step you take, you will feel the shift in the room's energy as even inanimate objects focus their gaze upon you.

 Various Haunted Areas
 Explore various meticulously crafted locations, each featuring its own unique history and paranormal intensity.

 Get Your Equipment
 Meet Gianna, a vital resident of your safe house and your dedicated friend for all things gear. From high-fidelity detection tools to survival essentials, she ensures you never step into the darkness unprepared.

 Select the Investigation Map
 Oscar is your experienced guide and another heart of the safe house. He scouts the most haunted locations so you don't have to go in blind. Rely on his firsthand knowledge to select your next investigation map and prepare for the unique dangers that await.

 Define Your Presence
 Create your unique investigator with high-fidelity models and a variety of customization options. Shape an identity that stands out in the darkness and tailor your gear to match your style.

 Season Pass: Extending the Sign
 Push the boundaries. New regions, dangerous entities, and allies await you with the Season Pass. Uncover the secrets of your safe house and continue your investigation. This nightmare is just the beginning.

store.name: Aniimo
store.short: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!
store.about:
Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

 When embarking on an adventure on Idyll, anyone you meet can become a companion! Catch Aniimo using Aniipods, set traps and time your catch perfectly - enjoy the thrill and uncertainty of every moment! Unique Aniimo will appear according to the environment, weather, phenomena and time of day. Most Aniimo can evolve, making collecting and discovering Aniimo even more exciting.

 On your journey of adventure you can Twine with Aniimo and essentially become any Aniimo that you collect. Use the Aniimo’s skills to solve puzzles, win battles and overcome challenges! Twine with Aniimo, to see the world from a brand new perspective.

 The continent of Idyll is expansive and alive with beauty and the perfect setting to capture, to Twine, to find answers and for the Aniimo to reach their full potential. Challenge, race, discover... immersive exploration ensures every step of the journey is engaging. Whether you're gliding, diving, burrowing... you can step foot anywhere.

 In the vast world of Aniimo, every real-time challenge is full of unknowns and surprises. The PVEVP mode "Egg Heist" allows you to join a 3-player team anytime to engage in real-time searches and battles in the Lost Isles.
 Whether you're solo, multiplayer, adventuring, battling, or simply looking to quickly become...

store.name: Zombie Hamsters
store.short: You're tiny zombie hamsters trapped in a dangerous laboratory. Find a way out, experiment with crazy abilities, and unleash chaos. Every escape is unique. No hints! Just one goal and one challenge — can you escape?
store.about:
Play solo or with friends. Explore a massive procedurally generated research laboratory filled with scientists, security guards, and mutant experiments. You're given a goal and the tools to achieve it — how you use them is entirely up to you! Plan and pull off your own unique escape!

 Infect
 Infect everyone around you and unleash a full-blown zombie apocalypse.

 Destroy
 The entire laboratory is yours to wreak havoc in!

 Challenge
 You have one goal — escape the laboratory. How you achieve it is up to you.

 Fear Your Teammates
 Your greatest enemy is your best friend.

 Mutants
 You're not alone! And not everyone is friendly.
 The only thing that matters is escaping the laboratory. What condition you leave it in is another story.
 Game Features
 4-Player Co-op — Explore the laboratory and overcome challenges together with your friends.

 Zombie Infection — Infect scientists, security guards, and other inhabitants of the laboratory.

 Stealth & Exploration — Sneak through narrow ventilation shafts and discover alternative routes.

 Puzzles & Platforming Challenges — There's no single right solution, only your choices and their consequences.

 Dangerous Laboratory — Avoid deadly traps, face hostile enemies, and expect the unexpected.

store.name: PHUY
store.short: You’re a crew of hapless thieves with one job: rob a museum and make it out alive. Hunt for valuables, solve puzzles, and survive the locals. Just try not to become part of the exhibit. A co-op horror game for 1–4 players.
store.about:
You’re a crew of thieves who decided to rob a museum. Break in, find the valuables you came for, and try to make it out with them. 
 Getting to the loot isn’t always easy. Explore the museum, solve puzzles, and find a way forward. Some of the things you steal might come in handy before you even make it to the exit.
 YOU’RE NOT ALONE IN THE MUSEUM
 The museum has its own inhabitants, and they’re not too happy to have visitors. Each one behaves differently, so there’s no single plan that will work every time.
 Just don’t lose the loot. Or your friends, if you can help it.

 IT’S ALL ABOUT PHYSICS
 Players, objects, and the environment all interact with each other, and things don’t always go the way you planned.

 BETWEEN HEISTS
 You can’t spend all your time robbing museums. Between heists, head back to your base, put on some music or record your own, grab a drink, and just hang out with your friends.

store.name: Where the Seeds Fall
store.short: Blight has infected the land, forcing humanity to live upon the branches of the World Tree. After a chance encounter with a strange child, your world begins to fall apart. Navigate ruins, read the wind, and take a leap of faith into this thrilling action-adventure game.
store.about:
The earth has been afflicted with Blight, forcing humanity to build new homes upon the branches of the World Tree.
It is a place fraught with peril, and in their fear, humanity has branded "Fell Children" as omens of disaster. After encountering a Fell Child, however, one soldier goes against orders and resolves to escort them to the surface world.

 Navigate crumbling platforms, brace against strong winds, and make sure you land on steady ground. On the precarious branches of the World Tree, one misstep could spell your doom.

 Growing on the World Tree are unique flower buds you can pick up and carry. Throw them where you want to land to create flower blossoms that will absorb the impact of your otherwise deadly fall.

 As you explore the World Tree, uncover the truth behind the Fell Child to learn what—and who—your journey is truly about.

 Enjoy a densely-packed narrative experience that can be finished in about 3 hours. After clearing the main story, continue challenging yourself with higher-difficulty maps and a time trial mode.

store.name: Cash is King! Business Simulator
store.short: Start with nothing and build your own business empire in sunny Miami Beach! Sell lemonade, run vending machines, automate your companies and turn small side jobs into big profits in this relaxed first-person simulator.
store.about:
Welcome to Miami Beach . Sun, sand, and money are in the air. You start with empty pockets and work your way up in this laid-back first-person simulation. Collect cash, improve your reputation, and enjoy fun, slightly chaotic gameplay with hustles and amusing minigames. In the end, only one thing matters: Cash is King and you want the crown.

 Build your own street empire 
 You buy and place vending machines, sell lemonade on the beach, and invest your earnings to steadily expand your own little empire.

 Casual gameplay with a feel-good vibe 
 With hard work, a bit of luck, and a pinch of chaos, you fill your cash register, level up your business, and enjoy that good feeling when your balance grows faster than your sunburn.

 Improve your reputation & keep the neighborhood clean 
 Your rise depends on your reputation. Keep the neighborhood clean, remove graffiti, and help people stay cool under the sun. The more popular you become, the more opportunities open up for you.

 Fun minigames & charming chaos 
 Water gun, broom, or newspaper stand: every minigame brings variety, cash, or popularity, plus that wonderful “Just one quick thing …” effect that keeps you playing longer than you planned.

 Unique characters & quirky jobs 
 Colorful personalities like Siggi Sunshine, Rico Cartón, Selma Slots, and Lenny accompany you on your journey and bring you jobs, tips, and new opportunities in the streets of the Sunshine State.

 Furnish your apartment 
 Earn enough cash for your own apartment, shop for furniture at Sofa King, and make your home just the way you like it.

 Your...

store.name: GANG OF DRAGON
store.short: A new action-adventure game from game creator Toshihiro Nagoshi, set in the streets of Shinjuku, Tokyo. Starring Ma Dong-seok as Shin Ji-seong, the story unfolds with heated and intense human drama across Shinjuku, including Kabukicho — one of Japan’s largest entertainment districts.
store.about:
An action-adventure set in Kabukicho, the iconic nightlife district of Shinjuku, Tokyo.

Shin Ji-seong — portrayed by renowned Asian actor Ma Dong-seok — is a high-ranking member of a Korean crime syndicate based in Kabukicho. As he explores the streets of Shinjuku, Shin becomes entangled in underworld conflicts and forges intense, human connections that push him to confront his own sense of purpose.

Combat unfolds from a third-person perspective, centered on Shin’s overwhelming physical power. Engage enemies through brutal hand-to-hand strikes, precise blade attacks, gunplay, and high-impact vehicle action across the city.

Forge your own path through a story where violence and human bonds intertwine.

store.name: MUPO
store.short: Grab your keyboard and jump into the rhythm in MUPO. This fast-paced rhythm game is driven by skill, creativity, and community. Build maps, climb leaderboards, and shape the game’s future. And there’s so much more to come, stay tuned. Be part of the MUPO journey!
store.about:
Welcome to MUPO ,  a rhythm game with a unique twist. 
 Your keyboard isn’t just an input device ,  it’s the game itself. 
 Hit notes, build maps, and claim your spot on the leaderboard. 
Can you master the toughest maps and rise above your friends to become the ultimate MUPO champion?

 MUPO offers a smooth and immersive rhythm experience where you can enjoy the music in your own way. You can play songs in various difficulties and use modifiers to tailor the challenge to your own preference.

 MUPO thrives through its community. You can design and share your own maps, making the game a constantly evolving experience. The built-in level editor ensures there’s always new content to play and discover.

 For anyone who likes a good challenge, MUPO features global leaderboards. Compete against friends and rhythm gamers worldwide, climb the rankings, and prove your skill.

 MUPO will continue to evolve steadily and will expand with multiplayer modes, custom keyboard skins, and new layouts like Numpad, Arrow Keys, or a full 100% keyboard layout. Future updates will add more content and creative tools for a fully personalized rhythm experience.

store.name: Drunken Goddess Reflux
store.short: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.
store.about:
Break the rules as you drink in this twisted game of Russian roulette, and push the demon till she spills it all!

 "No one's ever done this to me before...
 Ahh, you're incredible, darling."

 A shot glass Russian roulette with a demon who loves you enough to kill you.
 Survive the night, and savor seven flavors of ruin.

 ■The drunker you get, the wilder the game!
 Drink until the rules stop mattering, and unleash drunken tricks only a true barfly could master to make it out alive!

 ■A soul-on-the-line drinking survival game where you spill your soul or make her spill!
 A high-stakes roulette where every shot hits a little different!
 Only one rule: get the demon wasted and make her spill her soul to win!

 ■Femme Soule
 "Surrender your life to me, darling. Let's spend eternity together."
 In Hell's bar, Pandemonium, a liquor-soaked demon awaits—one who loves you enough to kill you.

 ♥ Let's sink into Hell side by side!
 Longing for a sip of madness and bliss? Down for a one-night stand with a demon? Hallelujah! Add Drunken Goddess Reflux to your wishlist and wait for the release half-drunk and smiling!

 ■ Staff
 Producer & Director: WHO YOU (Fuyuki Hayashi)
 Art Director / Character Designer / Animator: odyk
 Theme Song & BGM: Aiobahn +81
 Lead Game Designer: Masatoshi Tokuoka
 Programmer: oyatsu, okazu
 3D Environment: tiri, temi
 Background Art: amebiyori
 GUI Design: Kaoru Ito
 Logo Design: Hiroto Sugawara (femt)
 Voice: Nanahira

 “DEMON’S SHOT”
 Composition: Aiobahn +81
 Arrangement: Aiobahn +81
