 Vocal: DEMONDICE

store.name: a Dogs Dream
store.short: Test your sixth sense. Will you eat a wild rabbit, or tie someone to the train tracks? Every choice is yours to make. May you find a reason to laugh inside your nightmares.
store.about:
What kind of dreams have you been having lately?

 The good dog Cloud is taken by an alien on his 25th birthday.
 Now you are a dog, showing countless dreams to the alien.
In these dreams, everything is twisted — but trust your sixth sense to find the truth.
 Make the alien angry, and they might suck the Earth like a candy.

 – Choose within dreams – 

 Your unknown choices will lead your journey.
Sometimes the strangest choice is the bravest one.

 In dreams, the main character changes. Navigate each story with a different protagonist in every dream.

 -Explore the ship by day—stay out of the aliens’ line of sight.- 

 Fight through brutal encounters and surreal anomalies to uncover an escape route.
 Recruit allies and slip through the ship’s shadowy back corridors.
 The alien is tracking you. Stay sharp.

 – Collect helpful items with Dreambugs – 

 Put the alien into a deep sleep to earn Dreambugs.
Grind them — they’ll come in handy.

 – Care for the alien’s mind – 

 The being looks quite lonely.
 Making it sad… might be a mistake.

 – Discover the hidden ending – 
Within a chain of small dreams,
uncover the end of a greater story —
one that only you can create.
 Play a Dogs Dream now!

 Dozens of short, surreal omnibus stories with countless choices

 Emotional scenes crafted around diverse, dreamlike themes

 How could a small dog possibly save the world?

 A touching main story hidden within tiny dreams
 a Dogs Dream is a surreal narrative adventure inspired by Maki Sasaki’s “Street of the Beach” , The Rocky Horror Picture Show , Osamu Tezuka’s “Phoenix” , and One...

store.name: Zenless Zone Zero
store.short: Zenless Zone Zero is HoYoverse’s brand-new urban fantasy ARPG. Players act as "Proxies" who explore Hollows alongside a wide range of unique Agents, fighting enemies, and completing commissions on their journey to unveil the mysteries behind New Eridu.
store.about:
Welcome to New Eridu — Where Humanity Rises Anew! 

 Zenless Zone Zero is a brand-new urban fantasy action RPG lovingly crafted by HoYoverse.
 In the game, a disaster known as "Hollows" brought modern civilization to its knees. Hollows appear out of the blue, spawning anomalous dimensions crawling with terrifying monsters called "Ethereals."
 In the wake of this catastrophic disaster, the last city to survive the apocalypse — New Eridu — used the technology and resources needed to combat the Hollows, overcame countless dangers, and gradually evolved into humanity's final bastion of civilization.
 In New Eridu, you'll step into the role of a Proxy — a professional who provides guidance to those who need to venture into the dangerous Hollows for various reasons. You'll embark on adventures with unique characters, exploring Hollows together, battling powerful enemies, completing commissions, and uncovering the secrets hidden within the city.

 Satisfying Combat, Igniting Your Passion for Action
 Zenless Zone Zero delivers smooth and exhilarating combat. Launch your offense with Basic Attacks and Special Attacks, counter enemy strikes through dodges and blocks, then string together flashy combos with Chain Attacks to finish them off. Different enemies have their own specialties and weaknesses — seizing the right opportunity and responding with precision is key to controlling the battle.

 Cutting-Edge Visuals, Maximum Audiovisual Experience
 Zenless Zone Zero features a striking art style and visual design that stands out. Characters boast incredibly detailed expressions and...

store.name: Gun a Rat
store.short: Don’t like rats? Don’t like your friends? Then this game is made for you! Hunt down the rats before they wreck the place, and methodically place your traps to slow them down as much as possible!
store.about:
Gun a Rat is a fast-paced asymmetrical multiplayer game to play with your friends.
 Play as the Rats and wreck the house... or as the Exterminator , and wipe them out down to the last one.
Start matches from 2 to 20 players on a variety of maps, each with its own share of surprises, with 3 game modes to choose from…

 A very special voice chat... 
 Rats can talk to each other through voice chat without fear of being understood.

 The Exterminator only hears squeaks instead of their words!

 Your goal as a Rat: 
 Reach the target score by destroying and stealing objects before time runs out, without getting killed!

 But be careful... every destruction makes a noise that will give you away!

 If the Exterminator is hunting you down,
quickly hide in the furniture to escape their gaze.

 As the Exterminator: 
 Use your camera to track the rats' movements and find out where they're hiding...

 Place your traps carefully to slow them down as much as possible

 Kill them all!

 A wide range of traps is at your disposal,
each one holding its own nasty surprises for the Rats ...

 3 game modes to keep things fresh: 
 Classic : smash and steal as many objects as you can to reach the target score before time runs out!

 Hide and Seek : earn points by looking at the Exterminator ... but stay well hidden so you don't get spotted!

 Bomb Tag : an explosive game of tag! Pass the bomb to another player before it blows up in your snout!

 Play match after match to earn Cheese Coins ,
and spend them on skins to customize your rat!

 So, which side will you be on?

store.name: Trees Hate You
store.short: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...
store.about:
After a picnic in the woods, it's time to go home. But the nearby flora is determined to take you off course and make your life miserable.

 This is a rage game focused on traps and gags. There's a surprise around every corner to keep your hike infuriating. Try to avoid the traps, inevitably die from them, and try again. These trees are unfair, mean, and merciless. They will use your expectations against you to humiliate you.

 In this game, you can:
 Be the victim of a variety of bullying methods

 Get lost in several biomes as your journey goes terribly off course

 Collect cool hats (or ugly hats, depending on your fashion sense)

 Find an axe?

store.name: No One to See – Pinebark Camp
store.short: Going through a hard time, Ethan decided to go camping alone in the Pinebark woods. He wanted to get away from everything for a few days and find a little silence. He just didn't expect that, in Pinebark, the silence would be listening too.
store.about:
"I never used to believe those stories about what the woods hide. To me, it was all exaggeration." 

Ethan went camping alone in the Pinebark woods. He needed a break from the city and from a rough time in his life. He only stayed two days, and when he came back... he was no longer the same.

In No One to See , you relive those two days the way he tells them. Stay quiet

At certain moments, the game listens to your microphone. Talking, shouting, moving: nothing goes unnoticed in the silence of Pinebark, and out there you're not as alone as it seems. What to expect

 First-person psychological horror with a VHS tape look.

 A short, complete story you can finish in 40 to 50 minutes.

 Drive to the woods, set up camp, light the campfire, cook and fish at the lake.

 Talk to the people you meet along the way and choose your replies.

 Text messages on your phone.

 Steam achievements.

 Best played with headphones and a microphone.

store.name: AI Digital Human Lab
store.short: Meet Luna, a lifelike AI companion who lives on your PC: talk by voice or text and she answers in her own voice, with 74 expressions and natural gestures, all on-device. Optionally, an AI assistant that supports MCP can direct her: lights, camera, outfits, dance, songs.
store.about:
A Digital Human Who Listens, Understands, and Answers in Her Own Voice
 Meet Luna, a lifelike digital human who lives right on your PC. Talk to her by voice or text — ask a question, share your day, tell a story — and she answers in the moment, in her own voice, with accurate lip-sync, 74 facial expressions and gestures that fit what she says. No scripts, no dialogue trees: every reply is generated live. Her language model and her voice run on your own graphics card, so your conversations stay on your PC — no subscription, no API keys.
 Optional: Connect an AI Assistant (MCP)
 AI Digital Human Lab has a built-in MCP server (Model Context Protocol, the open standard AI assistants use to work with apps). If you use an AI assistant that supports MCP, you can connect it, and it can see the scene and direct it: speak through her, set the lights and the camera, dress her, pose her, start a dance, and capture the moment. This is entirely optional: the game is complete without it, and you need nothing outside Steam to play.
 Connect in seconds — click the robot button in the chat bar (or type /mcp bind), scan the QR code with your phone, and send one message to your agent. No API keys, no configuration files.

 Your agent speaks as her — hand the conversation to your agent: your words go to it, and she answers with its words, lip-synced and with matching expressions. Switch back to her built-in AI anytime.

 A director at your command — more than 40 tools: camera angles, studio lighting, the look of the picture, poses, motions, outfits, hairstyles, backdrops, face sculpting, and...

store.name: Too Deep To Quit
store.short: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!
store.about:
Too Deep To Quit is a 1-4 player co-op survival exploration game. Gather your team of adventurers, brave the dangers of cursed temples, and claim the ultimate treasure.

 A true adventurer knows how to improvise. These cursed temples hold a lot more than just gold, they’re packed with the leftovers of the poor saps who came before you. Check every dark corner for whatever keeps you breathing.

 Sure, starving to death is bad, but getting squashed by the walls is definitely worse. Every hallway is a literal death trap waiting for the clumsy guy in your squad to mess up.

 If the traps don’t get you, the locals will. These forgotten temples are the perfect breeding ground for anything that slithers, stings, or bites. 

 It belongs in a museum... but it’ll look way better in your bank account. Deep within these ruins lie priceless artifacts and solid gold idols just waiting to be claimed.

store.name: Bullet Meltdown
store.short: An adrenaline-pumping bullet heaven where death is permanent. Hire and evolve unique companions, discover 950+ weapon variations, and fight through swarms of enemies and bosses. Grow stronger every run, but if your team falls, they're gone for good.
store.about:
ABOUT THIS GAME
 Bullet Meltdown is best described as Brotato meets Tower Defense,  a bullet heaven arena shooter with base building, AI companions, and permanent progression. Get overpowered every run.

 BECOME OVERPOWERED
 Every run is a hunt for power. Tear through waves of enemies, grab coins mid-chaos, and spend them in the shop on weapons and upgrades that stack into insane combinations. Pick up rare guns and watch your build spiral out of control.
 Between runs, spend collected resources on permanent upgrades to your character. Each session you come back stronger. The grind is the game and the game is glorious. 
 Master special abilities that turn the tide: dodge roll out of certain death, trigger a wave-long attack boost that supercharges every unit on the field, or stop time itself in a spectacular display of power while enemies freeze and bullets hang in the air.

 FIGHT INSANE BOSSES
 Bosses in Bullet Meltdown are not obstacles. They are disasters. 
 Giant snakes that eat walls like it's cardboard. Spiders that walk straight over your fortifications. Gang assaults where multiple bosses rush your base simultaneously. Surprise attacks on end of the wave. Each zone brings its own nightmare and they will tear your carefully built outpost to splinters while you scramble to survive.
 Face off against dozens of unique enemy types engineered to disrupt your plans: armored heavies that shrug off bullets, hatching eggs that spawn mid-wave, zombies that refuse to stay dead, ghosts that blink through your walls, and suicide bombers wrapped in fire. No two areas feel the...

store.name: Cozy~Fishing Kitten
store.short: Dive into a cozy, idle fishing experience! Cast your line from a little corner on your desktop. Customize your cute avatar and background, then feed and collect adorable cats of all breeds. Unlock beautiful scenes and jump into multiplayer and sneak in some "chill-time" with friends!
store.about:
"Cozy~ Fishing Kitten" is a lighthearted desktop idle game where you can slack off with your friends, dress up your character with all kinds of outfits, collect different breeds of cats, and gradually unlock more slacking-off scenes.

 Freely adjust the position and size of the game window and tuck it into a corner of your desktop. Cast your line and wait for a bite while you get things done. This whole pond is yours now! 
 When you have a moment, check out today's haul. From common little fish to creatures from the deepest seas, and even some downright strange fellows, every cast brings a surprise. Here, no angler ever goes home empty-handed!

 Thanks to nature's gifts, collecting flotsam not only yields plenty of resources but also gives you a chance at mysterious eggs. And what hatches out of them? Cats that hatch eggs! 
 Stack cats on an egg to speed up hatching: the more cats, the faster it hatches. Dozens of furry friends are waiting to be collected, so go assemble your fluffy slacking-off squad!

 Customize your avatar and hand-draw your own OC with the brush tool. Whether you're a trained artist or a stick-figure beginner, you can make your character look exactly the way you like. There are over 200 outfits and scene decorations to collect in the game, and gacha capsules give you a chance at ultra-rare looks.

 Join multiplayer online rooms or invite friends to play together — fish and chat, share your catches, and trade your favorite outfits. Fun is better when shared: in this hidden little corner, a grand slacking-off party is quietly underway!

 Cast your line...

store.name: Debauchery & Magic
store.short: In Haven, magic thrives and debauchery is strictly forbidden. Defy a ruthless new ruler as you and your friends quest, loot, party, and battle your way across the kingdom to bring freedom back to its people.
store.about:
In Debauchery & Magic , you find yourself in the world of Haven: A fantastical place filled to the brim of your wizard hat with never-ending celebrations and a bustling economy fueled by indulgence. As expected, the newly crowned Prince Baytre’s coronation was a party for the ages!  
 Or it was...until you woke up the next morning. 
 Debauchery has been outlawed. Revelry is banned. Shenanigans of all sorts are no longer tolerated by the royal family, by penalty of death. 
 That is, unless you step up. 

 Solo, or with up to 11 friends, take the fight to Haven’s shadow government and leave a blazing trail of indulgence in your wake. 
 Quest, loot, and fight the powers that be with a variety of magic and weaponry. Drink concoctions that empower your spells but ruin your coordination. Smoke alchemical blends that'll send you into next week. Gamble your life savings in gold against the house, or your friends, in a myriad of games hidden away in secretive casinos. Or just laze the day away fishing for exotic and uncouth aquatic creatures. 
 Along the way, you can even stunt on the townsfolk with your gnarly skateboard skills across the fantasy world of Haven. 

 Dive into a dark-fantasy world where spellcasting, danger, and indulgence collide. Explore cursed kingdoms, tavern hideouts, underground gambling halls, and halls of arcane corruption as you shape your destiny through equal parts mystical energy and reckless decision-making . 
 The royal family won’t know what hit them, until a fireball is headed their way. 

 It’ll take more than moxie and harsh words to free the...

store.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes
store.short: Two vampires — an ambitious Kindred and a wretched Thinblood. Their fates clash in this Visual Novel set in the World of Darkness, where your arsenal extends beyond just words — from political machinations to forbidden Alchemy. Claw your way to power and leave your bitemarks on Berlin's underworld.
store.about:
Beneath the city's gleaming façade, the clashing vampire factions have carved Berlin into a chessboard of blood and influence. The balance of power needs to be disrupted, if the old order enforced by the Ivory Tower is to prevail. 
And you are the disruption.
 Sent by her Camarilla masters, Alice must navigate the intricacies of the politics at play to destabilise the region and sow discord, ensuring no one faction claims ultimate dominion.
 As she sinks her teeth deeper into the city, she encounters Lenz, who is scraping by on the fringes of the undead society. Their destinies intertwine, forcing a precarious alliance. Now, they must choose: cooperate or betray one another to survive the perilous nights ahead.

 Alice's efforts to destabilise the city's factions are directly reflected on a living map of Berlin. This landscape is a shifting web of contested territories, where each political maneuver brings a district closer to or further from her grasp. To achieve the task set by her masters, she must strategically influence and command the mortals and Kindred she encounters, utilizing Disciplines, the supernatural gifts of the undead.
 Meanwhile, Lenz survives by other means. Lacking Alice's superior Disciplines, he turns to his Alchemical knowledge to level the playing field. He crafts varied formulae through a hands-on Alchemy System that grant him new abilities and open conversation paths that would otherwise be closed to a Thinblood.
 Every conversation is a battleground . Dialogue unfolds through a branching system of choices that shape relationships, reveal secrets,...

store.name: PIX Football Manager
store.short: An online football manager. Scout talent from 350+ clubs, trust your eye to find the right players, and outbid rival managers in auctions. Build squad chemistry, shape your tactics, and face other managers’ clubs in weekly leagues, on your own schedule.
store.about:
PIX Football Manager is an online asynchronous PvP, no single-player retro football management sim built around one idea: the best way to find a great player is to watch them play. You won’t know every player’s true ability before signing them. Every signing is a gamble. Some will disappoint. Others will become club legends.
 Create your club and lead it through season after season. Scout players from over 350 clubs across 25 countries, build your tactics, manage contracts and finances, improve your facilities, and watch your decisions play out in fully simulated matches.

 Watch Matches, Scout Players!
 Watch fully simulated pixel-art football unfold from more than 350 clubs across 25 countries, trust what you see and uncover talent others overlook.

 Scout players yourself, or hire agents to search and negotiate on your behalf.

 Win Players Over --> Win the Auction  
 Some targets care about your club’s identity, popularity or facilities; others care most about money. Build a club they want to join, then outbid your rivals.

 Create the Ultimate Dream Team! 
 React with tactical changes and substitutions as the match develops.

 Balance chemistry, individual strengths, fitness and assemble the right team.

 Balance the Books 
 Choose between signings, contract renewals, facilities and stadium upgrades, then set ticket, food and shirt prices to grow matchday income.

 Plan for the Future 
 Invest in better facilities to improve training and reduce injury risk, while developing your Youth Academy to prepare the next generation of players.

 Compete Season After Season! 
...

store.name: Bradley the Badger
store.short: Bradley, the beloved platforming icon, finds himself lost in strange new lands... and decides to fight back! Shape unfinished worlds with your game developer powers, explore a genre-bending story, and save your home in this unique action-adventure. Wishlist now and join Bradley’s journey!
store.about:
Bradley the Badger is a love letter to games . It’s an action-adventure that blends exploration, traversal and mind-bending freeform puzzles, all brought to life through a satirical narrative that features moments in live-action. 
 A beloved platforming icon wakes up to a world that no longer makes sense. Longing to return home, Bradley embarks on a journey to save his world and his friends at all costs, even if that means coming face to face with a revelation bigger than anything he ever imagined.  
 Across wildly different playable worlds, “inspired” by famous games but stuck in development hell, you’ll experience a unique narrative told through the enthusiastic, curious, and endlessly playful eyes of a videogame mascot. Will Bradley rescue Dreamwoods?

 Core Gameplay – an action-adventure like no other 
 You will explore, double-jump, solve challenges, fight with your trusted frying pan across unfinished game worlds that are very much in need of a creative spark. Maybe that’s what you’ll contribute to save the day? There will be items to collect, quests to answer, secrets to unravel. And as much as Bradley would hope that this is gaming as usual, things will definitely be unlike anything he has ever experienced.   

 The Kit 
 At the heart of our game is the Kit . It’s a tool that lets Bradley modify every unfinished asset he can find, just as if he was a game developer. It’s systemic, immediate, and completely transforms how you approach exploration, traversal, puzzles, and combat. It might even change the way you think about this game.

 Here are some functions you’ll...

store.name: Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000
store.short: Experience the brutal fusion of galactic strategy and grimdark warfare in Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000. Take command of iconic factions, customise your war machine, and engage in devastating battles as you carve a bloody warpath across the stars.
store.about:
WAGE TOTAL WAR IN THE 41st MILLENNIUM 
 Total War’s award-winning fusion of turn-based strategy and colossal real-time battles descends into the grim, science-fantasy universe of Warhammer 40,000.

 In the Era Indomitus, the galaxy is aflame with endless war, and every soul’s survival hangs by a thread. Take command of iconic factions, customise your war machine, and engage in devastating battles as you carve a bloody warpath across the stars.

 There is no time for peace. No respite. No forgiveness. There is only war.

 COMMAND FOUR ICONIC FACTIONS 
 Lead campaigns across the void with four radically distinct factions, each forged with their own unique array of lore-inspired gameplay features, devastating weaponry, apocalyptic war machines, and methods of warfare.

 ● Space Marines: Genetically enhanced weapons of war, these warriors are few in number but near unmatched in power. Clad in sacred armour and wielding the Imperium’s most deadly weaponry, each strikes with devastating and unyielding precision. 
 ● Orks: Brutish hordes of destruction, they are unrelenting, countless and live for war. Storming the battlefield in endless mobs, they brandish unpredictable weapons and clanking war machines - all driven by the primal power of the WAAAGH! 
 ● Aeldari: An ancient and waning xenos race, who once ruled the stars, but now rail against their certain fate. Swift and elusive, they strike with psychic precision and elegant weaponry, exploiting weakness before vanishing into shadow. 
 ● Astra Militarum: The massed ranks of humanity’s largest fighting force are a bulwark of...

store.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
store.short: Escape the ordinary with The Jackbox Party Pack 12! Embark on a party adventure with goofy greetings in We Forgot a Card, wild image warping in Hyperface, absurd arguments in Debate and Switch, team-based fact battles in Idol Factions, and mind-melding friendship in MegaPals.
store.about:
Escape to a world of hilarity with The Jackbox Party Pack 12!
 Our team of Chicago comedians and party wizards set out to create all-new concepts that bring the thrill to holiday gatherings, dinner parties, game nights, and happy hours. Travel between joke-writing, photo alteration, absurd disputes, and fact battles to create a night perfectly suited to your crowd. 
 We’ve tailored this pack to help you shake off your humdrum day and make your game night run like a dream. Only one person needs to own the game in order for all to play! Use your phones or web-enabled devices as controllers to make it easy to join and get started.
 The Jackbox Party Pack 12 arrives just in time for the holiday season and can be enjoyed on any night that deserves a special touch. Is it a Monday? Kick the week off right. The day you went to the dentist? Show off your clean smile. You have a bunch of stuff due tomorrow? Tomorrow can wait!

 Learn more about these five games:

 MegaPals (Speed, Guessing)
 A mind-melding game that celebrates friends both old and new! See how connected you are with your pals through impulsive wordsmithing and explosive match-ups. How well do you know how your fellow players think? (3-8 players)

 Hyperface (Head-to-Head, Photoediting)
 A game where you take selfies or use stock photos and warp them in wild ways in order to respond to bizarre prompts like “your face when you’ve just seen a bear.” Smudge, yank, squash, and draw on photos to create one-of-a-kind masterpieces meant to be shared! (3-8 players)

 We Forgot a Card (Design, Joke-Writing)
 A game where you...

store.name: SlotsNStocks
store.short: Rig the market in this deckbuilding slot machine roguelite. Draft hundreds of bullish and bearish symbols, build money-making combinations, and manipulate the odds in your favor. Adapt to an ever-shifting market and make enough to survive your next margin call.
store.about:
IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER  : SlotsNStocks is a roguelite deckbuilder built around the manic rules and imagery of stock trading. It is, however, NOT a gambling game or a way to learn more about the stock market or trading. You cannot win real-world money playing this game or receive real rewards, nor does the game have in-app purchases. The game is its own reward. Please enjoy! 

 Welcome to the firm. Around here, we don’t wait for the market to move. We make it move. 
 Draft bullish and bearish symbols into your machine, from Bulls and Bears to Whales, Rockets, Insiders, and more. Every symbol you add changes how your market behaves. 

 So make the right call. Build the market you’re willing to bet on.

 Make it work. Symbols fall. Patterns hit. Combos come and go. It’s your job to make them count. 

 Build combinations between your bullish and bearish symbols to trigger bigger payouts and turn your machine into a money-making monster. 
 Bull Run. Bear Raid. Market Maker. Every draft is a new opportunity to control the grid. Double down the set with Relics that can bend the rules, giving you more ways to push the market in your favor. 

 Fifty ways to get paid, a hundred ways to get completely wiped…

 Think you’ve got it figured out? Think again. 
 Every week, the market shifts. Symbols change, dynamics crash, and the strategy that made you rich last Friday could leave you broke by Monday. 

Just remember to keep an eye on what’s coming, prepare your machine, and stay one step ahead of the impending shift.

 Coming up short? You’re not out just yet. 

Be prepared to face off...

store.name: ZERO Sievert 2
store.short: ZERO Sievert 2 is a top-down PvE extraction shooter set in the ruined country of Zakov. Hunt alone or with a crew, face anomalies, bandits, and mutants, and make it out alive.
store.about:
ZERO Sievert 2 is a top-down PvE extraction shooter set in the Zakov Exclusion Zone . 
 Play solo or with friends across procedurally generated maps filled with anomalies, bandits, and mutants.
 Extract alive, sell your loot, and gear up for the next Hunt.

 Hunt solo or with up to four players. Move together, cover more ground, and back each other up when things turn south. Every Hunter gains experience in co-op, keeps their own gear and loot, and can pursue their own quests during the same Hunt.

 ZERO Sievert 2 sends Hunters across new and returning maps, each with its own threats, landmarks, and opportunities. Each Hunt changes the layout, but fixed landmarks help you navigate, find loot, and spot danger early.
 Conditions can change a Hunt in an instant. Day turns to night. Fog rolls in. Blizzards cut visibility. Acid rain makes every minute outside riskier , and on some Hunts, special events can block routes, draw factions into open conflict, or pull you into fights you did not start.

 Anomalies are one of Zakov’s defining threats, and Hunters learn quickly to test the path ahead with bolts before moving forward. They can be deadly, but they also leave behind crystals valuable enough to draw Hunters back into the Zone.
 Relics - new in ZERO Sievert 2 - are powerful objects linked to those same anomalies. Hunters can equip them for passive bonuses, and the most powerful relics can even grant active abilities. Every use pushes a relic closer to destabilisation. Push one too far, and it can trigger a Catastrophic Failure .

 Your Hunter develops through four skill...

store.name: Logic Arrows
store.short: Logic Arrows is a sandbox game where you design your own mechanisms: from logic gates to an entire computer. Use simple elements to build complex systems, solve engineering challenges and master computer logic.
store.about:
Each arrow performs a single simple operation on a signal, resulting in complex behavior. The game introduces you to the fundamentals of digital logic and computer architecture.

 Solve minimalist puzzles and watch the flow of signals.

 Or push the limits. Build calculators, displays, memory blocks, or even a fully functional CPU.

 There is no "right" solution, only your solution. Once you solve a puzzle, the real challenge begins: can you make it smaller? Can you make it faster?

store.name: Supreme Experiment
store.short: In a world abandoned by humans, machines have evolved into a new species—and found their own gods. Survive, explore, and fight to uncover the truth and realize that... nothing is what it seems. Perhaps, you can still save what remains of humanity.
store.about:
THE WORLD ABOVE 
 It has been a century since humanity retreated into the Spire Cities—towers stretching eight kilometers into the sky, high above the toxic clouds . Down on the surface, fleets of intelligent machines were left to maintain the world and supply the towers with everything we needed.
 Since then, everything ran on its own. No one remembers how it works anymore. The city above the clouds is the only world we know.

 THE SILENCE 
 But one day, the flow of resources simply... stopped . The machines fell silent. No signal. No explanation. Hunger and cold are creeping up the towers.
 Someone has to go down there and find out what happened. No one alive has ever done it before. You are the volunteer.
 But the world waiting below is not what we imagined. Not even close .

 GAMEPLAY FEATURES 
 Descent into the Unknown: Explore the forgotten surface world where machines have evolved into a terrifying new society.

 Atmospheric FPS: Immersive combat and exploration in a setting that blends high-tech ruins with primitive machine-cults.

 Uncover the Truth: Why did the machines stop? Hack terminals, decipher logs, and piece together the conspiracy.

 Fractured Reality System:  Your hacked neural implant becomes a gateway. Discover a sprawling parallel dimension triggered by cryptic QR codes scrawled across the wasteland—a world that evolves from a terrifying visual glitch into a deep, navigable realm with its own society and secrets.

 Nothing is What it Seems : The surface hides a secret that changes everything about the history of humanity .

store.name: Wall World Strategy
store.short: Build and lead a colony on the surface of an endless Wall. Manage resources and your people, develop new technologies, defend against relentless zyrex attacks, and send robo-spiders on risky expeditions. Keep the colony from collapsing – in Wall World, it's easy to fall.
store.about:
The Wall is a colossal structure stretching far beyond the visible horizon, hiding traces of ancient eras and unexplained phenomena within its depths. Here, among stone, metal, and darkness, humanity has been forced to build a new life – clinging to the Wall and trying to survive in a world full of threats and mysteries.

 Wall World Strategy is a colony sim on a sheer vertical surface, where every decision affects the stability of the system. Build and expand your base, gather resources, take care of your people, strengthen your defenses, and send expeditions into distant regions and unexplored depths. Each new step forward brings not only opportunities for growth but also new dangers. Survival depends on your foresight, your ability to manage limited resources, and your willingness to make difficult decisions.

 BUILD AND EXPAND THE COLONY
 Establish a base on the surface of the Endless Wall and gradually turn a small outpost into a large, stable, and well-defended colony. Plan the placement of key structures, develop production chains, expand living areas, and build infrastructure capable of supporting both population growth and stable operations.
 As your colony grows, you will need to decide how to expand, which structures to prioritize, and where to allocate resources – whether into production, housing, or defense.
 WITHSTAND THE THREATS
 The Wall is far from lifeless. In its shadows lurk zyrexes – dangerous creatures that will attack your colony again and again, testing its defenses, organization, and your ability to respond. Strengthen your defenses, secure...

store.name: Plague Doctor: Life in Pestilence
store.short: From an unknown quack to a reputable Plague Doctor, watch the plague unfold before your eyes. Gather ingredients, brew remedies, expand your clinic, and perform surgeries alone or up to 4 player co-op. Will you uphold the Hippocratic Oath... or watch the world rot and darken with every death.
store.about:
Appointed by the royal court to a remote village, you begin your journey as an unknown doctor. Build your reputation from a suspected quack to a reputable Plague Doctor, all while witnessing the spread of the plague day by day.

 Step outside the safety of the village walls into an open world filled with natural resources. Travel to lush fields, navigate deep caves, and traverse dense forests to locate rare medicinal herbs, mushrooms, and minerals.

 Identify and refine your gathered ingredients. Experiment with mixtures to discover potent medicinal properties, creating treatments that range from simple potions and pills to complex ointments and experimental injectable serums.

 Every patient tells a story. Listen to their plight, examine their bodies for symptoms, and establish a diagnosis. Your treatments require steady hands, ranging from basic remedies to invasive surgeries and medieval practices.

 Will you uphold the Hippocratic Oath, or decide who gets to live and who doesn’t? Choose carefully. The world responds dynamically to your success and failure. With every untreated patient and every death, the environment decays: homes fall into disrepair, fires break out, the weather turns turbulent, and nature itself withers.

 Immerse yourself in a village where every NPC has a unique life, schedule, and behavior. Get to know them as you treat them, or watch them succumb to sickness, or perhaps, to your own malpractice.

 Whether you bear the burden of the plague alone or share the task in 4-player co-op, the work never ends. However, when the pressure mounts, you can...

store.name: Legends of Rock
store.short: Start as a broke musician. Build your rock band, master songwriting, rehearsals, and gigs, and juggle a day job to pay the bills. Shop for records, instruments, and groceries, recruit bandmates, and earn your place in the Hall of Fame.
store.about:
Legends of Rock is a management game where you run your own rock band. Each day you choose how to spend your time. You will need to balance songwriting, rehearsals and playing gigs while holding down a day job to pay the bills, while surviving on instant noodles. 

 Shop for records, instruments and groceries, meet musicians around the city, and recruit your band. Record albums, earn points, and fight for a place in the online Hall of Fame.
 Ah, and remember to take a shower from time to time. 

 Your choices affect your character’s attributes. Practicing improves your musical skills, listening to music boosts inspiration, and skipping meals for too long will make you sick and lose time.

 Each band member performs based on their skill and practice. Songs have separate instrument tracks that play out differently every time - maybe the drummer nails it while the guitarist struggles. As your band improves, so do your performances. 

 The in-game band's music is composed by Arne Skagen ( Gluecifer ) and Anton Ruud. Special thanks to these amazing bands for allowing us to feature their music:  Sibiir, Slomosa, Svölk, Yoth Iria, Yesterdaze, The Good, The Bad and The Zugly, Beyond The Pale, Dekonstructor, Disgrave, Eyes of Disaster, Hitskrieg, Laarhöne, Miserate, Shlem, Syndrom, The Fuse, Tilintetgjort, Asunojokei  and  The Pink Eye And Grave Danger 

 Are you ready to be the next Legends of Rock ?

store.name: Fourteen Years of Flames
store.short: Fourteen Years of Flames is a story-driven FPS that replays China’s struggle in the Second Sino-Japanese War (1931–1945). Players embody 7 key characters and battle through 16 real historical events, experiencing the hardships and sacrifices over 14 years of struggle. Land weeps in 14 years of war.
store.about:
About Fourteen Years of Flames 

 Fenghuo Fourteen is a story set against the backdrop of the fourteen years of war, offering players a chance to return to the battlefields of the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression from a Chinese perspective. Experience once again the smoke of war that engulfed 400 million people in those turbulent years, a time when the entire nation stood united in its struggle for survival.
 Campaigns

 Fourteen Years of Flames presents players with renowned historical battles. Your journey begins in the rugged terrain of Northeast China and leads to the ancient capital, Nanjing, as you participate in the massive national anti-invasion war that spanned across China. Experience the sorrow, sacrifice, and heroism unique to that era.
 Weapons and Equipment

 Fourteen Years of Flames strives to faithfully recreate historical details, offering a 1:1 representation of the weapons, vehicles, and soldier gear used during the war. The game includes most of the weaponry and military equipment that appeared on the battlefields, from cold and hot weapons to various vehicles and gear.
 Campaign Scenarios

 In Fourteen Years of Flames , you will experience diverse and richly detailed campaign scenarios. The game aims to reveal the truth hidden behind the fog of history, bringing to life the solemn landscapes of China during the fourteen years of anti-invasion war. Each campaign offers a unique terrain and atmosphere, immersing players in the full intensity of the conflict.
 Looking Back at History, We Wish Our Motherland Remains Unshaken for All Eternity.
...

store.name: Zero To South
store.short: After the Y2K crash, take your taxi on the long road from Camp Zero to South. Pick up passengers, trade items, and survive the journey.
store.about:
You are a taxi driver heading out on a long trip across the USA. You need to find fuel, repair your taxi, and find food to stay alive. The road is long, so you will have to stop and loot buildings along the way for supplies, tools, and spare parts. You can use the items you gather to upgrade your car, improve its performance, add armor, and reinforce it for the drive ahead. If your car breaks down or you run out of gas, you are on your own. Manage your loot and use your resources carefully to make sure you don't get stuck in the middle of nowhere.

 The roads are dangerous. Armed groups block the roads to steal your items and money. You will run into these people often and you must fight them to clear the path. You have to defeat these bandits to open their roadblocks if you want to keep moving.

 Pick up passengers from communities and drive them to their destinations. In return, they will give you food, supplies, and other useful items to help you survive the long journey south.

store.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
store.short: Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow Rose Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.
store.about:
Medieval Paris, Where the Tolling Bells Herald the End
 1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.
 Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.
 Rose is soon swept up in the dark conspiracy that lurks beneath. Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation?

 Satisfying Whip Action
 Castlevania's iconic whip action is more satisfying than ever!
 Crack your whip to move around freely like a trapeze artist!
 Master the whip mechanics and be creative to pounce on your prey like a wolf in fast-paced combat!

 Diverse Bosses and the Arcana System
 Face-off against legendary bosses including Death, Medusa and Carmilla in addition to enigmatic new bosses such as Joan of Arc.
 Once defeated, bosses are sealed into Rose's tarot cards, turning them into Arcana - use their skills to cast spells and obtain unique special actions.

 Customize Your Battle Style with Weapons and Relics
 Customize Rose’s battle style by using a variety of equipment, including weapons spanning seven distinct categories and Relics that trigger powerful effects through both offense and defense.
 Combine equipment you discover through exploration to create your own playstyle!

 Iconic Castlevania Atmosphere, Reimagined in New Stages
 From iconic Gothic aesthetics to vivid, refined visuals, the game presents a fresh take on the world of Castlevania.
 Explore maps filled with...

store.name: Deluge: Raintime
store.short: Certain things are better left alone, they don't willingly submit to the games of man, but develop a grudge, that sleeps under the soil for decades— An interactive visual novel with psychological and lovecraftian undertones.
store.about:
— t here's something wrong with the lake, the lake that was once a sea. 
 I believe certain things are better left alone, they don't willingly submit to the games of man, but develop a grudge, that sleeps under the soil for decades— 

 Built on an artificial island, the university town of Bremersberg harbors abnormalities that lay hidden in plain sight. Follow William, an unassuming college student, as he grows increasingly obsessed with the island's secrets. Will William get a grip on himself, before his curiosity drives him to unfettered madness?

 ABOUT
 Deluge: Raintime is an interactive adventure game with psychological and lovecraftian undertones. Story-wise, it builds forth on The Raintime ,  a short indie VN released by socah in 2020. Introducing a mostly new cast of characters, Deluge: Raintime reveals secrets that strike at the core of Deluge Chronicles.

 In addition, the full release of Deluge: Raintime will contain a comprehensive After Story to Deluge, following the lives of Abe, Rika, Ina and Mei five years after the conclusion of Sermon for the Dead.

 FEATURES
 Carefully crafted mystery visual novel where choices matter.

 Beautiful human-drawn artwork, made by ていな and other artists.

 Immersive game world with fleshed out characters and countless settings.

 Different ending routes to explore.

 Non-repetitive, atmospheric soundtrack spanning multiple hours.

store.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
store.short: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.
store.about:
The ultimate kaiju arena brawler is back, completely remastered. From Atari and original developer, Pipeworks, Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered updates the 2002 fighter with enhanced visuals and quality of life improvements. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through 8 locations, each with day and night variations. Battle through real-world cities, Monster Island, and the alien Mothership. Face off against your friends in local co-op or new online multiplayer. 

Master your skills in cinematic kaiju vs. kaiju battles through familiar cities. Every monster has a distinctive moveset that makes each brawl unique, from vicious melee attacks to ranged energy blasts to special Rage Mode strikes. Tired of throwing punches? Why not throw a skyscraper, instead? The arenas are not just passive locations, and instead allow you to use the environment strategically in combat and even weaponize buildings and other landmarks.

The visuals throughout the game have been remastered from the ground up to enhance the cinematic experience of the original. Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered also features gameplay updates, as well as an improved unlock system, so you can unlock monsters, locations, and gallery items in any order you choose. FEATURES 
 The original 2002 Godzilla arena fighter, remastered. 

 12 Kaiju to choose from, each with a uniquely vicious moveset.

 8 locations, including recreated real-world cities, Monster Island, and the Alien Mothership.

 Gallery items to unlock. 

 Play with friends in local co-op and...

store.name: Scars of Honor
store.short: Scars of Honor is a free-to-play fantasy MMORPG where player choice, skill-based combat, and meaningful progression shape your legend.
store.about:
Set on the war-torn continent of Aragon, two alliances - the disciplined Sacred Order and the relentless Domination - battle for survival as an ancient Ice Dragon stirs in the frozen North.
 Choose your faction, race, and class, then build your hero through a modern MMO combat system, evolving talents, personal Scars, meaningful crafting, and endlessly replayable Evershifting Dungeons.
 KEY FEATURES:

 Fast, modern MMO combat that rewards positioning, timing, and decision-making. Master active abilities, react to enemy patterns, and outplay your opponents rather than relying on rotations alone.

 Shape your character with over 240 talents per class and permanent Scars that fundamentally alter your abilities and playstyle. Every choice matters, creating builds that feel personal, powerful, and distinct.

 No two dungeon runs are the same. Dynamic layouts, shifting encounters, and changing modifiers ensure each run offers new challenges, strategies, and rewards.

 Choose from unique races and unconventional classes, each grounded in the world’s lore and identity. Visual design, abilities, and narrative themes reinforce meaningful faction and character choice.

 Test your skill in Arenas and 5v5 Battlegrounds with equalized gear. Victory is determined by teamwork, strategy, and mastery.

 Craft, upgrade, and customize gear to complement your build and preferred playstyle. Progression supports experimentation, letting you refine your character as you grow stronger.

 A fair monetization model focused on cosmetics and convenience only. Power is earned through gameplay, not...

store.name: Reshine
store.short: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.
store.about:
Take apart, clean and bring new life to long forgotten objects in Reshine - a cozy restoration game that will take you on a journey through history, all within the safe space of your own attic.
 Reshine is a chill, relaxing experience. Simple and intuitive controls, minimalistic UI, straightforward gameplay. There are no complicated systems, no management, no stress.

 Listen to the rainfall, as you slowly work in a quiet attic, where the time seems to have stopped. Surrounded by relics of the past, take apart each object piece by piece. There’s no rush, you can follow your own rhythm, discovering how everything fits together as you go. With nothing to get wrong, you’re free to simply unwind and enjoy the process.

 The parts need to be restored to their former glory. Clean away the dust, sand down rough edges, and gently remove the rust using a variety of tools. Pick colors that feel right for you and repaint the surface until it looks good as new. Go in any order you want and just sit back, relax and watch the object come back to life.

 When every part looks like new, you can slowly bring everything back together. Piece by piece, watch the object take shape again. Before you know it, it’s looking like its old self again, or maybe even better.

 And that's it! Compare your final result with the object before restoration to see how much it has changed. You can repeat the restoration as many times as you want, to try different colors or just relive the experience. But, most importantly, more old treasures await you!

store.name: We Are So Cooked
store.short: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.
store.about:
IT WAS AN ACCIDENT. PROBABLY. 
 DEAD WEIGHT 

 A dead body is heavy, floppy, and incredibly awkward.
 Solo Struggle: Dragging the body alone is slow and leaves a bloody trail.

 Team Lift: Grab a limb each to move faster, but coordinate carefully—if you pull left and your friend pulls right, you’re going to drop him down the stairs.

 Physics Chaos: The body snags on doorframes, knocks over vases, and slides off laundry carts. Every step is a potential disaster.

 THREATS 

 The world is watching.
 Civilians: If a guest sees the body, they scream. Screams attract Guards.

 Security: They hunt noise. If they catch you with the body, it’s over.

 Eyes & Noses: Security Cameras watch the hallways, while Guard Dogs can sniff out the body even if it's hidden inside a locker.

 IMPROVISE YOUR ESCAPE 

 You have no weapons. You have no plan. You only have what you can find.
 Scavenge: Turn the environment into your toolkit. Find a Wheelchair to roll the body past reception. Use a Mop to clean up blood trails. Throw a Squeaky Toy to distract a guard.

 One Hand Only: You can hold an item, OR you can drag the body. You can’t do both. You’ll have to scream at your friends to open doors for you.

 UNIQUE SCENARIOS 

 You aren't just hiding in one building. Every environment forces your team to adapt to new physics hazards and AI threats.
 Crowded Public Spaces: Sneak through luxury hotel lobbies and balance the dead weight on top-heavy luggage carts. Just panic quietly when a nosy maid accidentally rolls away the laundry bin you used as a hiding spot.

 High-Security Compounds:...

store.name: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
store.short: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.
store.about:
PRE-PURCHASE CONTENT 
 Pre-purchase STRANGER THAN HEAVEN to get the “Dosu: Kagekiri” weapon to use in-game*.

 FACE DOWN FATE 
 A fifty-year saga of those with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. San Francisco, 1915. Our story begins as a young boy sneaks aboard a mysterious ship in the dead of night. 

 His name? Makoto Daito. Born to an American father and a Japanese mother, Makoto's world is one of harsh persecution, a fate cruely cast upon him simply because of his Asian heritage.

 After losing both of his parents and finding himself completely alone, Makoto, in an act of desperation, decides to risk it all and travel to his mother's birthplace. If the United States won't accept him for who he is, maybe Japan will...

 With nothing but the shirt on his back, Makoto soon learns, however, that his voyage across the Pacific is anything but a "free ride," and that this one choice will forever change the course of his life. What awaits our young stowaway in Japan? And where will the years take him next?

 5 ERAS, 5 CITIES 
 The story unfolds across a version of Japan that may have existed in another life altogether, immersing you in 5 sprawling cities, each modeled after real locations of their respective eras.

 1915, Kokura, Fukuoka: home of what was said to be one of the world’s largest foundries, a smoke-scorched town bursting with the passion of hard-driven, equally fiery workers.
 1929, Kure, Hiroshima: a port town dominated by Japan’s largest naval arsenal and heavily influenced by the presence of yakuza organizations.
 1943, Minami, Osaka:...

store.name: ROB RUN
store.short: ROB RUN is a brutal crime sandbox featuring thousands of players. Rise above everyone through the grit, the grime, and the struggle. Break free and take yourself from squalor by any means.
store.about:
ONLY REAL PLAYERS
 Every cop and every criminal is a living breathing human with their own agenda. And with 5,000 players around you, any situation can quickly get out of control. The cops are everywhere, and they pose a real threat. So, if an open fight is too dangerous, you can always find another way to get what you want.

 CLANS AND POWER
 You can survive on your own, but you can only thrive by working together. Create your own crime family or join an existing clan. Assign roles, organize raids, take control of territories, wage gang wars, and negotiate truces. In a place where anyone can betray you, reliable allies are your most valuable asset.

 NO ROOM FOR ERROR
 You risk losing absolutely everything every minute. Someone can easily take what's yours, but the same is true the other way around. To survive, you have to be able to plan, make quick decisions, and pull the trigger at the right moment.

 BRUTAL CRIMINAL UNDERWORLD
 Bank robberies, raids on rivals' hideouts, police chases, and bloody shootouts. Every day is a struggle for resources and influence. The only things that can get you anywhere are strength and cunning.

 YOUR HOME IS YOUR CASTLE
 Create your own hideout. Build and upgrade your base, store loot and vehicles, and place workbenches and safes. But remember: the more lavish your refuge, the more intruders you're going to have.

 TILL THE SERVER WIPES US OUT
 In just one week, you can go from being a regular thug to the boss of the server's largest organization. And then start over — with new experience, allies, and a more ambitious plan to seize...

store.name: 妹調教日記
store.short: ○学生の生意気な妹を調教するADVゲームがスチームで高画質化！

store.name: XenoFeels
store.short: You are a lone space customs officer. Every day, spaceships from different galaxies fly past your tiny asteroid. Tourists, truckers, travelers... Bad news: There are terrorists among them. If you miss even one, your home planet will explode. Good news: You carry a shotgun!
store.about:
A space customs simulator. You need to compare photographs and documents of aliens with their appearance and vehicles in order to find differences and identify the imposter.
 Spot the differences! 
 There's ALWAYS something that gives a terrorist away: an error in the documents, a poor disguise, fake license plates, or prohibited objects hidden in the car. Use these clues to expose the impostors! 

 Use the gun! 
 You have the right to use your service shotgun and no responsibilities! What could be better? Shoot at anything that seems suspicious. Don't worry about innocent victims; they can easily be written off as "collateral damage"...

 Try not to lose your mind! 
 The job of a space customs officer is hard and exhausting, so don't be surprised if... strange things start happening to you by the end of the day. Remember, it’s okay to hear voices in your head — just don't talk to them!

store.name: Carry the Pack Rack
store.short: One car, two drivers! Team up where one controls the steering wheel and the other handles the gas. Overcome obstacles through perfect coordination. Enjoy the chaos with local or online co-op. Can you reach the finish line without crashing?
store.about:
Can you drive a single car together with your friends? 
 Unique Coordination Experience: Share the gas, brake, and steering control with your friend to demonstrate true teamwork. While one of you watches the road, the other must adjust the speed. If your communication breaks, a crash is inevitable!

 Destructible Vehicle and Dangerous Obstacles : Your car is more than just a visual. When it hits a wall or gets caught under a giant piston, it turns into scrap realistically. Try to reach the finish line amidst crushed bodywork, falling parts, and failing mechanics.

 Features :
 Shared Control: Co-op mechanics split between the steering wheel and pedals.

 Online & Local Co-op: Play shoulder-to-shoulder on the same keyboard or online with a friend from afar. 

 Solo Mode: A single-player mode for those who want to test their own coordination. 

 Challenging Tracks: Moving obstacles, cliffs, and physics-based puzzles.

store.name: SONIC PICO PARK
store.short: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!
store.about:
Sonic dashes into the world of the hit indie game, PICO PARK!

 Experience the multiplayer co-op action puzzle gameplay of the PICO PARK series like never before! In our latest entry, the PICO PARK series is teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog!
 SONIC PICO PARK is a 2D action puzzle game where cooperation is essential!

 The rules are simple: just reach the goal plate on the right side of each stage. But the only way to succeed is for everyone to work together.

 This exciting crossover lets every playable character use Sonic's iconic Spin Dash, while adding classic Sonic-style gameplay elements such as rings, loops, and springs! Team up with your friends and take on these new challenges together!

 Just like the rest of the series, the game supports 2 to 8 players locally or online. All content can be enjoyed with any number of players! Online play also supports cross-play, and up to 7 local players can join online from a single PC.
 Combining the flair of Sonic and the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK, this one-of-a-kind collaboration is packed with fun for everyone... whether you experience it with family, friends, your partner, or even new teammates you meet online!
 Gather your squad and try it today!

store.name: Very Safe Dino Park 🦖
store.short: A chaotic 1 to 4 player dinosaur park sim where feeding the dinos, cleaning the mess, and surviving the chaos are all part of the job.
store.about:
Welcome to the Very Safe Dino Park.

 Who built this laboratory?
 Why are you here?

Your heart is full of love. The city is full of cats who need it.
 Save abandoned, homeless, and helpless cats. Give them care, earn their trust, and help them find a forever home - or keep them with you and build a safe sanctuary where they can live happily. Play alone or together with your own team of cat parents.

 SAVE CATS 
 Locate cats in distress on the open city map. Ride your bike on a rescue mission. Use the right tools and gadgets. Save poor, sweet little animals.
 Every rescue is unique. Every life matters.

 Bring rescued cats home and give them gentle care:

 • treat illnesses

 • help them feel safe again

 BUILD YOUR CAT PARADISE 
 Turn your home into a true cat sanctuary.

store.name: Totally Secure Airport
store.short: Totally Secure Airport is a chaotic co-op sim where you play as an airport security guard. Search through weird luggage and decide who flies and who cries. Documents? Check. Suitcases? Shuffle. Find troublemakers with your friends, but be quick - the airplane is taking off soon!
store.about:
DIVE INTO THE CO-OP MAYHEM

 Why ruin someone's vacation alone when you can do it with friends? Grab your squad and split the duties: one person scans, one barks orders, and everyone else tries not to lose their minds.
 DIG THROUGH WEIRD STUFF

 You’re the king of the metal detector, so start acting like it! Feel like confiscating a cactus? Do it. Want to deport a guy just because his passport photo is too smug? No problem. Your scanner, your rules.
 FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS

 Don’t overthink it. There is no need to make everything exceptional. Just follow simple instructions you’ve been given. Spot the banned stuff, stamp the papers, and keep the line moving.

 Search passengers together with up to 4 players

 An airport where you must ensure total security

 Crowds of impatient passengers

 Contraband in suitcases

 A cute little dog

 A stun gun

 Name badges

store.name: Probably Stolen - Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim
store.short: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and decide how far you’re willing to go to stay afloat. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.
store.about:
In a towering space station split by wealth and corruption, your business runs on merchandise with flexible origins. You’re a former scavenger who secured a storefront thanks to a generous loan and questionable timing. Now rent is rising, factions are watching, and most of your best margins live in legal gray zones. 

 You never really know who’s on the other side of the counter. Today’s customer could be a security fisher for evidence, a revolutionary seeking leverage, or a fallen elite testing your usefulness. Every sale is a gamble. Approve it, refuse it, report it, or look away; someone is always taking notes. Reputation buys access and protection, but it also paints a target on your back. On this station, every client is a potential profit and a potential trouble.

 Start as a gunsmith, chemist, water merchant, fence, farmer, or from absolute rock bottom. Every product line has its own profit curve and its own way of ruining you, weapons bring inspections, chemicals bring addiction, water brings liability, contraband brings raids. Some trades need heavy machinery and permits, others just a good hiding spot and a straight face. The better the margins, the worse the consequences when something goes wrong. You’re not choosing a theme for your shop, you’re choosing which kind of trouble you’re willing to monetize.

 Every item you stock carries its own risks. Cigarette packs need visual inspection before resale. Water must be tested and filtered. Weapons require permits and modifications. Profitable chemicals rely on closely guarded recipes. Rare items need proper...

 ■Refined Action and Strategy
 Experience the series’ iconic hybrid of real‑time action and command‑based combat in its most polished form yet. Seamlessly switch between party members, issue commands in Tactical Mode, and unleash powerful abilities and synergies to overcome colossal threats.
 ■Deep Customization and Builds
 Prepare your team for the battles ahead...

store.about:
Welcome to Hull Rupture. 
 The objective is simple. Keep moving. Whatever it takes.
 Manage resources, power, and human lives to keep the system running

 Build and optimize modules to defend the Despot’s ship

 Explore the galaxy and uncover dangerous opportunities

 Face high-risk decisions and adapt mid-run

 Mix 3 ships, 6 modes, and 4 difficulty levels for endless replayability 

 Earth is gone. Your ship is one of humanity’s last weapons - a living projectile racing toward the alien homeworld under the command of Despot AI, tasked with delivering final vengeance with a cargo of cooperative personnel.
 To survive the journey, you must keep the ship moving at all costs while it grows into an overengineered machine that converts resources, materials, and human effort into continued propulsion. 
 Construct interconnected modules to produce resources, repair damage, boost efficiency, and reinforce defenses. Every resource has its purpose. Humans included, while supplies last.

 Aliens don’t knock, they rip holes straight through your hull. You know exactly when they will arrive and where they will breach, which somehow still isn’t enough. 
Place turrets, traps, barricades, and automated defenses to funnel enemies into carefully planned kill zones while the humans assist. Each wave grows stronger and more aggressive, forcing you to constantly adapt your layout while expanding. Good planning reduces deaths. Poor planning distributes them.

store.name: Last Harbor
store.short: Zombie Apocalypse On A Boat. You’re stranded on a boat during a zombie outbreak in the beautiful San Juan islands of Washington State. How will you survive an open-world archipelago, where the living are just as much of a threat as the dead?
store.about:
Humanity has fallen. The undead roam the land and the few remaining survivors have taken to the sea in search of refuge. To survive, they must maintain and upgrade their boats, venturing back to the land they once called home in search of resources, loot and sustenance. But every expedition could be their last and it’s not just the zombies that are out for blood… 

 Your home, away from home: 

 Your boat is your lifeline. Your mobile base, your means of traversal and your last stand against the horror unravelling in the world.
 Upgrade your vessel to withstand raids, improve your crafting capabilities, house fellow survivors and navigate the world more effectively. 
 But keep in mind, while the sea keeps the undead at bay, you can only survive offshore for so long.

 The San Juan Islands of Washington State 
 Inspired by true events of spending the lockdown of 2020 on a boat stuck in the beautiful San Juan Islands of Washington state. Fishing, exploration, the feeling of dread while surrounded by beauty, and walking around quaint, seemingly abandoned town centers while trying to avoid other people. 

 We aspire to replicate this feeling of isolation as you navigate the abandoned remains of a cluster of islands off the US coast, teeming with the undead. Familiar weapons, zombie survival mechanics, crafting, basebuilding and exploration, set against a unique backdrop where your “base” is mobile and essential for survival and exploration. 
 Anchor next to an unexplored island, launch your dinghy and venture ashore. Stay alert of your surroundings, as other players won’t...

store.name: Cat Mail Co.
store.short: Run a cozy cat post office. Sort and deliver parcels from the daily boat, organizing everything your way. At night, the moon reveals hidden truths about packages. Clear a strange backlog, help locals, and unlock new abilities and destinations.
store.about:
A quiet island. A forgotten post office. And a mountain of undelivered mail. 

You arrive just in time… or perhaps a little too late. The former postman has vanished, leaving chaos behind: parcels piled to the ceiling, customers growing impatient, and a once-thriving postal service on the brink of collapse. 

One package at a time, you’ll bring it back to life.

 Cat Mail Co. is about slowing down and enjoying the rhythm of small, satisfying tasks. 

Incoming mail arrives by boat, and outgoing parcels must be carefully loaded for their journey. 

Sort deliveries for the right destinations, or risk having them returned damaged. Take your time serving customers, organize your storage exactly the way you like, prepare for the next wave, and keep everything running smoothly as the post office slowly regains its former glory. 

With each improvement, new destinations unlock, along with tools and abilities to help you manage the growing operation.

 Every package tells you how it wants to be handled… but how you do it is up to you. 

Weigh parcels to determine postage, apply destination labels, mark fragile or heavy goods, and decorate them with a variety of stamps. Functional or whimsical, every sticker you place adds personality to your work. 

There’s no such thing as a “correct” way but just your way.

 The post office doesn’t sleep… and neither do you. 

As night settles in, moonlight reveals secrets. What seemed ordinary during the day may carry strange properties after dark, offering magical insight into how some parcels should be treated. 

The routine continues, but in...

BASE BUILDING

 DEFEND

 SURVIVAL

store.name: ZONE L.O.S.T.
store.short: YOUR BODY IS YOUR WEAKNESS. A four-player co-op horror game that puts you in the shoes of the chief scientists of a research facility. Your sole objective is to carry out the self-destruct plan and escape the facility.
store.about:
ZONE LOST 
 YOUR BODY IS YOUR WEAKNESS. A four-player co-op horror game that puts you in the shoes of the chief scientists of a research facility. Your sole objective is to carry out the self-destruct plan and escape the facility. 

 PHYSICAL TRAITS 
 In ZONE L.O.S.T., you don't choose a hero - you choose your limitations. The game features four characters, each with unique physiology: one can't see what's on the table, another can't squeeze through a narrow opening, and one is physically bound to their chair. Your body is your greatest debuff. 
 INTERACTIVE ENVIRONMENT 
 The complex is composed of objects governed by the laws of physics. These aren't just decorations, but the only way to compensate for your vulnerability. Use tables, chairs, equipment, and office furniture to create visual barriers. There are no designated stealth zones in this game - you create your own lines of sight using anything that can be moved, rolled, or knocked over. 
 5 COMPLEX LEVELS 
 The entire complex is divided into five sectors. In each, you are assigned specific tasks:
 Complete tasks in each ZONE L.O.S.T. sector.

 Find and activate the Self-destruction Button.

 Evacuate before the ZONE L.O.S.T. complex enters the self-destruct phase

 THREAT WITHIN THE COMPLEX 
 You are not alone in the halls of ZONE L.O.S.T. Creatures that have escaped from their containment zones are tireless. They react to noise and changes in their environment. You have no countermeasures—only physical interaction with the objects and the ability of your team to coordinate actions despite each individual's...

 Different piggy types

 Random loot

 Upgrades

 Different Hammers

store.name: Takeover 2
store.short: Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.
store.about:
ABOUT THIS GAME 
 Takeover 2 is a hard-hitting, arcade-style beat ’em up and the sequel to 2019’s The Takeover . It features stylish updated visuals and a completely overhauled combat system, delivering tighter controls and significantly expanded gameplay depth.
 The combat system has been redesigned to provide greater player control and tactical options. Use the environment to your advantage by weaponizing almost everything you can get your hands on; buckets, cones, tires…nothing is off-limits!. Wield a variety of weapons to manage crowds and adapt to different enemy types.
 HARD-HITTING ARCADE COMBAT 
 Takeover 2 delivers fast, responsive, and aggressive action.
 Master:
 Combo chains

 Parry mechanics

 Special attacks

 Finishing moves

 Crowd control strategies

 Perfect combo runs

 Max out your skills to earn coveted S Rankings and to conquer the higher difficulty modes.
 GAME MODES 
 Takeover 2 includes three core game modes:
 Arcade Mode 
Fight through the full campaign which consists of a progressing gauntlet of dangerous stages filled with hordes of blood-thirsty enemies and intense boss encounters!
 Challenge Mode 
Plan your own route through several stages while engaging in fast, high-pressure trials with specific mission objectives and performance-based star ratings. Precision and efficiency matter!
 Score Attack

Your oxygen, power, and food all come from machines you set up and maintain, and keeping them running is a must for survival.

The tech tree gives you a long road from scraping by to running a base that mostly takes care of itself.
