 Swipe, Match, Message
It all starts on your in-game phone. Browse profiles on the dating app and read what each person does, what they're into and what they're looking for. Then swipe. When you match, they write first, and what they say depends on your own profile. Keep the conversation going, and if it's going well, ask them out.
 The Date Is Where It Counts
Pick where you're going, either coffee at a cozy cafe or dinner at a restaurant, and decide whether to bring flowers, chocolate or a small gift. At the table you talk face to face, order from the menu and see your food and drinks arrive.

As the evening goes on, you can make your move: hold their hand, ask for a kiss, share a dessert, ask them to be yours, or suggest leaving together. Every move is a real question, and they can say no .

At the end someone has to deal with the bill. You can pay, split it or let them pay, and every character feels differently about that. Characters Who Feel Real
Each character has their own personality, temperament, tastes, life story and memory. They remember what you said and how you treated them. Their Attraction , Trust , Respect and Comfort , and the Tension between you, shift with every message, and small notes show you when something you said worked or didn't. Their faces react as you talk: a...

store.name: Salt and Soil: A Frontier Family Sim
store.short: A turn-based colony sim set on the American frontier from 1607 to 1900, where you guide one family through generations as towns grow, trade routes shift, and historical upheavals reshape the world around you
store.about:
ONE HOMESTEAD. ONE FAMILY. THREE CENTURIES.
 Build a home, make a living, and leave the next generation something worth inheriting. 
 Guide one family through life on the American frontier in a turn-based colony sim spanning 1607–1900. Each turn is a year: put your household to work, develop your homestead, and decide how to meet the changes arriving at your doorstep.
 MAKE A LIFE IN A WORLD THAT KEEPS CHANGING
 Towns grow, borders shift, and trade routes change. Wars, migration, gold rushes, and the arrival of the railroad transform the continent over nearly three centuries. Watch history unfold on a map of North America as your family finds its place within it.
 New settlements bring new neighbors. Changing markets create opportunities and risks. Plan for the year ahead while adapting to a world that keeps moving beyond your fields.

 BUILD A HOMESTEAD THAT CAN OUTLIVE YOU
 Grow crops, raise livestock, build workshops, and trade what you produce. Divide your family's labor between immediate needs and plans for the future. Every new building takes resources; every task needs someone to do it.
 Expand production, improve storage, or prepare for leaner years. Decide what to keep, what to sell, and what your household can afford to risk. The home you build becomes the next generation's starting point.
 Your neighbors matter, too. Trade and cooperate with nearby settlements and Indigenous nations, build relationships, and deal with tensions and bandit threats that can disrupt your plans.

 WATCH YOUR FAMILY BECOME A DYNASTY
 Children grow up. Marriages bring families...

store.name: Sushiamo
store.short: Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!
store.about:
Sushiamo is a Balatro-inspired roguelike deck-builder where you combine unique ingredients, tools, and sauces to create crazy sushi and trigger game-breaking combos. 
 Find the synergy 
 Every ingredient has a distinct bonus and synergy with other ingredients. Experiment to find the best combo!
Build your perfect kitchen by collecting the right ingredients, tools and sauces to progress through increasingly higher scoring requirements and become a sushi master.

 Choose Your Path 
 Navigate through a map that changes every run, where every choice matters, take the safer path or risk it all for greater rewards. 
Encounter unexpected events along the way that can grant you game-changing bonuses or set you back.

 So much content to unlock 
 🌊 Over 300+ items to discover

 🎐 A market to discover your perfect setup

 🍥 Unlockable ingredients, tools, sauces and more

 Credits: Trailer Music by " Won Jong Hwa "

store.name: Oboro no Ichi
store.short: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.
store.about:
[A Market Between Memories] 

Welcome to Oboro no Ichi , a market suspended between memories, where lost souls seek peace.
Build, expand, and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, and shape a place that can grow alongside them.

 [Build and Grow Your Market] 
 Freely design your space, connecting stalls, buildings, and pathways to create a lively and harmonious place.
Each structure has a specific role: produce resources, supply your stalls, and grow your market one step at a time.

 (A Simple Yet Deep Gameplay Loop) 
 Find the right balance between beauty and functionality.
Organize production, manage sales, expand your market, and increase its appeal to welcome more and more spirits.
A relaxing cycle that is easy to grasp, yet full of choices, strategies, and combinations.

 (A Calm and Cozy Experience) 

In Oboro no Ichi , there is no rush.
Only the slow drifting of spirits, the sound of the wind…
and a market that grows alongside them.
Take your time.

store.name: Gun Restoration Shop Simulator
store.short: Run a gun restoration workshop. Take in damaged firearms, dismantle them, and craft missing parts using various tools. Unlock advanced machinery, restore each weapon to its former glory. Track demand, negotiate prices, and run a successful restoration business.
store.about:
Use a variety of tools to shape raw materials into detailed gun parts. Cut, drill, grind, and refine each component by hand.

 Restore weapons back to their original condition or modify them to match customer preferences with painting and finishing. 

 Take firearms apart piece by piece. Replace worn components or rebuild them entirely with newly crafted parts.

 Complete orders, manage customer demands, and deliver finished weapons through dead drops. Balance cost, quality, and profit to keep your shop running.

 Purchase new tools and unlock advanced schematics. Grow from basic repairs to full restorations and custom builds.

store.name: Dirt Clicker
store.short: Start with a spoon and a dream. Dig for treasures, unlock upgrades, get help from friendly pals and flip tools to dig up mountains of dirt. Will you find out what secrets are hidden beneath the dirt?
store.about:
Dirt Clicker is a super satisfying incremental digging game where dirt is your currency & buried treasures are just a few scoops away. 
 Start with nothing but a spoon and a patch of dirt. Dig your way through the ground, uncover treasures and build up your fortune by investing in better tools. Unlock a growing collection of upgrades, from shovels and pickaxes to jackhammers and beyond, each helping you dig up even more dirt.

 You can’t keep digging by yourself forever. Get some pals like the; Mushrooms, Frogs, Golems or any of the other creatures to keep it going while you focus on the more important stuff.

 Spend your well earned dirt in a massive skill tree, you can upgrade your tools & unlock ways to strengthen your pals. Every upgrade makes digging just a little easier and faster.

 When you've dug as deep as you can, it's time to Prestige! Reset your progress, turn your hard-earned dirt into precious worms, and spend them on permanent upgrades that reshape the way you play. Unlock new systems, discover powerful synergies, and turn every new run into an even bigger digging adventure.

 Every new layer has something new waiting for you! Dig up valuable treasures and rare relics. Some are worth selling, while others are harder to find and give you an extra boost. Open chests & equip your pals with hats that have game changing effects. You might stumble upon strange little surprises throughout the world.

 Shop for Tools, Pals & Hats

 Explore a Massive Skill Tree

 Prestige System

 Automate with Pals

 The Void Challenge

 Discover 100+ valuable items

 Discover Rare...

store.name: Casualties: Unknown
store.short: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 11 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.
store.about:
Survive a Harsh World  
 Each layer brings its own challenges, adapt and descend. 

 Simulated Limb and Cardiovascular Systems  
 Injuries are unavoidable. You will have to bandage yourself, fight infected wounds, and stabilize blood loss before losing consciousness. Additionally, your mood can greatly affect your chances of survival, too much doom and gloom will make your life harder. 

 Craft to Survive  
 As a creature capable of reason, using tools will allow you to travel the cavernous layers more efficiently. In case you start bleeding out, the flora will provide great resources to patch yourself up. 

 Explore at Your Own Risk  
 Previous expeditions have left some good loot behind. But even helpful things can prove to be your death.

 Uncover the Truth  
 What actually lies at the end of this journey? And what becomes of you if you are to succeed?

 Features 
 An entirely simulated cardiovascular and limb damage system

 Character traits to increase on your run: Intelligence, Strength, and Resilience

 Robust crafting mechanics to increase your odds of survival

 3 characters with their own distinct playstyles

 11 layers of an alien planet with their own challenges and dangers

 300 items to find on your runs

 Adjustable loot and danger values accessible on the main menu

store.name: Lost Media Agency
store.short: A found footage horror game where you need to piece together a timeline in chronological order of a Kaiju incident that occurred.
store.about:
You work in a secret government facility tasked with covering up mysterious incidents from around the world. This time, you’ve received fragmented found footage recovered from multiple devices linked to an incident in a small town in Latvia.
 Your job is to reconstruct the timeline and arrange the footage in the correct chronological order to report on the Kaiju incident to your superiors. 

 Main Features: 
 Analyze, rewind, and piece together lost media to uncover the truth behind the incident.

 Deduce the correct chronological order using subtle clues hidden within the footage.

 Immerse yourself in a retro PC interface designed to pull you deeper into the mystery.

 Explore your unsettling office environment.

 Approximately 1 hour of gameplay—depending on your deduction skills.

 Inspired by found footage films, this game largely reflects the experience of those genres.
 And remember: while you sort through the footage… your boss is always watching.

store.name: Grandma Left Me A Building
store.short: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.
store.about:
"We make our friends; we make our enemies; but God makes our next-door neighbour."
- G.K. Chesterton

Grandma Left Me a Building is a cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Pick your tenants, manage neighbor dynamics, upgrade the building, hire staff, and handle the chaos that follows.

The walls are crumbling, the pipes are leaking, strange noises keep coming from upstairs. You're in for a long haul, fixing it all with the rent you collect. But the applicants knocking on your door are just as strange: do you go with the opera singer who bursts into an aria in the elevator, the philosopher who answers every question with "but why?", or the eight-year-old who takes apart anything within reach and puts it back together about 20% of the time?

As you welcome all these eccentric characters into your building, remember one thing: they have to get along. Wrong pairings bring chaos. The right ones bring peace. Fix up the place, hire staff, handle whatever the day brings. Grandma will be watching.

 Review the lease contracts your broker brings and set the terms.

 Place tenants in apartments with their future neighbors in mind.

 Handle tenant requests and complaints before they pile up.

 Fix what's broken, open new apartments, and raise the building's value.

 Collect daily rent, pay salaries and bills on time.

 Hire staff: doormen, security, cleaners, and more.

 Handle unexpected events when they hit, live with the consequences.

 30+ unique tenants across 4 social tiers.

 300+ distinct character interactions.

 100+...

store.name: TARAE: The Unbound
store.short: TARAE: The Unbound is an action RPG set in an Eastern dark fantasy world. Explore Taegwido, an island born upon the shattered boundaries of the Six Realms, and master the distinct combat styles and builds of six unique classes.
store.about:
Sever Fate.  
 TARAE: The Unbound is a top-down action RPG set in an Eastern dark fantasy.
 Mercilessly carve your way through swarms of enemies, master the patterns of powerful foes, and overcome every challenge standing in your way.
 Cut Down the Horde Use a wide arsenal of skills and chained attacks to tear through the battlefield. Experience a combat system that hits as hard as it looks.

 Boss Battles Built to Be Mastered Learn the patterns and tricks of menacing boss monsters. Seize your moment to dodge, counter, and carve your path to glory.

 Relentless Action, Merciless Impact Every hit lands with satisfying force, making each fight exhilarating to tear through a mass of enemies.

 Combat Shaped by Your Decisions Combine class skills, traits, support skills, and gear into a build and playstyle that's all your own.

 Six Seekers, One Intertwined Tale Travel with the six Seekers, each carrying their own karma and purpose. Through countless trials, seek true understanding to become true allies.

 Journey Across Taegwido, at the Shattered Boundaries of the Six Realms Step into a world that reimagines Eastern myth, folklore, and traditional aesthetics, where beauty and mystery are entwined with darkness and brutality.

 Each battle and every choice shapes the path to restoring order to the Six Realms.

 Taegwido, an island born upon the collapsed Six Realms 
 "The Sources that can restore the cycle of reincarnation lie scattered across Taegwido." 
 The outcast Agasa shattered the boundaries to break the wheel of reincarnation. From these fractured lands, the island of...

store.name: Crimson Solstice
store.short: A cozy horror adventure. Uncover the mysteries of the Crimson Solstice and decide Moonvale’s fate. Build relationships and manage resources as time is of the essence. Spend your days wisely and help the townsfolk of Moonvale survive.
store.about:
The Town of Moonvale has been targeted by an unknown entity. A recent caravan attack has caused a panic to ripple through the village. Engage with various citizens in order to uncover the cause of recent unfortunate events.

 Events swell toward a dramatic conclusion, and preparing for the coming Solstice is paramount to survival. Your choices shape the fate of Moonvale, leading to multiple branching outcomes and many different possible endings. How will your story end?

 There exist many denizens within the town of Moonvale. Converse with each of them to learn more about them, their ties to the village, and the mysteries of the Crimson Solstice. 

 Scarlett:
 Friendly, charismatic, with a bubbly personality. Scarlett is the go-to individual for seeds, tools, and other supplies. Her time spent in larger cities has pushed her towards a quieter life in Moonvale. She may opt to offer additional goods and services as well to her close friends.

 Simon:
 The mayor of the town of Moonvale. Distraught by the caravan attack made on his people, Simon vows to set things right. His demeanor is often deflective or pompous. However, he has yet to do wrong by the citizens of his humble town.

 Ophelia:
 This energetic youth enjoys frolicking among the farm animals. Although her mother prefers her to study how to become a proper lady, she prefers to spend her days playing outside. Taking after her father in many respects, Ophelia wishes for nothing more than sunshine and long summer days.

 Blaire:
 A woman with what others describes as a healing presence. She has a known love of the...

store.name: Music Manager
store.short: Sign artists, develop talent, release music and steer careers through tours, festivals and changing trends in a detailed music industry management sim set from 1952 to 2026.
store.about:
Music Manager is a detailed simulation game about building careers in the music industry from 1952 to 2026, covering the history of modern popular music. Start in any year during that period and work across a global music scene, with playable locations across every inhabited continent.
 Scout talent, negotiate contracts, book gigs, send acts on tour, play festivals, record songs, release music, handle publicity and guide your artists through changing trends, shifting tastes and fierce competition. Some acts will need patience. Others may be ready to move quickly. The challenge is deciding where to spend your time, money and attention in an industry that never stands still.
 As your career progresses, achievements can unlock support staff who take over parts of the business, letting you focus more on the areas you enjoy most.
 If you enjoy management games built around systems, long-term planning and shaping your own story over time, Music Manager puts you in control of the decisions behind the music.
 Key Features
 Start in any year from 1952 to 2026

 Manage acts across the changing history of modern music

 Work across playable global locations

 Scout, sign and develop artists

 Book gigs, tours and festival appearances

 Record songs and release singles and albums

 Handle publicity, public attention, reputation and long-term legacy

 Unlock support staff through achievements

store.name: Metro Anomaly
store.short: Watch the behavior of the office clerks closely and find the one who is merely pretending to be human. You have only one bullet to survive this cycle. Make a mistake, and the anomaly will attack you.
store.about:
Metro Anomaly is an anomaly-hunting horror game where you must identify the anomaly by its behavior.
 An anomaly can be something as simple as an unnatural head turn or a twisted joint.
 But it can also be someone staring at you or even trying to attack you.
 ANOMALY EXAMPLE:

 Once you’ve identified the anomaly, you can aim and shoot — but you only have one bullet. 
 If you’re wrong, the anomaly will attack you:

 NOT EVERY ANOMALY WILL JUST WAIT FOR YOU TO FIND IT!

store.name: Cartel Pilots Wanted
store.short: Cartel Pilots Wanted is a co-op pilot job sim set in a tropical archipelago controlled by the cartel. Fly smuggling missions with friends, deliver sketchy cargo, and upgrade your aircraft. Master accessible flight physics and explore hidden islands with a chill criminal vibe.
store.about:
DELIVER SKETCHY CARGO

 After a wild night in paradise, you and your friends wake up on a remote island owned by a cartel. To start your lives anew, you must take to the skies and fly questionable missions for your new “employers”. Take contracts, stack cargo, and deliver it across a vast tropical archipelago.

 COOPERATIVE SMUGGLING

 If you’re going to take shady smuggling flights, you might as well do it with friends, right? Experience the life of a cartel pilot in co-op. Just don’t forget to grab a crate of cold beer before the next mission.

 PREPARE AND MAINTAIN YOUR PLANES

 Get your hands dirty in the hangar to ensure your planes stay airborne and reliable. Yes, it’s a chill smuggler life on these islands, but a well-maintained plane is your only way home.

 STYLE IN THE SKIES, STYLE ON LAND

 Express your style by customizing both your pilot and your aircraft. Choose from a variety of outfits and design custom liveries for your planes. If you’re going to be the most wanted pilots in the region, you might as well look good doing it.

 TROPICAL ARCHIPELAGO AWAITS

 Explore a vast world of sun-drenched islands and breathtaking ocean views. Navigate through clear skies or prepare to show your piloting skills when violent tropical storms hit the area.

store.name: Booster Pack Heroes
store.short: Rip open booster packs and pull your next foil hero in Booster Pack Heroes - an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Defend the tower from an endless onslaught of monsters and fight your way through the realms.
store.about:
OPEN PACKS. SURVIVE THE HORDE. 
 Booster Pack Heroes is an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Discover heroes and spells, upgrade their abilities, and survive endless monster hordes as you fight your way through the realms.

 OPEN PACKS 
 Rip open booster packs, each with its own pool of heroes and spells. Hunt for rare cards and build a collection powerful enough to crush the toughest foes.

 UPGRADE YOUR POWER 
 Survive to earn Mastery. Use it to upgrade your heroes and spells, unlock powerful new abilities, and turn your collection into an unstoppable force.

 SURVIVE THE HORDE 
 Monsters are coming for the tower. Fight through increasingly dangerous waves, unleash devastating abilities, and push your survival as far as you can.

 TRAVEL BETWEEN REALMS 
 Defeat each chapter's boss to unlock new booster packs, heroes, spells, and challenges. Every run feeds the next, giving you more power and letting you survive a bit longer.
 …and there's more to discover beyond the tower. Travel between mysterious planes of existence, each with its own secrets.
 The cycle has repeated countless times.
 You're here to break it.

store.name: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator
store.short: Run your own ice cream shop in a vibrant Caribbean setting! Prepare ice cream, mix flavors, add toppings, serve customers, keep your shop clean, restock ingredients, hire staff, and expand your shop from a small stand into a busy business.
store.about:
Experience the smooth, satisfying flow of ice cream in real time. Play in two dedicated modes:
 Classic : Enjoy a time management challenge as the business day goes on and you need to complete all your planned tasks.

 Cozy : Play at your own pace without the need to worry about the passing time, prep ice cream and buy ingredients as long as you want until you're ready to open shop again.

 Craft delicious ice cream from scratch using fresh ingredients, mix flavors, and create the perfect texture. Turn simple ingredients into tasty, satisfying ice cream delights.

 Customize the icy treats based on each customer’s request with a variety of toppings and combinations. Serve exactly what they want and keep your customers happy.

 Keep your shop clean while things get messy. A clean space keeps the experience sweet for everyone.

 Turn an empty space into your dream ice cream shop.  Customize your shop’s look and style to make it your own.

 Buy fresh ingredients from local markets, stock your shop, and keep your business running.

store.name: Voxotron
store.short: A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit and no brakes. Dodge, graze, and boost around a rotating cosmic cylinder where runs last 30 seconds and death is instant. Chase world records, race ghost replays, or play with up to 7 friends.
store.about:
A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit. 

 You pilot an insanely fast ship around a cosmic cylinder. There's no speed limit - only your ability to stay focused.

 No brakes. No speed limit. 

 This is not a game about slowing down. It's about going faster. There are no brakes. Brakes are boring. 

But there is a boost button. It's free to use, and it's always on the table. 

Going faster isn't a punishment. It's the entire point of the game.

 Short runs. Instant Death. 

 Most runs last under 30 seconds. If you hit something - you die.

 Three speed classes. 
 Prove your skill across three speed classes:

 FLOW - Plenty of time to react and learn the tracks. You can keep the boost pressed the whole way.
 HYPER - The boost gets serious. You can still probably hold it the entire run. 
 OVERDRIVE - Speedrunner territory. Insanely fast. If you can't hyperfocus and stay fully locked in, it's not for you.

 Insane skill ceiling. 
 So you can hold the boost the entire run. Good. You can still go faster:

 Grazing - near misses give you extra speed. The more you risk, the bigger the return.
 Smoothness - turning scrubs speed. Carve clean lines and keep the speed you've earned. 
 The Line - use the cylinder's curvature to find the shortest path and shave off milliseconds.

 Global leaderboards. Ghost replays. 

 You just got Gold after 30 runs on the same track. Then you check the leaderboard - the world record is five seconds faster than your time. You load its Ghost Replay.

 You know you can do better.

 One more run.

 Daily, weekly and monthly challenges. 
 Fresh...

store.name: Just Dying
store.short: A Roguelite survivor starring streamers. Rescue your followers to stay off the unemployment line, unlock unique characters, stack powerful runes, and become a wrecking ball of total chaos. Learn. Die. Repeat.

store.name: CINDER CITY
store.short: CINDER CITY is an open-world cinematic third-person shooter set in a fallen near-future Seoul. Fight alongside allies, push back against overwhelming threats, and reclaim the city from the forces tearing it apart.
store.about:
Take Back Seoul 
 Become a Cinderknight, each with unique abilities, and stand as one of the last lines of defense against the maniacal Hyde group, twisted Creatures, and hostile factions that strike without warning.
 The city has fallen. No ground is safe. Use your abilities, hold your role, and fight to take back what was lost.

 Fight with Tactics 
 Tactical Gear with distinct uses like drones and stealth. Vehicles like bikes, power loader mechs, and aircraft scattered across the open world. Your strategy and loadout decide every fight.

 Choose Your Missions 
 Epic story missions, side missions, and dynamic events fill the open world. Take on missions solo or team up with other players. The choices you make will shape what this city becomes.

 Every Threat. Every Scale. 
 Field bosses, instanced dungeons, massive world raids — the threats in Seoul don't stop, and neither do you.
 Divide roles, execute strategy, and build your character around your playstyle. Whether it's a dungeon run or a full-scale raid, co-op is where it all comes together.

store.name: Heaven Miner
store.short: Find outfits, fall in love with angels, and build a harem! Start a relaxing journey in Heaven Miner and build a unique harem.
store.about:
Heaven Miner is a lighthearted and adorable small-scale game where players help angels find outfits, form bonds with angels of different personalities, and build a harem!
 In this process, improve your abilities and form bonds with angels!

 Gameplay: 
 Search for angel outfits from all over the world.

 Collect outfits and give them to the corresponding angels to gain their love.

 Use the love you gain to upgrade your abilities.

 Game Features: 
 Over 20 interchangeable outfits.

 More than 20 levels, plus composite challenge stages after clearing.

 Seven angels with distinct personalities.

 Unique interactive story where you can knock angels on the head.

 Various functional gem combinations.

 Strive Strive to become a member of Heaven,
 but Heaven won't accept you!!

store.name: BOMBANANA!
store.short: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?
store.about:
BOMBANANA! is a chaotic, explosively funny co-op multiplayer game for three, where each player has only part of the information - blind monkey, deaf monkey and mute monkey must work together to defuse a bomb, or everyone goes BOOM! Will your friendship survive the ultimate test?
 MEET YOUR SQUAD! 
 🙈 Blind Monkey: You can’t see the bomb, but you can touch the bomb! 👍 Sadly, you can’t see colors or read screens. You’ll need to rely on your teammates for the rest. 

 🙊 Mute Monkey: You are the only one who can read the bomb disposal manual. If only you could tell the others what you know.

 🙉 Deaf Monkey: You can see the bomb and you can see your friends as they frantically gesture at you. Sadly, you can’t hear a thing, but at this point, would you even want to?

 As you gamble with your friends' lives, you must rely on each other and your monkeys' unique abilities. Communication is key, and there’s no one right way to defuse the bomb. We don’t impose any methods: wave, shout, throw bananas. Working out how you communicate is your job.
 WARNING! 
 Players can and should expect peak amounts of misunderstanding, unjust accusations, and desperate body language, placing your friendships in jeopardy. Just because you keep talking, that doesn't mean nobody explodes. Even if you manage to survive the bomb, there's no guarantee your friendship will. Some might call this game "friendslop". We disagree. If anything, it's a new genre: anti-friendslop, or perhaps an argument simulator. 🤔
 We’ll let you be the judge!

 FEATURES! 
 3-Player Co-op - No more, no less. Exactly three...

store.name: HANDS OVER
store.short: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.
store.about:
HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless trials become cruel tests of luck, nerves and trust.
 Take a seat at the table, play your cards, sabotage your friends and try to stay in the game while every turn puts someone under pressure.
 This is not a kids' game anymore. 

 Players are trapped in a cruel show, where they have to take their seats and face warped versions of games that once seemed like harmless fun.
 The rules are simple.
The pressure is not.
 Simple rules. Sinister consequences. 

 Press the teeth one by one.
One of them is the wrong one.
 That is enough to understand the idea before the tension starts. HANDS OVER takes instantly readable mini-games and turns them into sinister multiplayer mind games, where every simple action can change the match.
 Play dirty. Last longer. 

 Between turns, players use influence cards to change the odds, protect themselves, sabotage opponents and trigger chaotic events.
 A safe move can become a disaster in seconds. A desperate player can turn the whole table against someone else. Each card can save you, break someone else's plan or turn a safe-looking move into a problem.
 Every mistake leaves a mark. 

 In HANDS OVER , failure is not just a number on the screen.
 A bad move can cost you a hand, knock you out of the round, shift the balance at the table and turn the whole match against you. Every punishment is visible, clear and made for moments players will want to record, share and replay.
 The table is always watching. 

 Every match takes place in dark, oppressive rooms, among cruel devices, uneasy...

store.name: Alien: Isolation 2
store.short: Face your ultimate fears in the long-awaited sequel to the award-winning survival horror game, Alien: Isolation.
store.about:
When a survey team on a remote colony-planet discovers a mysterious crashed vessel, one member makes it her priority to investigate. No one is prepared for the horror unwittingly unleashed on the settlement. Nowhere is safe.
 So begins a desperate journey to survive and escape, as she is relentlessly hunted by the deadly creature.

store.name: Malignus
store.short: A dungeon colony sim where you play the dungeon itself: its Boss, its minions and the beasts in its caves. Dig out halls, wire deadly traps, and raid the world above for treasure. Then hold your hoard against the heroes who come to take it back. Play alone or in 2–4 player co-op.
store.about:
You are the dungeon. 
 Inspired by Dungeon Keeper and RimWorld.
 Your Boss rules from the throne. Your minions dig the halls, haul the loot and guard the prisoners, and they have opinions about all of it. Your caves fill with creatures to tame or eat. Raid the settlements above for treasure, then hold it against the adventurers who come to take it back.
 Rule together. Build one shared dungeon in 2–4 player co-op.

 Carve out your dungeon. Dig through solid rock, shape rooms, and fill them with workshops, beds, thrones, altars and traps.

 Command six monster races. Goblins, kobolds, orcs, gnolls, bugbears and ogres each bring their own strengths.

 Manage a dungeon full of personalities. Dozens of traits, grumbles and breakdowns mean your minions won't always behave.

 Turn your halls into a deathtrap. Dart throwers, spinning blades, flamethrowers, gas, electric coils and webs. Wire them to pressure plates, tripwires, sensors, levers and timers.

 Hold what you stole. Invasions grow larger and deadlier, with 6 adventurer races, 10 classes and more than 40 traits.

 Keep plenty of prisoners. Chain up the survivors and interrogate them for secrets. Your minions expect a proper dungeon to have captives.

 Raid the world above. Send your minions across the overworld, command every raid in real time, and face a world that remembers what you did.

 Choose your Boss. Rule with one of four Boss monsters whose powers grow with your hoard.

 Practice the dark arts. Cast Pyromancy, Electromancy, Necromancy and Shadowmancy spells, perform rituals, and bargain with dark gods for...

store.name: Hitchhiking to Hell
store.short: A hitchhiking journey through empty roads where every car could be your salvation… or your end. Walk through desolate places and encounter bizarre strangers along the way. Talk, decide, and survive unpredictable encounters as rumors of a roadside killer spread. While travelling towards the unknown.
store.about:
You are alone on the road, trying to reach an unknown destination. Cars pass by in the night, and strangers offer you rides. Some are kind. Some are not. Some should never have stopped at all.
 Walk through desolate highways, abandoned gas stations, fog-covered forests, and empty roadside towns. Meet bizarre, unpredictable characters who may help you… or make you disappear.
 Every decision matters. Every ride is a gamble.

 CORE GAMEPLAY 
 Hitchhike across a branching network of roads and stops
 Decide which drivers to trust… or avoid
 Engage in tense first-person conversations inside moving vehicles
 Observe, investigate, and survive unpredictable situations
 React through quick-time events in critical moments
 Manage survival needs: hunger, thirst, sleep, hygiene, and stress

 A WORLD OF PARANOIA 
 News reports talk about a series of brutal killings across the region. Radio broadcasts warn travelers to be careful. Posters appear in roadside stops with vague descriptions of a possible suspect.
 As tension rises, people become more desperate. Drivers demand payment, favors, or silence. Trust becomes a currency more valuable than money.
 And sometimes… you may not be the only one hiding something.

 SURVIVAL IS NOT ENOUGH 
 Talk to drivers
Escape from a moving vehicle
Be stopped by the police and questioned
 Walk alone through dangerous routes when no one stops
 Decide what kind of person you become
 But every action changes the world around you.

 WALK BETWEEN WORLDS 
 Not every journey happens inside a car.
 You will walk through:Desolate highwaysAbandoned gas...

store.name: Cat Caffeine
store.short: A cozy idle ASMR cat café that lives on your screen. Cook and serve customers dishes and decorate your café while you work or relax.
store.about:
A Cozy Café - Right on Your Screen!
 Your cat café lives quietly alongside whatever you’re doing. Let it run while you work , play , or relax - and enjoy the gentle company of your growing team of adorable cats .

 Cook Tasty Meals
 Prepare and serve a growing variety of delicious dishes at your café. From freshly baked cupcakes to gourmet cat treats , unlock new recipes and keep your feline customers coming back for more.

 Build and Decorate
 Unlock new furniture and decorations as you level up . Arrange your café however you like !

 Dress Up Your Cats
 Collect hats , shirts and glasses in the Wardrobe and give every worker cat their own look! Over 40 items to find , and every new hire brings an outfit of their own.

 Hire (or Fire) Your Staff
 Recruit cats to help run the café and keep things efficient. Build your ideal team - or mix things up by swapping workers to suit your style.

 Unlock Perks
 Discover perks that improve how your café runs. Add a tip jar for extra income, boost your earnings with decorations, or expand your team by unlocking more worker slots .

 Serve Special Customers
 Keep an eye on the door! You never know what special guests might pop in.

 Impress the Critics
 Complete tasks and the critics arrive , snapping photos of everything you've built.

 See What Cats Say About You
 Read the praise, collect coins from happy posts , and spot what to fix from the complaints - not enough chairs, a long wait, or a treat missing from the menu.

 Your Perfect Companion
 Keep your café anywhere on your screen while you focus on other tasks. Resize it to fit...

store.name: Crossfire
store.short: Layla and Cross are two opposing operators, divided by ideology but united in a fragile alliance against a threat neither can survive alone. Tactical freedom meets grounded combat in a narrative-driven cinematic action-adventure.
store.about:
Layla, a gun-for-hire, is on a reconnaissance contract in the Atlas Mountains that quickly devolves into a harrowing struggle she cannot overcome alone. Cross is an opposing operator, trained, lethal, and the last person Layla would choose to trust. But trust isn't the point. Making it out alive is. Fighting for survival and their own humanity, the pair's fraught alliance is the only chance at overcoming the existential threat ahead. 

 GRIPPING CINEMATIC NARRATIVE 
 Experience the journey of Layla and Cross, two opposing operators fighting for survival and their own humanity in a fraught but temporary alliance.

 COVER-BASED SHOOTING EVOLVED 
 Survey your surroundings and dynamically maintain cover with Adaptive Cover, our transformative new cover system. Stealth, engage, reposition, and flank. Together with Cross, use the terrain to outthink, outmaneuver, and overcome your enemies. With Adaptive Cover, the harsh terrain is another weapon in your arsenal.

 HIGH TENSION COMBAT 
 At any moment, a single bullet could prove lethal. Mastering and refining your tactical approach is your key to survival.

 A CINEMATIC LANDSCAPE 
 Experience the harsh, beautiful Atlas Mountains with a genre-defining traversal system. Use the world around you to endure the threats ahead.

store.name: VOID PROFIT
store.short: Fly a rented corporate vessel in a procedurally-generated universe, navigate risky routes, profit from changing markets before the opportunity disappears and you lose it all. Take jobs, navigate the markets, smuggle, lie. Do everything in order to keep flying.
store.about:
Void Profit is an Aetrocor -certified independent trading experience.

Under an active rental agreement, you are permitted to operate one (1) company vessel. Continued access is contingent on regular payment compliance. 

Operate efficiently and stay profitable.

 You are granted full discretion over your activities.

Choose the cargo. Select your destinations. Establish what risks are acceptable. Aetrocor doesn't interfere with your choices. Performance remains your responsibility. 

 Transit is not always the same. 

Routes differ in travel time, traffic and inspection pressure based on the factions controlling the area. Some are efficient and highly monitored. Others are slower and may have reduced oversight. Familiar routes may attract increased attention over time. Never rely on a single route. Operators are expected to evaluate conditions before departure. 

 All markets are subject to change. 

 Demand fluctuates. Supply shifts. As opportunities are utilized, they deteriorate. It is advised to take timely action. 
 Most goods remain tradable, but profitability is not guaranteed. 

Rental obligations remain unaffected as per your contract. 

 Interceptions, manifest checks, cargo scans, or other disruptions may occur during transit. Traffic density is not constant. Routes may become unstable or temporarily unavailable. 

Adapt accordingly. 

 Aetrocor does not maintain jurisdiction over the zones you operate in. 

Corporate territories, union-controlled regions, independent stations, and fringe sectors each maintain their own standards of enforcement, legality, and...

store.name: Desktop Oasis
store.short: Grow a little oasis on your desktop. Earn Inspiration as you type, work or study, and discover plants, boats, creatures and rare collectibles. Let it grow quietly while you’re busy; return to collect, check on your plants or play with floating objects and real-time water physics.
store.about:
Welcome to Desktop Oasis 

 A little oasis of your own, right on your desktop 
 Write a few lines, look something up or get on with your work. There can be a little oasis beside it all.
 Desktop Oasis is an idle desktop game made to keep you company during everyday computer use. Typing and everyday activity gradually earn Inspiration, bringing new creatures, plants, boats, decorations and collectibles to your growing oasis.
 A little company while you’re busy 
 Keep your oasis on the desktop while you get on with your day. It can quietly build up progress in the background as you work, study or browse.
 When you have a moment, come back to see how your plants have grown, where a boat has drifted or what’s new in your collection. Or just listen to the water and watch the little things float by.

 Spend a moment playing on the water 
 Boats, logs and rafts move with the water and bump into one another. Drag an interactive floating object somewhere new, let go and see how the water responds.
 Real-time water physics gives these small interactions a playful touch. Alongside collecting and growing, there’s room to simply play for a while.

 Something new to come back to 
 Watch small plants grow, set a waterwheel turning and spend your Inspiration to unlock scene objects and discover new collectibles.
 Some objects keep producing Inspiration and can also be clicked to collect it once their conditions are met. When their production cycle is complete, they leave to make room for the next round of objects.
 Tend a plant today; discover a missing collection entry tomorrow. Get to...

store.name: MECCHA CHAMELEON
store.short: Paint yourself to blend in! "Meccha Chameleon" is a new-sensation hide-and-seek game where you paint your white body to mimic the stage. Spot, pose, and "artistic skill" are keys to survival. Deceive Seekers with techniques that put chameleons to shame! Supports public matches and streaming.
store.about:
Paint your own body! Blend in like a chameleon in this hide-and-seek game!
 yeah! Mechcha "Hide and Seek" 
 The rules are simple. Split into the Seeker team and the Hider team to play hide-and-seek. The Seekers win if they find everyone within the time limit.
 yeah! Mechcha "Paint" 
 The way you hide is a bit special. Paint your pure white body to blend into the stage. Just like a chameleon. The hiding spot, the pose, and above all, your artistic skills are the key! Deceive the Seekers' eyes with a mimicry that would even surprise a chameleon.
 yeah! Mechcha "Matching" 
 Of course you can play with friends, but you can also play with people you don't know. (If you create a server that is not set to private, anyone can join freely.) Game streamers can easily host viewer participation games. The maximum number of players depends on the host's network environment. (2–10 players recommended. This may increase or decrease based on future playtests.)
 [About Videos and Streaming] 
 Gameplay videos and streaming are welcome. Please check the following two points:
 Include the name of this game in the title. (Required)

 Include the Steam store page URL in the description. (Optional)

store.name: Happy Wheels
store.short: Choose your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory.
store.about:
Happy Wheels is a side-scrolling, physics-based, community driven sandbox game, now (finally) available, ad-free, on Steam. Select your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory. Choose from more than 5 million user created levels or create and share your own.

 Features 
 Fully featured Level Editor -- build and share your own courses

 Play new, daily user submitted levels, sorted and ranked through the interactive Level Browser

 Multiple playable characters, each with unique vehicles and underwhelming abilities

 Life ending obstacles. Lack of adequate reward. Why even do this?

 NEW*   Level Browser Select Date feature, for deep dive into ancient levels of the forgotten past

 NEW* Unsavory Steam Achievements and Stats

 NEW* Link your old Happy Wheels account to your Steam ID, auto login on multiple devices

 NEW* Added controller support

 NEW*  Download levels for offline play

 NEW*  Complete lack of ads, I don't like ads

store.name: Elven Huntress: Sunveil
store.short: An atmospheric action RPG about an elven huntress exploring fantasy worlds through magical portals. Fight, collect rare equipment, and improve your character.
store.about:
Elven Huntress: Sunveil is an atmospheric third-person 3D action RPG with exploration, loot, crafting, and character customization.

 Play as an elven huntress, explore fantasy locations through magical portals, fight orcs, humans, and the undead, find rare equipment, and improve your character.

 Explore a fantasy world
 Travel through the portal to a variety of locations:
 Snow-covered mountain ruins.

 Coniferous forests.

 Ancient fortresses.

 Dungeons.

 Dark lands of the undead.

 Fight enemies, gather resources, unlock new equipment, and improve your character.

 Create your own elven huntress
 Use the character creator, customize your appearance, and collect unique sets of equipment.

 Sunveil Fortress
 Sunveil is your main hub and progression center.
 Between raids, upgrade your fortress and unlock new features:
 Weapon and armor crafting.

 Alchemy and potion making.

 Equipment transmogrification.

 Item enhancement with runes.

 Shop.

 Character progression system.

 Elven Huntress: Sunveil is an atmospheric single-player adventure with a beautiful protagonist, enjoyable progression, and a world you'll want to return to.

store.name: Swords of Legends
store.short: Swords of Legends is a single-player action-adventure RPG set in the primordial age, a world drawn from the strange tales of classical Chinese literature, where mortals, gods, and wandering souls walk the same earth.
store.about:
Swords of Legends is a single-player action-adventure RPG set in the primordial age, a world drawn from the strange tales of classical Chinese literature, where mortals, gods, and wandering souls walk the same earth. 
 From Aurogon Shanghai, this is the official sequel to the Gujian series, carrying its signature storytelling and artistry to a new adventure.

 As an Arbiter of the Underworld, you can unleash mystical techniques, summon spirit creatures, and wield an arsenal of weapons — each with its own playstyle, from the swords of the living to the artifacts of the dead.
 Read your enemies' weakness, weave your powers, and bring down all who cross your path.

 Step into a world born of ancient Chinese myth, where the gods, demons, and beasts of The Classic of Mountains and Seas (Shan Hai Jing) walk the earth once more - rendered in cinematic detail on Unreal Engine 5.
 Lotus ponds at first light, weathered temples drifting with leaves, lonely inns glowing in the mountains. Flower-spirits, headless ghosts, beauties with painted skin — alive down to the last brushstroke, all bound into a tale that spans the mortal realm and the underworld.

 Not every soul wants to leave. Some still cling to a final wish. Defeat them. Hear them out. Lay their burdens to rest — and the spirit you once fought will walk beside you, bringing a story, a power, and a voice all their own.
 Their tales are mirrors. The longer you walk together, the more of their past comes to light. Each one is a question for your own road: what kind of life do you want to live?

 About Aurogon Shanghai 
 A...

store.name: Arknights: Endfield
store.short: Arknights: Endfield is a 3D real-time strategy RPG from Gryphline. You will take on the role of the Endministrator of Endfield Industries, explore Talos-II, and defend and expand the frontiers of human civilization.
store.about:
Endministrator, Welcome to Talos-II!
 Arknights: Endfield is a 3D real-time strategy RPG from Gryphline. 
 On the planet [Talos-II], visitors to this world, the earliest settlers, braved wars and disasters. Through over 150 years of relentless effort, they rebuilt a foundation for humanity: the [Civilization Band]. 
 Yet most of this world remains untamed. Vast wildlands and uninhabited territories stretching toward the horizon still await exploration. The shadows of the past still linger, while new threats have quietly emerged. 
 As the Endministrator of Endfield Industries, use AIC Factory technologies and collaborate with your operators to build and expand a new homeland for humanity.

 Explore Talos-II, Build a New Homeland
 Venture into the soaring peaks and snaking waterways of Talos-II, where discoveries lie at every turn. Neutralize Ankhor threats, purify the Blight, overcome crises through exploration, and continue AIC construction to bring prosperity back to this land.

 Meet Operators, Journey Together
 No one stands alone. As you explore Talos-II, you'll meet operators with distinct personalities. Work alongside them to build a new home for humanity.

 Unleash Your Creativity, Build an AIC Factory
 Take control of Endfield Industries' versatile facilities. Follow existing production layouts or devise your own sophisticated, highly efficient automated production lines. Let your industrial capacity power every exploration and battle. Savor the joy of building from scratch.

 Coordinate Combos, Fight Side by Side
 Lead your team into battle, moving them freely and...

store.name: Dead Sector
store.short: Run your own data center. Design server boards component by component and use your boards space wisely. Wire power and network throughout your floor to form specialized clusters, and dispatch contracts to your custom hardware. Scale from a single rack to a massive redundant, multi-cluster operation.
store.about:
One empty floor. One client. Build it into the backbone of the cloud
 You begin with a bare room and a single server you assembled by hand. Grow it into a sprawling enterprise data center: rows of hundreds of racks, redundant power and networking, massive storage fabric, and a steady stream of clients pushing heavy workloads across hardware you designed yourself every day. 
 Design your own servers
 You do not buy servers off a shelf. You build them.

 Choose every piece of hardware and where it goes: processors, memory, storage drives, network cards, GPUs, and enterprise AI accelerators, each with its own cost, performance, and power draw.

 Build the right server for the work. A server tuned for log processing is wasted money on an AI training run.

 Unlock new chassis, board form factors, appliances and more as you grow, from compact single socket nodes to dense intertwined GPU, CPU and storage clusters.

 Build out the facility
 A great server is nothing without the room around it, and this is where the real engineering begins.
 Lay out your floor rack by rack and slot your servers into place.

 Feed them power through UPS units and distribution panels, but mind your circuits, because a single overloaded run can make an entire aisle of servers go dark. 

 Stitch it all together using network appliances and cables, storage fabrics and more to form the networks and clusters each workload demands.

 Sign clients. Deliver uptime
 Customers arrive with real workloads: web hosting, video rendering, cold storage, financial trading, cloud gaming, and more. Take on what your...

store.name: JOHN GLEEP
store.short: JOHN GLEEP is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.
store.about:
JOHN GLEEP is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

 How’s one alien supposed to steal resources and citizens from unsuspecting planets while managing a failing casino full of involuntary gamblers? At the same time, obviously. Zip across the planet to abduct everyone while avoiding high-alert attacks from Captain Missile. Fill your bouncy gambling empire with every abductee and watch them tumble around while you deal with distractions. Also you’re gonna be defusing bombs. And squashing bugs. And ignoring virtual meetings. And probably a bunch of other stuff at the same time. 

 Every planet ransacked is another day closer to your debt being collected on by the nefarious dentist/mob boss Joey Norp. Maximize profits by upgrading and customizing your casino with pegs from the gacha machine. Use the Junk and Gadgets you find on each planet to bolster your ship or activate distracting new abilities. Don’t forget to fuel up that Hyperdrive, though - escaping to a new star system means more planets to raid, and more time to pay off the mob. 

 Failure to pay means game over for John Gleep. Or does it? A new run means new casino combos, new planets to discover, and another chance at clearing your debt. If you work hard enough, you might even encounter helpful companions you can earn a variety of permanent upgrades from. You could also listen...

store.name: Legend of Defenders
store.short: A thrilling idle tower defense game with automated battles and endless growth, and enjoy a pure single-player experience with zero in-app purchases! Build your defenses, deploy heroes, and watch your fortress evolve from a humble outpost into an unstoppable stronghold—even while you’re away.
store.about:
Enjoy a pure single-player experience with zero in-app purchases, build a powerful defense with heroes and turrets, and protect your castle from endless monster waves! Your heroes and turrets will continue fighting in the background while resources accumulate automatically over time.
 As monsters grow stronger, you'll need to upgrade your defenses, adjust your strategy, and make the most of your ultimates.
 Every battle strengthens your lineup and fortifies your castle, helping you build an unstoppable stronghold that keeps monster waves at bay. The game also supports a boss key, allowing you to instantly hide the game window whenever needed.

 Recruit new heroes, pair them with turrets, and build the ultimate defense team.
 Every unit brings unique abilities and strengths to the battlefield. Mix elements, attack styles, and crowd control effects to discover powerful combinations.
 Whether you prefer steady firepower to hold back monster waves, devastating area attacks to sweep the battlefield, or explosive bursts to bring down elite foes, you can shape a playstyle that’s uniquely yours.
 Experiment with different lineups, adjust your defenses, and find the combination that works best for you!

 Every idle reward helps fuel your growing army. Gold, experience, and talent points can be invested into upgrading your heroes, turrets, and castle. Skill trees, treasures, and equipment provide even more ways to customize your lineup and strengthen your defenses.
 Resources continue to accumulate while you’re away, letting you return ready for greater challenges. There’s no need...

store.name: Guild Wars 3™
store.short: Guild Wars 3 is an action-adventure MMORPG, a modern evolution of the genre that blends rich action-combat, character building, and skill collection. Set in the enchanting frontier of Orr, the world brims with mystery, magic, and wonder.
store.about:
Become a Vaelwarden, a guardian of the land of Orr, protector of the people and spirits that call Orr home. Discover untold stories and forge lasting bonds with your fellow players as you glide, leap, sprint, and ride your way across a frontier with adventure around every corner.

 A Modern Evolution of the MMO
 Master a combat system where depth is achieved through strategic skill use, positioning, and movement – where action RPG combat meets Guild Wars build-making – creating a unique combat experience.

 Run, slide, leap, and bound across Orr with a one-of-a-kind movement system that transfers your momentum between modes of travel, providing a free-form joy of movement through a world alive with adventure.

store.name: King in the Mountain
store.short: A resource management incremental mining game where you rebuild your Mountain Hall. Plan each descent, choose where your dwarves dig, gather gold and rare artifacts, and return home when the torch burns out. Manage production, upgrade your crew, dig deeper, and bring your fallen kingdom back to life
store.about:
King in the Mountain is a resource management incremental mining game about an exiled king rebuilding his lost kingdom one expedition at a time.
 A forgotten mountain hides the gold, gems, and ancient artifacts your royal family needs to rise again. Rebuild your Mountain Hall between expeditions, choose where your dwarves should dig, and watch them carve through the earth on their own until the torch burns out. 
 Plan the mine, collect what you can, return when the light dies, then spend your treasure on better tools, more dwarves, and the next descent into the mountain. 
 Rebuild the Mountain Hall  
 Your Mountain Hall is the heart of your fallen kingdom. Build and arrange rooms, place workshops like smelteries, ore mines, and kitchens, hire more dwarves, and prepare your kingdom for deeper expeditions into the mountain.

 Plan the Mine  
 Pick where your dwarves should dig and let them work. Every expedition is a balancing of timing, efficient routes, and greed. Go straight for the gold or push deeper before the torch fades.

 Beat the Torch  
 Each dig lasts only as long as your torch keeps burning. Grab enough treasure, get your dwarves out, and return richer than before.

 Upgrade and Repeat  
 Hire more dwarves, improve your tools, extend your torchlight, and make every expedition more efficient. Each run brings your fallen kingdom a little closer to life. 

 No Fighting. Just Mining 
 No monsters or combat. Just the satisfying rhythm of planning, digging, upgrading, and watching your dwarven operation grow from a desperate expedition into the foundation of a new...

store.name: Lords of the Fallen II
store.short: Lords of the Fallen II is a dark fantasy action-RPG where brutal, soulslike combat meets a world splitting at its core. Battle against the darkness in an epic adventure across a shattered kingdom. One world. Two realms. No mercy.
store.about:
A thousand years have passed since the Great Rupture. 

Realm by realm, nation after nation, the Umbral darkness has consumed all in her path. One Kingdom remains - a sacred land shrouded by an ancient force. For a time, mankind found sanctuary in this haven, but as light fades, darkness rises, and now, the Eternal Night draws near. 

A hero must rise, for a God to fall.

Journey across a vast, war-torn kingdom crumbling from within, as the realms of living and dead bleed into one. From moonlit citadels to time-ravaged temples, tread carefully, for each step forward may well be your last. 

Engage in intense, soulslike battles where every strike counts thanks to a fast, fluid and aggressive combat system. Whether steel or sorcery, melee or ranged, experiment with countless builds to overcome each unique enemy encounter before delivering an arena-drenching execution. 

Confront colossal abominations forged in a world without hope and void of mercy. Each distinct boss battle showdown will prove a gruelling test of skill, grit, and will. Though aid is at hand, should you seek it…

As bearer of the Umbral lamp, you have the ability to pass between the realms of the living and the dead, each with its own pathways, treasures, and of course, nightmarish creatures. But even greater, darker powers await you on this journey… 

Journey through Thorngar alone or alongside a fellow Lampbearer in seamless online co-op. Both players will save all mainline progression in shared campaign mode, or join a casual session to simply lend a fellow crusader a helping hand.

store.name: PITH
store.short: Traverse a wonderful and strange world, find playful tools, and uncover secrets in PITH, a metroidbrainia/puzzle-platforming adventure full of twists and surprises.
store.about:
Traverse a wonderful and strange world, find playful tools, and uncover secrets in PITH, a metroidbrainia/puzzle-platforming adventure full of twists and surprises. 

 Discover 
 Jump through tiny interconnected worlds

 Uncover tools to help you on your journey

 Choose how to explore a non-linear world

 Observe 
 Some entities you will encounter are not friendly...

 You will have to retrace your steps to previously visited worlds to uncover new pathways

 Keep your eyes peeled - you never know where something might be hiding

store.name: Carry On Together
store.short: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?
store.about:
Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players.
 Start a small delivery company with your friends, take on moving jobs and try to get every item to its destination in one piece. Break the furniture, crash the truck, lose all your earnings or hold it together as a team. Can you keep the company alive?
 LIFT TOGETHER 
 Some items are too heavy to carry alone. Stretch out your arms, sync up with your teammates and lift together with physics-based controls. Couches, fridges, pianos and giant boxes all need teamwork. Watch out for tight corridors, slippery stairs and that one friend who lets go at the worst possible moment.

 DRIVE THE TRUCK 
 Load the delivery truck, pick a driver and hit the road. Enjoy the view on the way, but stay alert: one sharp turn and the whole cargo flies. The road might be the most dangerous part of the job. Do you trust your driver?

 EVERY LOCATION IS A NEW DISASTER 
 From suburban houses with wide gardens to multi-story office buildings, from narrow apartment hallways to mountain dirt roads, every location brings its own kind of chaos. Fit the sofa in the elevator, roll the rock off the road, squeeze the wardrobe through the garden gate.

 GROW YOUR COMPANY 
 Every successful delivery earns money, and every broken item costs you. Upgrade your company, take on bigger jobs and prove you're the best (or worst) movers in town.

store.name: Leviathan: Rhino
store.short: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.
store.about:
There are things beyond our control. Changes that cannot be resisted. Sometimes, all we can do is leave, or stay and watch everything we loved disappear.
 In this world, leviathans, colossal creatures of Lovecraftian scale, have long since become part of everyday life. They cannot be stopped. Humanity can only track their movements and get out of their way in time. But for some, there is nowhere left to go and no reason to leave.

 Explore a small village from a first-person perspective, talk to its residents, and carry out simple everyday tasks.
 Feed the cow. Visit your neighbor. Listen to the news. Remember the past. Wait.

 Leviathan: Rhino is an existential horror game about inevitability, attachment, loneliness, guilt, and the fragile hope that even at the very end, there may still be light.

store.name: The Citadel Project
store.short: The Citadel Project is a first-person stealth game with lite RPG/Adventure elements, inspired by Thief and Dark Messiah and set in a dark fantasy world. Use your tools and surroundings wisely, stay hidden in the shadows, and uncover the dark secrets behind the Citadel's downfall.
store.about:
The Citadel Project is a solo-developed stealth game with lite RPG/Adventure elements. Set in a Dark Fantasy environment, you are at a disadvantage in direct combat and have no magic spells to back you up... Use stealth, assassination, and many tools at your disposal to survive and avoid danger.

 The Citadel Project, the last line of defense built by the Ancient Kings in an attempt to preserve what remains of humanity in the face of the Great Storm. Unfortunately, an evil force is consuming it from within... Will you be able to navigate the nightmarish, labyrinthine architecture of this mega-structure and uncover what happened?
 You are nobody, just a simple prisoner who manages to escape from a cell deep within the Citadel. With only a few tools at your disposal, you must survive and find your way through its alleys and labyrinths, now turned deadly.
 Master the shadows 

 You must remain silent and, above all, unseen by the many dangers lurking within the Citadel. The Citadel Project features a complex lighting system that dynamically calculates your exposure to every light source, allowing you to take advantage of every area of darkness, or even create your own using the tools at your disposal.
 Eliminate your enemies 

 These infected guards and civilians are a real threat, and the infection makes it impossible to kill them by normal means, but if you are stealthy enough, you can tear out the gangrenous growths on their backs. Be careful, don't leave bodies in plain sight, or the entire area will be alerted...

 Use your brain, push away 

 Even if you can't fight and...

store.name: Imperium
store.short: Imperium is a single-player 4X space strategy game. Colonize alien worlds, design your own spaceships, research exotic technologies, and outmaneuver rival empires through diplomacy or open war. Build a galactic empire and rule it your way.
store.about:
Imperium is a single-player 4X space strategy game about building a civilization among the stars. Begin with one colony and a single home star, then expand across a galaxy of alien worlds - researching exotic science, designing your own fleets, and bending rival empires to your will through diplomacy or open war. Every game generates a new galaxy, a new balance of power, and a new empire to call your own. 

 Colonize a Living Galaxy
 Explore procedurally generated galaxies ranging from a dozen systems to well over a hundred.

 Settle planets, moons, and asteroids - each with a surface you develop tile by tile. 

 Construct more than 50 surface structures and orbital installations: factories, laboratories, hydroponic gardens, defense towers, embassies, and more.

 Terraform hostile worlds and uncover ancient ruins left behind by a vanished civilization.

 Hand any colony to a Governor and let it run itself

 Design Your Own Fleets
 Engineer warships from the keel up across five hull classes, from nimble scouts to colossal capital ships.

 Combine more than 80 components - power cores, drives, scanners, shields, and an arsenal of exotic weaponry. 

 No two commanders fly the same fleet. Two players using identical hulls can wage completely different wars.

 Research Exotic Technologies
 Advance through a tech tree of 68 technologies, from your first orbital shipyard to the frontier of exotic physics.

 Harness serious, far-future science: gravity manipulation, frequency-based weaponry, and technologies most 4X games never touch.

 Unlock late-game breakthroughs that reshape...

store.name: 明末：力挽狂澜
store.short: 正在尝试让地图大战略+AI模拟结合，看看能碰撞出怎样的火花，游戏支持传统大战略地图策略模拟的大部分要素，同时让AI替代了核心的摇骰子阶段，让游戏的自由度更上一层楼。科技，国策，人物，势力以及几乎所有的一切，不再局限于开发者的预设条目和节点。
store.about:
I'm experimenting with combining map-based grand strategy with AI simulation to see what emerges. The game supports most of the systems you would expect from a traditional grand strategy game, and its world can run entirely without AI. AI takes over the core "dice-rolling" stage, opening up even more possibilities. Technologies, national policies, characters, factions, and almost everything else are no longer limited to predefined entries and progression trees. 

 Please note: AI expands the game's freedom and enriches its world. The language model is given access to over 50 tools that let it query and modify game data—that's the extent of its role. World simulation, population growth and decline, food consumption and production, tax calculations, changes to regional task status, military casualties, and other underlying systems are all calculated by the game's code. Clarifications

 At present, the LLM supplements the game's freedom, worldbuilding, and immersion by replacing the "dice rolls" found in traditional strategy games. This feature can be turned off. The underlying world simulation runs independently of the LLM. Unless AI simulation intervenes, other factions act according to programmed strategies. Game Systems

 National policies

 Technology

 Taxation

 Court politics

 Regional management

 Military

 Diplomacy

 Map exploration

 Weapons

 Buildings

store.name: ANANTA
store.short: Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG. Play as a variety of characters and explore everything from bustling business districts and hidden alleyways, to quiet tea towns and buzzing old streets. Rub shoulders with a wide-ranging cast of intriguing characters as you assemble a team all your own.
store.about:
Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG with no rules. Step into the shoes of a diverse cast of characters and forge connections as you build a team all your own.
Join forces against the threats lurking in the shadows, or live it up and take in the nightlife under the neon glow. The choice is yours.

 Global release January 15th, 2027

In ANANTA, a whole new world awaits you. Ready to take the plunge?
 Become an Influencer and Save the World 
 You're a stranger in a strange land, but that's alright.
 The moment you set foot in Nova City,
 you start making a name for yourself.
 It's time to build your reputation, and save the world while you're at it.

 Two Cities, Two Adventures 
 Don't forget to head back home once in a while.
 One plane ticket and you're back to your old stomping grounds of Chongxiao.
 But even a place you know like the back of your hand
 is bound to have a hidden secret or two.

 Exhilarating Martial Arts Battles 
 From the second you raise your fist,

 and each strike deserves to go viral.

 Experience the Thrill of 24/7 City Life 
 Boredom? Never heard of it.
 Drama that would make soap operas blush one day, 3AM street racing the next.
 No two days are the same.
 Every hour has something new on offer, and it can all be streamed anytime.

 Discover Different Walks of Life 
 NCCA officer, genius hacker, or gang leader?
 Inhabit all manner of different characters.
 Experience this world from top to bottom and everywhere in-between.
 Who knows, you may befriend some oddballs along the way.

 Unlimited Exploration
