store.name: Resident Evil Veronica
store.short: Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica. In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.
store.about:
Survive the Deranged Terror 

Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica.

This new title preserves the essence of the original game, while introducing modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline, and vividly detailed graphics.
In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror. 3 months have passed since the biological disaster in Raccoon City. 

Claire Redfield, having survived along with Leon S. Kennedy and Sherry Birkin, travels to France in search of her brother, Chris Redfield.

However, what awaits her is not a reunion with her brother, but the Umbrella special forces unit responsible for the incident. They capture Claire and transport her to a mysterious island.

Now Claire must make a desperate attempt to escape the remote Rockfort Island which, due to another biological disaster, has transformed into a living hellscape of survival horror.

store.name: What the Buck?!
store.short: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.
store.about:
Swipe the credit card through the ATM and bills land on the table. Steer the breaker over them and shred them. Every bill you destroy pays out, and the shreds go in the trash.

 Electric bills arc to the bills next to them. Explosive bills blow up the stack around them. A burning bill sets its neighbours on fire. With the right upgrades, one hit clears the whole table.

 Over 240 upgrades across the upgrade panels, the skill tree and the prestige tree. New bill types, bigger bundles, coins, diamonds, a flamethrower and a second ATM. Each branch changes how the table plays.

 Destroying money also earns Prestige Points. When the shift slows down, end it and spend the points on permanent upgrades: an auto swiper, a second ATM, a combo meter. The next shift starts stronger and goes further.

 Gold bills pay more, and their shockwave turns the bills around them gold. Diamonds shatter into shards that cut through the stacks. Stock certificates land in your tray: watch Bitcorn and Grandma's Tulip Fund rise and fall, and cash out at the right moment.

 Keep destroying without a pause and the combo meter fills. Every Frenzy stage pays more, and the numbers on the table grow with it.

 Your boss, Mr. Buck, calls in with instructions and opinions. "A trillion dollars. That's a one with twelve zeros. I had to order a wider monitor just to fit your balance on the screen."

 Over 240 upgrades in three upgrade systems
 Fire, lightning and explosions that chain from bill to bill
 Gold bills, diamonds, coins and stock certificates
 47 Steam achievements
 31 languages
 Your demo progress...

store.name: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor
store.short: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor is a turn-based party RPG set in the Forgotten Realms. Build a band of heroes, descend into the haunted elven ruins of Myth Drannor, and use tactical positioning, spellcraft and steel to stop a dracolich from corrupting the realm.
store.about:
Malevolence is afoot in the Forgotten Realms world: a new Pool of Radiance has been discovered beneath the city of New Phlan, and a wave of pure evil now emanates from it, cursing all it touches. Answer Elminster’s call, descend into the ruined Elven city of Myth Drannor and stop the sorceress and the dracolich before they turn the power of the Pool against the realm.

 Create up to four heroes and recruit two more along the way, for a party of six. The game features the Dungeons & Dragons rules, with different races, classes and spells. Players may choose between the genuine turn-based style of role-playing and a more action-focused, timed-turn style of play. The optional turn timer makes for more engaging, higher-pressure fights.

 Originally released in 2001, Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor revived one of the most storied names in cRPG history. Now it’s available digitally for the first time, with a full suite of enhancements. The re-release runs smoothly on modern hardware, includes sharper visuals, fixes numerous original game bugs and adds widescreen support, including 4K.

 The improved UI adds an action bar and tooltips. It comes with full controller support and reworked camera control.

 Return to the legendary Pool of Radiance - back to where the legacy began

 Save Faerûn: answer Elminster’s call and stop the sorceress and the dracolich from using the power of the Pool of Radiance against the realm

 Party of six: create up to four heroes and recruit two more along the way

 Deep progression: level up characters to 16th level and cast 8th-level spells

...

store.name: Never Sort By Color
store.short: Somewhere under that mountain of bricks is your floor. Sort the impossible Pile with a magnet glove, sieves, and part-seeking vision. Fill labeled drawers, pull parts, watch MOC builds snap together brick by brick. Cozy, satisfying, and governed by one rule: never sort by color.
store.about:
There is one rule of brick sorting. Everyone learns it the hard way. 

 You've inherited a workshop and a Pile that swallowed it whole. Never Sort By Color is a zen organization sim about setting it right - sorting an impossibly huge mountain of plastic bricks into a perfectly labeled workshop, one satisfying handful at a time.

 Tame the Pile
 The Pile doesn't look conquerable. That's the point. Start by picking out bricks one at a time, and grow into an unstoppable sorting machine:
 Magnet Glove - aim at a part and every loose copy rips out of the Pile and streams into your hand.

 Sorter's Eye - mark a part type and watch every instance glow through the chaos.

 Sieve Tray - scoop, shake, and let gravity sort a whole load by size in one motion.

 Bucket Sort - bind bins to hotkeys and fling bricks blind over your shoulder, pure muscle memory.

 Locators - hold up any brick and its home drawer lights up across the room.

 Buy bins, trays, and cabinet walls. Stack them into towers. Label everything. Watch the floor appear.
 Pull the parts. Watch it build.
 Instruction books lie scattered around the workshop, each one a MOC waiting for parts. Crack one open, pull its bill of materials from your perfect drawers, and watch the model build itself, brick by brick - a time-lapse of parts flying up and clicking into place, stud by stud.
 This is where your sorting pays off or bites. Honest drawers mean a full kit pulls in seconds. A contaminated drawer means the tray rejects your wrong part right in front of you.
 Finished models don't ship away - they fill your workshop. A fire...

store.name: BELTFED
store.short: You are a rogue AI with one directive: AUTOMATE DEATH. Shred, burn and vaporize overwhelming swarms of ravenous bugs as your part factory, part war machine lays waste to one world after another. In BELTFED, the factory is your weapon.
store.about:
BELTFED is a roguelike factory-defense game of rapid, brutal runs and absurd scale. Lay belts, wire up smelters and assemblers, and balance your power grid, turning raw ore into raw firepower. All the while a planet's worth of bugs descends upon your factory. This is automation fused with total war.
 AUTOMATE DEATH 

 The swarm arrives in the hundreds of thousands. Meet them with guns, flamethrowers, launchers, mortars, lasers, drones, mines and more - all of it fueled by your own production lines. A single run can push your kill count into the millions. Welcome to slaughter at an industrial scale.
 MASS PRODUCTION. MASS EXTINCTION. 

 Balance industry, power and security as you expand your factory and push into the fog for richer veins and rarer resources. More bugs require more bullets, and supply must keep up because demand doesn't wait. As you expand, choose from run-defining upgrade cards that shape how you play, making every factory different from the last.
 THE NEXUS MUST SURVIVE 

 The Nexus is your central intelligence and item storage. It must be defended at all costs. If your Nexus is compromised, your factory will be terminated and the run will end. Everything else is expendable. As you progress, you'll unlock new Nexus cores that change the way you play.
 THE FACTORY IS YOUR WEAPON 

 Every deployment feeds permanent progression: new weapons, new buildings, new upgrade cards, unique Nexus cores and modules. Your ever-expanding arsenal ensures every deployment is deadlier than the last. Customize your loadout before each run to tune the machine to your...

store.name: Tenebrarium
store.short: An idle-like alien colony simulator. Study an alien species and expand the colony to discover all their peculiar behaviours.
store.about:
Enjoy a colony simulator without the steep learning curve. Simply place resources, sit back, and observe. 

 The Teno are a volatile alien species, capable of fusing intelligently with their environment, or exploding into a pile of bones. As you learn about them, you use this information to grow their colony, unlocking new resources and uncovering more advanced behaviours. 

 Investigate the extent of the aliens' intelligence, and find ways to make use of their volatility.

 Enjoy a hand-crafted retro pixel art aesthetic, a lo-fi sci-fi soundtrack, and tonnes of weird little guys. 

 Full game features: 
 20 Teno variants

 10 Placeable resources

 4 Biomes

 7 Hivemind Idea-Viruses (if you don't know what this means, don't worry about it!)

 100+ Alien behaviours

 A resolution to the Teno's story

 2 post-game Sandbox modes

 Achievements

 This is a small project by a solo developer, and NO generative AI was used whatsoever.

store.name: Maria IV: A Cozy Botanical Sim
store.short: What would life look like as a florist on Pont Notre-Dame in late 15th-century Paris? Personalize your home and shop, carry on your legacy, and grow flowers using real cultivation principles. The final page of the Guide Book may just be the first page of your real-life botanical journey.
store.about:
Run a cozy flower shop in medieval Paris 
Maria IV: A Cozy Botanical Sim is a relaxing flower shop simulator and life sim set in late 15th-century Paris, France . As a young florist, you inherit a small flower shop on the Pont Notre-Dame bridge. Grow flowers and plants, run your shop, decorate your home and workspace, and shape the little world your grandmother left you with your own hands.

 Grow flowers with real gardening principles 
The Guide Book passed down from your grandmother keeps track of every flower you grow, and growing every flower in the book is one of the main goals of the game. Each plant's needs for water, light and care follow real gardening and botany principles, so what you learn in this botanical sim may also help you grow flowers and plants in real life and in your own garden.

 Manage, expand and decorate your shop 
At its heart, Maria IV is a shop simulator: sell your flowers, manage your stock and income, expand your florist shop and hire employees. Personalize your home and workspace with a wide range of decorations; decorating and organizing your cozy shop is part of the fun, until your little plant shop on the bridge becomes one of the best-known flower shops in Paris.

 A historical, atmospheric journey 
Explore the atmosphere of historical, late medieval France to Renaissance-inspired music , and uncover the traces of a family legacy passed down through generations.

 Features 
• A cozy flower shop simulator and life sim in medieval Paris
• Grow flowers and plants with realistic water, light and care needs
• Complete your grandmother's...

store.name: Paper Shredder
store.short: Shred your company's paperwork to earn a $1,000,000 payout. Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath. Will you sign?
store.about:
Welcome aboard! You have accepted a highly prestigious, entry-level position. Your objective is simple: clear a "minor" backlog of corporate paperwork. Achieve 100% disposal efficiency, and a cool $1,000,000 payout is yours. Don't worry about the scale of the task, management believes in you!
 Shred, Sweep, Repeat 
 Experience the intense sensory pleasure of turning tower-high piles of rigid bureaucracy into weightless confetti. Shred documents and sweep up the mess to earn company merit points. Upgrade basic tools into heavy-duty setups, skyrocketing your processing speed and document destruction.
 Mandated Morale Boosts 
 Never feel lonely on the clock! Your dedicated Happiness Manager is always watching, offering continuous, highly mandatory psychological support, and toxic positivity to keep your motivation at an optimized 100%.
 Branching Career Paths 
 Dig through paper mountains to find more than just forgotten files. Rumor says past associates couldn't bear the grind and shredded a path to freedom instead. Will you follow them?

store.name: Brick Buddies
store.short: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.
store.about:
Find it, pick it up, snap it into place 
 Open a bag of parts and spread the colorful bricks across your workbench. Follow the instructions, find the pieces you need, and snap them into place. With each satisfying click, your model takes shape. Enjoy the simple pleasure of building, one brick at a time.

 On your own or with friends 
 Build at your own pace, or settle in for a chat with friends. Up to 4 players can share a workbench online and build one model together. Someone puts up the walls while someone else adds the windows, each helping out a piece at a time. Chat, listen to your favorite music, and watch a little creation come together—a keepsake of the time you've shared.

 Hands-on, down to the smallest detail 
 Put on the stickers, open the doors, and move the curtains. Discover rooms and tiny decorations you couldn't see while building. Once the last piece is in place, take a leisurely look around your finished model. The little space you've made is full of details worth a closer look.

 What little world will you build today? 
 Cozy country cottages, spaceships, pirate ships, little retro game consoles, and the tightly packed buildings of Kowloon Walled City. Build your way through a variety of themes, piece by piece. As you finish models in the same theme, a short story unfolds. Grow your collection and discover the warm little stories within.

 Discover 11 themes, 33 models, and 6,000+ bricks to put together, one by one.

 Enjoy making something with your own hands, from opening the bag to placing the last sticker.

 Unwind with a solo build, or finish a...

store.name: Civitas: World Simulator
store.short: Civitas: World Simulator is a deep historical-fantasy simulation where nations will dynamically rise, fall, and evolve. In this game we model internal forces like ethnicity, culture, language and other inner political struggles.
store.about:
Civitas: World Simulator is a deep historical fantasy simulation where nations will dynamically rise, fall, and evolve. In this game, we model internal forces like ethnicity, culture, language, and other internal political struggles. Lead any nation from near the dawn of recorded history in 3000BC, and into the far future.

 Civitas is an ever-evolving landscape of constant political shifts, misaligned ideas, clashing ideologies, and eventually, their armies! wrestle with the peoples of your land constantly. Upgrade your nation via your governmental policies and technology in order to rule and subjugate the entire planet 

Utilize the in depth country management and role playing tools to experience both real and fantasy history in ways you've never experienced before. Create rulers, rename and recolor countries, and pursue peaceful or aggressive expansion. Nations will remember their history with you and others, respond dynamically, and constantly change their structure as the world around them also changes. 

 Each nation, at its base level, is a tower built on unstable foundations, forced to constantly change shape while always being at risk of collapsing due to forces both external and internal. The people of a nation may grow angry and rise up against their king! Agents of an enemy nation may implant revolutionary ideas within the people. Your poor choices in managing your nation may bring it to its knees!

store.name: Gas N Cars
store.short: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.
store.about:
⛽ Serve Customers & Fuel Cars  
 Fill up cars with the right fuel, stop at the right amount, and get paid for a job well done. Be precise, move fast, and keep customers happy… or mess things up and watch their reactions. 

 🧽 Clean, Repair & Upgrade Cars  
 Some cars arrive dirty, broken, or missing parts. Clean them, repair them, replace car parts, and earn extra cash for good service. The better you work, the better your rewards. 

 🔨 Steal Parts, Break Cars & Create Chaos  
 Don’t feel like being a perfect employee? Steal mirrors, break windows, damage cars, spray fuel everywhere. Every tool can become a source of chaos. 

 🚚 Buy New Tools From the Delivery Truck  
 A delivery truck regularly stops by with new tools, weapons, items, and consumables. Spend your cash to unlock more ways to serve customers, prank them, or completely ruin their day. 

 🎨 Paint, Burn, Spray & Experiment  
 Use spray paint, fuel, lighters, weird items, and other tools to experiment with customers and cars.  

 🚓 Catch Wanted Fugitives  
 The sheriff may ask for your help. Watch the queue, identify wanted drivers, and stop them to earn special rewards. Serve them normally… or take them down your own way. 

 ⭐ Earn Cash, Reviews & Climb the Leaderboard  
 Complete missions, collect money, unlock new tools, and build your reputation. Customers leave reviews based on what happened to them.

store.name: Ignite the Depths
store.short: Ignite the Depths is an atmospheric dark-fantasy PvE dungeon crawler set within a sprawling, hand-crafted labyrinth. Descend into the darkness alone or unite with up to 4 players in a co-op adventure. Will you conquer the Abyss?
store.about:
Ignite the Depths is a cooperative, fast-paced dark fantasy dungeon crawler with NO forced PvP or extraction mechanics. In your quest for mythical riches, descend into the Abyss alone or with a party of treasure hunters to slay terrifying monsters lurking within maze-like dungeons
 CHOOSE YOUR CLASS 

 Master four distinct classes, each with unique abilities, weapons, and team roles. Whether you prefer to rain down a barrage of fireballs from afar, unleash a fury of your blade, or hold the frontline behind your shield, the choice is yours.
 Throughout your adventure, you will mold your character into a unique build that suits your playstyle. New classes will join the adventure as development continues.
 A HAND-CRAFTED DARK FANTASY WORLD TO DISCOVER 

 Explore a wide variety of dreamlike vistas while cutting through relentless foes. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover secret pathways filled with danger and treasure, parkour across ancient ruins, and hack and slash your way deeper into the haunting beauty of the Abyss.
 Each dimension is guarded by a powerful Lord, promising a fierce battle and a worthy reward.
 DESCENT INTO THE ABYSS TOGETHER 

 While every hero is fully playable solo, each class is designed with deep co-op synergy, rewarding creative teamwork and combinations of abilities.
 Coordinate your powers and chain their effects into devastating combinations. Experiment with different party compositions and discover new strategies as your builds evolve.
 UNLEASH YOUR ULTIMATE POWER 

 Slay enemies, annihilate every barrel in sight, and hunt down hidden treasures to...

store.name: The Winery - Winemaking Simulator
store.short: Build your own winery, craft exceptional wines, and grow your reputation with every vintage. Unlock recipes, master new technologies, host winery events, and weather the seasons — because great winemaking is an art, and every bottle tells a story.
store.about:
Create wines worth remembering
 The Winery is a relaxing winemaking simulator where every decision shapes the future of your vineyard.
 Research new recipes, master production techniques, satisfy demanding customers, and adapt to the challenges of each season. No two years are the same — unexpected events, shifting customer tastes, and the changing seasons will quietly test your skills as a winemaker.

 Unlock new recipes and experiment with different production methods to craft wines with unique characteristics. Improve their quality, refine your technique, and discover new styles that appeal to a growing variety of customers.
 Every season brings new opportunities
 The winemaking process changes throughout the year. Harvest grapes in season, manage production at the right time, and plan to keep your winery running smoothly.
 Every customer has different tastes
 Customers don't simply ask for "red" or "white." They're looking for specific types, flavors, and characteristics. Learn their preferences and craft wines that match what they're looking for.
 Adapt to unexpected events
 Your winery is alive with random events that can shape your success. Weather conditions, production incidents, and other surprises will affect the quality of your wines and call for careful decisions.
 Research and improve
 Unlock modern equipment, advanced technologies, and new production techniques to create higher-quality wines and grow your reputation as a winemaker.
 Key Features
 Craft wines using a wide range of unlockable recipes.

 Experience seasonal gameplay that influences every stage...

store.name: Ebbtide
store.short: Ebbtide is a zombie survival strategy game. Lead the last carrier task force through a world overrun by the dead, starting in Los Angeles: direct your forces on a real-time operations map, then zoom straight into the 3D pixel-art battlefield to command the fight or take direct control.
store.about:
Ebbtide is a real-time zombie survival strategy game. You command TF-1 "Ark", humanity's last carrier task force. The war begins in Los Angeles, from the Hollywood Hills to the Port of LA. Direct operations across the city, fight on its streets and carry the campaign across the world. The Map Is the Battlefield
Scroll into any street on the operations map and it becomes the live battlefield, with no loading screen. Scroll back out and the fight keeps running. There are no separate missions and no hidden auto-resolve: every soldier lost, zombie killed and building destroyed carries back to the map.

 Command a City Under Siege
Pause, or run the operations map at up to 4x, as LA's 15 districts slide from Hold to Crisis to Lost. You cannot save everyone, so decide who to pull out first.
 Order National Guard, LAPD and LA County Sheriff's units to hold, delay or withdraw, and call in Marines from Camp Pendleton.

 Send truck and helicopter convoys with supplies, troops or refugees.

 Pull out units and survivors cut off behind the lines before the horde reaches them.
 Only hordes within your forces' line of sight are visible on the map.

 A Horde That Fights Back
Los Angeles is overrun by a million zombies, perhaps more. The Nexus, the hive mind that controls them, ambushes convoys, cuts roads, besieges bases and hunts stranded units. You always get a warning before an attack: reroute, retreat or call in fire support from the map.

On the battlefield, zombies pile up to climb walls and rooftops and cling to helicopters hovering close to the ground. Soldiers killed by the horde...

store.name: Afterworld
store.short: Lead a tribe of survivors, rediscover ancient technology, manage wasteland settlements and wage wars of conquest and political struggle in Afterworld, an original post-apocalyptic survival grand strategy game from Paradox Development Studio, the creators of Crusader Kings III and Hearts of Iron IV.
store.about:
Emerge from the ruins into a new age, where the remnants of humanity must rebuild atop the wreckage of a post-apocalyptic world. Band survivors together, define the spirit of the tribe, and establish your empire in the Afterworld, a Grand Strategy Game that is easy to learn but difficult to survive.

 The world you knew is gone, and its remains are ripe for the picking. To build an empire that spans the continent, first you will need to keep your tiny band of survivors alive: explore hostile wastelands, expand into new territories and rediscover lost technologies. Establish a handful of settlements, forge tribal alliances and clash with cultists, raider warlords, and the immortal Ancients who already think this world is theirs. As your nation expands, your experience will shift from a small-scale, approachable beginning into a Grand Strategy as rich and complex as you have come to expect from Paradox games.

 Begin as shelterfolk crawling out of a failing nuclear bunker, or wayward zealots looking for their goddess in the dustlands, or one of several other playable Origins. Build the first settlements in the wastelands and decide what kind of people you are destined to be. 

 Scrape together food, water, and fuel in an environment that wants you dead. Finding scarce resources will stretch your meager band thin, but under your guidance they will adapt and learn  new skills and methods to refine the lost riches of the land.

 Explore a procedurally generated North America. The terrain and geography are recognizable, but resources, tribes, and threats are different every...

store.name: Warlapse
store.short: War isn't heroism — it's ruthless order and maneuver. Across 7 ages from the Stone Age to modern times, encircle the enemy, cut their supply, and break morale to melt them in the killbox. Lead veterans through Campaign, dive into fast Skirmishes, or mod tomorrow's wars with your own units!
store.about:
WAR IS A MATTER OF ORDER AND MANEUVER. In Warlapse, victory isn't won by brute force — it's won by suffocating the enemy. Spraying bullets is amateur hour; the real art is dismantling your enemy's logistics from within.

 CUT THE SUPPLY LINES, BREAK THEIR MORALE 
 Pockets and Supply Lines: Encircle the enemy from both flanks to seal them in, or sever their supply line, and their morale plummets to zero in moments.

 Morale as Armor, Morale as Slaughter: In Warlapse, morale is your greatest defense. High-morale units shrug off attacks with minor damage, while broken units take devastating losses and melt away in seconds inside the killbox you've created.

 7 AGES OF EVOLUTION, MULTIPLE WAYS TO PLAY 
 From Stone to Drone: Fight across 7 distinct ages, from the Stone Age to the modern era. Units don't just get stronger as they advance — new roles like armor penetration, range, and speed reshape the entire order of battle.

 Campaign, Skirmish, and Age Progression: Carry your surviving veterans from battle to battle in Campaign mode, test your tactics in one-off Skirmish battles, or evolve seamlessly through every age in a single real-time battle in One-Shot mode.

 INTUITIVE BRUSH-BASED COMMAND 
 Fluid Tactical Control: No clunky menus, no box-select drag-and-drop. Paint your selected units straight onto the battlefield to snap them instantly into the formation you want — line, crescent, or wedge — reposition them without breaking existing formations, or draw their advance routes directly.

 Information at a Glance: High-contrast rings around your units tell you at a glance...

store.name: UBAI Ending
store.short: Ryousuke is suddenly confronted with a difficult decision regarding the future of Ubai.
store.about:
One day while performing his regular duties at the Ubai office, a man claiming to be the CEO of Ubai shows up to talk with Ryousuke. After talking with the man, Ryousuke learns of a facet of Ubai that he had never known about and is also given an ultimatum regarding his standing at Ubai. An ultimatum that shakes him to his very core... What will become of Ryousuke? Just what is the true nature of Ubai? Find out in the final entry of the UBAI series!

 In this thrilling visual novel, learn of the inner workings of Ubai through the eyes of Ryousuke. See what decision Ryousuke makes, the painstaking thought process behind his decision, and what becomes of him and Ubai.

 Thrilling Visual Novel Experience 
 Allow yourself to be drawn into their exciting story. Where will fate point them, and what lies in the hidden shadows of Ubai?

store.name: Grand Theft Timeline
store.short: 1-4+ players time-travel kidnapping-collection dungeon-crawling heist with physics, guns, bosses, arena, homebase, skins, and stocks! Kidnap people across 200+ worlds of history & fiction, haul them home in cages and farm paradox in your garage. 25+ theme packs, 2,000+ NPCs and Workshop mods!
store.about:
A 1-4+ PLAYER CO-OP TIME TRAVEL TIMELINE HEIST ACROSS 200+ WORLDS! 
 Rob history & fiction with your friends and drag the famous people in it home in cages. 
 Kidnapping-collection dungeon-crawling heist with physics, guns, bosses, arena, homebase, skins, and stocks! 
 Lock everyone you catch in your garage and farm them for paradox. 
 25+ theme packs, 2,000+ NPCs and Workshop mods! 
 And yes, you can shoot Hitler. 
 You and your friends built a time machine, humanity's greatest invention.
And you're using it to rob people who haven't invented police yet.
Every button in it does something, and your friend is pressing all of them.
 FEATURES 
 200+ WORLDS! Real history and pure fiction on one time machine, from the dinosaurs to Squid Game

 25+ THEME PACKS! Play one like a story, world by world, all the way to its finale

 2,000+ NPCs TO CAPTURE! Knock them down and drag them home in cages

 GUNS AND SPECIAL WEAPONS! Every world has its own special weapons to find

 A BOSS IN EVERY WORLD!  Unlock the map to it, then kill it, or cage it and take it home

 VALUABLES! Steal each world's treasures and sell em for cash.

 DON'T GET LEFT BEHIND! The machine leaves with whoever's inside. Miss it and you show up decades older. Or as a baby.

 CROWDS! Whole hordes to tear through, 100 one-hit-mummies coming for you at once

 THROW ANYTHING! Grab whatever's lying around and throw it at Hitler when you run out of ammo

 RIDES! Ride em while your friends shoot from the back

 THE TIMELINE ARENA! Your captures fight in a Roman colosseum to unlock the next worlds

 A ZOO THAT PAYS! Your...

store.name: Camping Resort Simulator
store.short: Build and run your own campsite in this cozy management sim. Turn an empty stretch of coast into a camping resort with a character all its own: lay out paths, place pitches, glamping and bungalows, shape the landscape, and welcome guests who each live their own little holiday.
store.about:
You don't just build a campsite. You take a wild stretch of coast and turn it into a place people come back to. 

Camping Resort Simulator is a cozy management sim about transforming a place. Start with an empty plot by the sea and shape it, piece by piece, into a resort with a character all its own: lay out the paths, raise bungalows and villas, open a lagoon pool, plant the landscape, and welcome guests who arrive hoping for a holiday they'll remember.

 Your first summer starts now 
Three chapters take you from an empty plot to your first big festival night. Then Free play is yours: no goals, no locks, and a tool to shape the land your way.

 From quiet pitches to lagoon villas 
Tents and caravans, glamping, bungalows and villas around a lagoon pool with a palm island. Add a slide pool, a beach bar, ice cream and a restaurant, and every corner finds its own kind of guest.

 Summer nights 
When the sun goes down, the campsite lights up: open-air cinema, live shows on the plaza, festival nights with a DJ, and string lights over the paths.

 Shape a real place, not a grid 
Every plot has its own quality and feel, so where you place something matters as much as what you build. A bungalow tucked into the right corner of the coast becomes somewhere special. The same bungalow dropped just anywhere is only a box.

 Watch your guests live their holiday 
Click any visitor and follow their day — where they wander, what they enjoy, what they were hoping to find. Your resort is never a spreadsheet. It's a place full of people living small stories.

 Manage with your head and your...

store.name: Excuse Me, King!
store.short: Explain yourself! Improvise an excuse out loud for an embarrassing accusation, sneak in word cards like "butter" and "school lunch", and let your friends rate it from 1 to 5 stars. A party game for 2 to 8 players, on one PC or online with your own voice chat.
store.about:
What could possibly explain this?
 Excuse Me, King! is an improv party game for 2–8 players. Faced with an embarrassing accusation, you have just a little time to talk your way out of trouble. Make it convincing, make it ridiculous, or make your friends laugh. The excuse is yours to invent.
 Start with a line. See where it takes you.
 After the accusation appears, your character shows a starting phrase in a speech bubble. Read it aloud, then launch into your excuse when the timer begins.
 Work unexpected words into your story.
 Your word cards can turn a simple excuse into something much stranger. Use a word, click its card to reveal it, and earn extra points. When your time is up, the other players rate your excuse from 1 to 5 stars. Their ratings and your card points add up to your score, with an extra bonus for using every card.
 Four ways to get out of trouble
 Classic: The standard rules, with three word cards per turn. Choose one of three charge styles: Random Charge, Pick & Plead (pick your accusation and opening line from three each), or Same Charge (everyone gets the same accusation; pick your turn, ties go to the roulette, and going first earns +2).

 Speed King: Just 15 seconds to explain yourself, with double points for word cards.

 Word Storm: Five word cards, and a +5 bonus if you use them all.

 Double Trouble: Two accusations at once. Find one excuse for both!
 Pick your look.
 Choose from seven character skins. They are cosmetic, so everyone plays by the same rules. Speech bubbles, reactions, animated score counts, and a lively results reveal keep the...

store.name: Scam With Your Friends
store.short: Run a scam call center with your friends. Use increasingly ridiculous schemes to trick AI callers out of their life savings. Hit your daily quota, cause chaos around the office, and survive a brutal performance review from your rageaholic boss.
store.about:
KOLKATA, INDIA IS CALLING YOU AND YOUR FRIENDS! 
 You and your friends run a scam call center under a ruthless boss. Cleverly scam and manipulate AI callers with your schemes! Hack into their computers to access the personal information you desperately need.

 HIT THE DAILY QUOTA OR FACE THE WRATH OF YOUR BOSS! 
 Every day you progress, you expand your arsenal of scams. Scam innocent people out of their life savings to reach your daily quota or GET FIRED!!! It is you or them!

 BE PRODUCTIVE! AND TRY NOT TO GET HACKED BY SCAMBAITERS... 
 Stay focused on scamming and try not get distracted. Watch out for the feisty scambaiters or you might catch the worst computer virus ever!

 KEY FEATURES 
 Online co-op with your friends or public lobbies

 Single player

 Hilarious real-time AI conversations

 Ridiculous scam scenarios

 Run-based progression with increasingly chaotic workdays

 Remote access to victim computers

 In-game paint app, screen recorder, and camera

 Survive computer viruses, police raids, air strikes, and other workplace disasters

 Heavily moddable content

 Create custom personalities through JSON files and voice cloning WAV files

store.name: Captive 3000
store.short: Wake from cryosleep on a dying space station prison and guide a remote droid to your own rescue. A lightning-fast, real-time, grid-based dungeon crawler with traditional sprite design. Explore and fight through 50+ hours of handcrafted star bases, then infinite seeded missions. Free demo available.
store.about:
Captive 3000 is an old-school dungeon crawler in the style of Dungeon Master, Legend of Grimrock, Eye of the Beholder, Black Crypt and Hired Guns, with a dystopian science-fiction setting.
 Inspired by the 1990 Amiga / Atari ST classic Captive, with tile-based movement, real-time combat, resource management, maze exploration, and handcrafted levels, rendered in first-person view using traditional sprites.

 Condemned to 1000 years in cryosleep... 
 You wake on a forgotten moon orbiting an unfamiliar singularity… 
 Memory wiped... cryogenic chamber smashed…. 
 Alien shadows haunt the abandoned station… 
 Main power failing, an emergency console flickers to life… the alarm repeats… 
 EARTH HAS FALLEN... 
 The terminal reaches out to a decommissioned Optimus Mark I on a distant planet… 
 A glimmer of hope? 
 Guide the ancient automaton through the vast expanse... find your lonely prison… 
 And stage your own rescue... 
 But your identity, the tale of your incarceration, and the fate of humanity… 
 ... is yet unknown ... 

 DESIGN
 Many modern first-person dungeon crawlers use 3D engines to emulate the traditional sprite-based grid/tile movement used by the original 'blobber' games like Dungeon Master. As a result they often experience sluggish, slow movement.
 Captive 3000 is built the old way, using traditional sprites (no 3D engines) and is lightning fast.
 The game features 13 handcrafted levels with multiple floors per level. These 13 Levels form Mission 01.
 Illustrated story chapters are hidden across the levels. Each mural reveals a fragment of the truth.
 Explore...

store.name: Blood & Canvas: Bareknuckle Boxing
store.short: Rise from illegal underground bouts to bareknuckle champion in a single-player boxing career where damage carries from fight to fight and can bring your career to an early end. Fight, upgrade your gym, climb the rankings, and see how far you can make it.
store.about:
Welcome To Violence. 

 Step into the role of an up-and-coming bareknuckle fighter and climb from illegal underground fights to the biggest stage in bareknuckle boxing. Every victory earns money to improve your abilities, upgrade your gym and prepare for tougher opponents, but every cut and bruise adds to the cumulative damage that will eventually end your career.

 Fight Smart. 
 Inspired by the best of traditional boxing games, Blood & Canvas is the first game built entirely around bareknuckle boxing. Every exchange matters. Manage your stamina, control the distance, pick your shots, and protect yourself at all times. Someone will get their face broken—don't let it be you.

 From Underground To The Championship. 
 Battle your way through three underground venues, earn your place among seasoned professionals and fight toward the championship - if your career lasts long enough.

store.name: FAKE ME
store.short: Model, paint, and blend in! FAKE ME is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you create your own disguise. Use simple 3D modeling tools to build the object you’ll hide as. You can also create your own costume by modeling. Hide from the Seekers or find every Faker before time runs out!
store.about:
FAKE ME combines classic hide-and-seek with creative 3D modeling in an online multiplayer game.
 Split into two teams: Fakers and Seekers. Fakers must blend into the environment and avoid being caught until time runs out, while Seekers must spot the objects created by other players and find every Faker.
 BUILD YOUR OWN DISGUISE 
 Use simple and easy-to-use modeling tools to build the object you want to hide as from scratch. Model a single shape or combine multiple pieces to create anything you can imagine, from a small decoration to a large structure. 

 BLEND INTO THE ENVIRONMENT 
 Choose the right size, colors, and position to make your creation look like a natural part of the map.
 Build a convincing prop or try an unusual disguise designed to confuse the Seekers.

 FIND ANYTHING SUSPICIOUS 
 An extra chair, a strangely shaped box, or a structure you are certain was not there a moment ago could be another player.
 Find every Faker before time runs out.

 DESIGN YOUR OWN CHARACTER 
 Modeling tools are not just for hiding. As a Seeker, you can customize your character’s appearance however you like.
 Paint your character and create unique costumes by modeling and combining different shapes. Create something funny and unusual or design a warrior with a style all your own.
 You decide what your character looks like. 

 PROP PAINT MODE 
 Instead of modeling from scratch, transform into an object on the map and paint it however you like. Blend into your surroundings—or stand out. It’s up to you!

 CHARACTER SKILLS 
 Use different skills as a Faker or a Seeker. A well-timed...

store.name: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard
store.short: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.
store.about:
Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard 
 For a few hundred years, a dragon collected and never once tidied up. Now the gold has swallowed the shelves, the furniture and most of the floor and everything the dragon actually treasures is buried somewhere inside it. You have a bag. You have time. Get sorting. 

 Sweep up the hoard 
 Aim your bag and pull coins straight off the pile one at a time at first, then in fat, greedy handfuls. Pour them into the chests around the lair; when one fills up, it slams shut, and that gold is yours to spend.

 Get scarily good at it 
 A deeper bag. Faster hands. More coins per grab. Nothing changes the job everything changes how it feels. By the end, you'll clear in seconds what used to take minutes.

 Find what the gold buried 
 Books, relics, keepsakes, oddities the hoard has been swallowing them for centuries. Spot something glinting through the coins, dig it free, carry it to the shelves, and set it down exactly where it belongs. Complete a collection, and the lair opens up a little more.

 Pet the cats 
 The cats were here long before you, and they'll be here long after. Every single one can be petted. The game keeps count.

 Take your time 
 No timers, no fail states, nobody looking over your shoulder. The pile isn't going anywhere, and your progress saves itself.

 In short 
 Tons of coins, and every one of them is yours to move

 An upgrade track that turns a chore into a habit

 A collection book to fill, shelf by shelf

 Cats: pettable, countable

 Full controller support

store.name: Traffic Architect
store.short: Become the master of traffic with your expert infrastructure designs. Lay down streets, shape junctions, time traffic lights, design a public transport network, and watch the city come alive. It grows on its own, and every new building sends more trips onto the roads you built.
store.about:
Traffic Architect is a road builder and traffic-management game. Build and transform the infrastructure network of a self-growing, fully simulated city, where every new building sends fresh trips onto your roads: people driving to work, trucks making deliveries.
 Every traffic jam has a cause. You provide the creative fix: a few more lanes, a retimed signal, an extra road link, or a whole new highway with an interchange where the crossing used to be. Build it and watch the traffic flow.
 And when more asphalt stops working, build a public transport network. A bus line with bus-only lanes, a rail link or a metro tunnel placed where people already travel fills up fast, and every rider is one less car in your junction. 

 Design the network
 Upgrade roads through 11 tiers, from gravel tracks to boulevards and multi-lane highways

 Cross rivers with bridges and mountains with tunnels in one simple move

 Rebuild a jammed crossing as a full interchange in one click: 3-way compact or trumpet where three meet, a compact or wide cloverleaf where two roads cross

 Shape the flow with one-way streets, turn restrictions and per-junction rules, then tune the traffic lights phase by phase

 Traffic simulated car by car
 Every vehicle is simulated. Follow a single car across town and see the jam from inside it

 The people using your network report back, a smooth run, a long wait or a detour twice the direct distance, and a congestion heat map shows where the network hurts

 Over two dozen live metrics, from queued cars to transit share, each charted across the whole run so you can see...

store.name: Timberline Factory
store.short: A realistic sawmill simulation made by a real sawmill worker: logs are physics objects that roll, collide and jam your conveyors. Automate production lines, fight dirt and wear, master the market and turn waste into energy.
store.about:
LOGISTICS MEETS PHYSICS 
 Forget rigid animations and pre-defined paths. In Timberline Factory , every log is a fully physics-based object. They have weight, they roll, and they can cause bottlenecks if your line isn't optimized. Strategically plan your layout on the available slots to master the physical flow of wood, a tactical challenge that rewards precision and clever logistics.

 AUTOMATE & GROW 
 Construct complex sawmill layouts from the ground up. Place conveyors, debarkers, and advanced sawing units. As your factory grows, you’ll unlock automated systems like the Headrig Line and the Boardstacker to turn raw logs into profitable bundles of boards.

 THE TIMBER INDEX: A BREATHING MARKET 
 The economy isn't flat. Master the Timber Index , a dynamic market system with a mean reversion algorithm. Prices for logs, boards, and pellets fluctuate based on market mood and random walks. Will you sell your stock now or wait for the market to bounce back?
 MAINTENANCE & CLEANING 
 Industrial machines are powerful but not indestructible. Sawdust and heavy usage wear down your equipment. Monitor machine dirt levels, manage repair costs, and hire Cleaning Staff to automate maintenance. Invest in Titanium upgrades to minimize downtime and keep the production humming.

 THE CIRCULAR ECONOMY 
 Nothing goes to waste. Use the Biomass Power Plant to turn bark into green energy to lower your operating costs. In the late game, expand into the Pellet Plant , turning sawdust into a highly profitable secondary product. Close the loop and maximize your factory's efficiency.

 FROM SPRUCE...

store.name: just volleyball
store.short: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!
store.about:
just volleyball is an arcade-style action volleyball game that aims to bring a freeform, addicting, and simple volleyball experience to PC, with full online & offline play. with a cursor-based aiming system and fully manual movement, the game may seem simple to pick up, but has a steep and rewarding learning curve.

 features: 
 1v1s, 2v2s, 3v3s, 4v4s, 5v5s... and 6v6! play whichever format of volleyball you enjoy the most!

 offline & online play: practice by yourself with bots, or head online!

 character customization: personalize your player with a simple yet dynamic avatar creation system.

 replay mode: review your highlights & capture cinematic moments!

store.name: Playrooms
store.short: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.
store.about:
Thousands of balls lie scattered across the Playrooms. Someone should put them back, and there's no one else here. Almost no one.
 You don't know how long you've been working here, but you know what needs doing: over 200,000 balls are scattered everywhere, and you bring them back to their ball pits. Nobody told you why.

 Your Job
 Collect the balls. Bring them back. Fill the ball pits. Full ball pits unlock new abilities, and collected balls are your currency. Eventually you'll have enough for the key to the next area. The work stays the same, only the room changes. Tiles, water, endless corridors, a hallway with more doors than it should have.

 Tools
 The more balls you collect, the more equipment you can afford. A scoop or a flashlight. Everything you need to keep working.

 Observe Working Hours
 When your shift is over, the lights start to go out one by one. Then there is only one thing that matters: stay in the light! Because you don't want to find out what is waiting for you in the darkness.

 Flexible Working Arrangements
 No fear at all, the way it’s meant to be, or no second chances? You decide how dangerous your job gets.

store.name: The Cozy Funemployment
store.short: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.
store.about:
Welcome to the coziest vacation of your life. Wake up whenever you want, cook your favorite meals, decorate your apartment, spend time with friends, and don't rush back to work. After all... you're just taking a little break . What could possibly go wrong? 

 Plenty of Cozy Activities
 Play the guitar, practice yoga, cook comforting meals, binge your favorite shows, sleep until noon, peek at your neighbors, count the last few coins in your wallet... and always find one more little thing to do.

 A Smartphone Full of Apps
 Chat with friends in a cozy messenger, order delicious food, collect cute figurines, take selfies, try your luck at the casino... Sometimes a little treat really does make you feel better.
 And your bank balance...? Don't worry about it. You've saved enough not to think about it.

 Decorate and Dress Up
 Buy the adorable outfits you've always wanted. Fill your apartment with shelves, fairy lights, plants, and paintings. Make it so warm and cozy that you'll never want to leave. 

 Find the Job That's Right for You
 Don't rush into taking the first job you see. You deserve to find the one that's truly right for you. There are plenty of opportunities out there - don't worry, the perfect one will come along. You're a valuable professional . There's no need to rush. 

 Don't worry. 
 You'll find a job. 
 But first... just get some rest.

store.name: Pathos
store.short: Pathos is a turn-based fantasy adventure inspired by retro dungeon crawlers. Experience deep, emergent gameplay with modern graphics, sound and a touch-first interface. Extensively customise your character and embark on epic procedurally generated campaigns.
store.about:
Pathos brings the depth and freedom of traditional roguelikes to a modern audience. 
 Over a decade of development has shaped Pathos into a deeply immersive fantasy roleplaying adventure. Choose from an extensive range of characters, master intricate systems and discover unexpected ways to overcome the challenges ahead. Explore vast, procedurally generated campaigns filled with strange creatures, powerful items and unexpected encounters. Experiment freely, embrace the consequences and watch out for Yet Another Stupid Death.
 FEATURES
 Turn-based, top-down and grid-based.

 Permadeath, with the option to resurrect and continue your adventure.

 Choose from 30 classes, 21 races, 18 specials and 9 companions.

 Single-player adventures with one character or a party of up to six.

 Split-screen local co-op.

 Import custom sprites for your character and pet.

 Real-time toggle to run time forward.

 Global Hall of Fame.

 Comprehensive contextual help.

 Community translations into 18 languages.

 Steam Deck including controller support.

 Steam Cloud sync for settings, custom heroes, save files and bones files.

 Four inbuilt tilesets:
 Sonyvanda -  modern outlined pixel art.

 Absurd -  semi-realistic photo art.

 Classic -  retro pixel art.

 Geoduck -  ASCII-inspired vector art.

 Four campaign modules:
 NetHack Codex -  a procedurally generated 40-level dungeon with hand-crafted branches.

 Kaloi Opus -  a large procedurally generated overland world with side dungeons.

 Pixel Sojourn -  a procedurally generated tribute to Shattered Pixel Dungeon.

 Dhak Legacy -  a...

store.name: Family Time
store.short: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!
store.about:
You're a Father Now
 All of a sudden you have to take care of dozens of wolf children! Every night their number grows! Fail to do so and your partner, the Wolf Mama, will kill you! How many can you sustain?

 Shelter Your Family!
 Build houses for them, or command them to build them for you!

 Feed your Family!
 Farm food for them or go out hunting with them!

 Pamper your Family!
 Keep them snug in their own beds to not anger the Wolf Mama!

 Can you support 10 children? 100? 1000?                                    10,000? 
 Find out.

store.name: LYSSA: Goddess of Rage
store.short: A tactical PvP card RPG in a world run by mercenaries. Climb the rankings in short, brutal real-time battles, recruit legendary fighters, and build a deck around your Commander. Seize territory with your alliance and get to know your crew off the battlefield.
store.about:
Welcome to LYSSA: Goddess of Rage, a tactical card RPG set in a world run by mercenaries, where three factions are locked in war and every fight is short, sharp, and brutal. 
 Pick Your Favorites. Make Them Unstoppable.
In LYSSA, every mercenary has a price — and a past. Recruit the ones you trust, gear them up, and turn them into legends. Then let your Commander tie it all together: their skills power up your whole deck, opening thousands of possible combinations to build a squad that fits your playstyle. Grow Strong. Then Prove It.
Follow the twist-filled story campaign of LYSSA: Goddess of Rage and adapt to arenas where random obstacles change every fight. Then comes the true test: real-time PvP . Climb the ranked ladder, jump into battles and tournaments, and fight your way to the top of the leaderboards .
Play at your own pace : quick bursts or marathon sessions — how you get there is up to you. Just make sure you get there first .
 Find Your Crew. Take the City.
Join an alliance , swap strategies with players from around the world , and team up for community events . Then go to war together: seize territory alongside your alliance and hold it against everyone who wants it back. In LYSSA: Goddess of Rage, the city belongs to whoever takes it. Get Close. Get Personal.
Off the battlefield, your mercenaries have plenty to say. Chat with them , get to know the stories behind their contracts, and build relationships that unlock exclusive moments in your personal gallery .

 So hire your mercenaries, build a deck no one sees coming, and fight your way to the top of a city...

store.name: Dungeons & Dynasties
store.short: DnD meets Football Manager. Create a guild, watch them form relationships and grow old together. Lose people both to the dark and to rival guilds battling to be the best in the realm. Grow your own town, or vote to help build an existing one. Or take the Cozy approach and run a guild on your terms.
store.about:
Football Manager, but every match is a dungeon and your players can die in it. 

 You run an adventuring guild in a realm that lost its king. Sign delvers, swear them to a term of years and send them into the dark. Win enough and you take the Crucible, and hold the realm until somebody takes it off you.

 Heroes die. Dynasties rise. The realm remembers both.

 Every fixture is a dungeon
 There is no match engine. Each delve is built for the day, and in the Trials a rival guild goes into the same one. If they make it to the final room, you fight them there.

 You never click an attack. You pick the party, set their orders and kit them out, then you watch. Flooded ground slows your fighters and pitch dark ruins your archers, so who you send matters as much as how strong they are. Nine classes, ten races, and a party that grows from four to six as you climb six divisions.

 People, not numbers
 Every delver arrives believing something, struggling with something, and swearing to do one thing before they are done. Most never manage it. Sending the right one on the right work, year after year, is how you find out who they are.

 They make friends and grudges underground. They sign for a term of years and come back asking for what they are worth. They pick up scars, retire, get sold, or do not come home, and the dead get a memorial card with their own sigil and epitaph. The Dungeonborn are the ones that you bring back.

 A realm that goes on without you
 Seventy-two guilds hold seats in 36 towns across seven lands, so you share a street with somebody who wanted to better you...

store.name: Echo Mates
store.short: To see, you must speak. To speak is to be found. A co-op horror in near-total darkness where every sound sends out a wave that lights the level — and calls whatever lives in it. 1–4 players, real voice, microphone required.
store.about:
TO SEE, YOU MUST SPEAK. TO SPEAK IS TO BE FOUND. 
 There is no light down there. Every sound sends out a wave that tears the world out of the dark for a second, then lets it go. Your voice is your flashlight. It is also your trail.

 EVERYTHING DOWN THERE HEARS YOU 
 A whisper lights a couple of metres. A scream lights half the floor, and everything hunting down there hears it too. Footsteps, a dropped crate, a slammed door: there is no harmless noise. But noise is also bait. Throw something into the dark and watch what comes for it.

 TAKE THE JOB. BRING IT BACK. 
 Pick a contract, ride the lift down, get the job done before the shift ends. Haul out what you came for, even if it is the last crew, and load it on the truck. Every descent is a new level. The deeper you go, the better the pay and the worse your odds. Whatever you fail to bring back is gone.

 TRUST YOUR EARS. NOT YOUR CREW. 
 Some doors open only when you sing the right note. One creature speaks in your teammate's voice. Another makes you see a monster where your friend is standing, and you will swing first. 1–4 players.
 WHAT YOU NEED 
 A microphone, required: it is not voice chat, it is the core mechanic. Headphones, required: the audio is positional, and speakers will give you away with your own voice.

store.name: Can 'Em All
store.short: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.
store.about:
Oh look, the truck is here.
 A truck delivers a fresh batch of adorable creatures straight to your factory.
 Unfortunately for them, they're also your main source of income.

 First, you need them dead.
 Grab your weapons and clear out the factory.

 Now turn them into something useful.
 Grab the bodies and throw them into the crusher.

 Get those cans into the tube.
 Your freshly processed cans still need to be sold.

 Reinvest in the business.
 Get stronger weapons. Upgrade your vacuum. Unlock machines. Build conveyors. Increase production. Bring in more creatures. Automate the factory.

store.name: Unharvest
store.short: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows, upgrade your plagues, and wither the world until nothing living remains.
store.about:
The soil has grown stagnant and weak. The harvest is long overdue. You've come to collect it.
 Touch it and it dies. 

 Upgrade your plagues. 

 Spread faster, reach wider. 

 The land fades, and so does everything on it. 

 Features 
 A beautiful, relaxing soundtrack and atmosphere

 Multiple unique environments to wither, beyond wheat fields

 Numerous plague upgrades for spreading, speed and reach

 A mysterious story told through the world around you

 A world that visibly and audibly changes as you play

store.name: Hood Warfare 2
store.short: Rival gangs fight for control of Chicago. Pick a side, customize your weapons, and fight other players across a variety of action-packed game modes. Spin the block and take over the streets in this chaotic multiplayer FPS.
store.about:
Rival gangs fight for control of Chicago. Pick a side, customize your weapons, and fight other players across a variety of action-packed game modes. Spin the block and take over the streets in this chaotic multiplayer FPS.

 Hood Warfare 2 brings back the chaotic FPS gameplay and humor of the original, now built in Unreal Engine 5 with updated visuals, new weapon animations, and a new set of maps. Fight through downtown, the suburbs, The Trenches, and Chicago Mall. Hold down the streets or take the fight indoors, with different routes and positions to learn on each map.

 Weapon customization gets an upgrade, too. Change out sights, magazines, grips, suppressors, and other attachments to get your gun how you want it. Set up your loadout with perks and equipment before heading into a match.

 Hood Warfare 2 features six game modes:
 Turf War: Gangs fight for control of turf around the map. Earn points for the territory your gang holds, and push the other team off theirs.

 GangBang: A classic team shootout. Two gangs go head-to-head, and the gang with the most kills wins.

 Chaos: Every man for himself. There is no loyalty to a gang in this mode. Get the most kills to come out on top.

 Hit A Lick: Take the bag from the enemy’s hood and bring it back to yours. Keep an eye on your own bag while your crew goes after theirs.

 Destroy The Block: One gang has the bomb. The other has to stop them. Plant or defuse to win, with only one life per round.

 Chain Snatch: Getting the kill is only half the job. Snatch the chains enemies drop to earn points, and collect your teammates’...

store.name: Needle In A Haystack Simulator
store.short: The viral one. The one and only. Find 1 needle hidden amongst 5,000,000 pieces of hay.
store.about:
FIND THE NEEDLE
 Somewhere inside 5,000,000 individual pieces of hay is a single needle.
 Your goal is simple.
 Find it. 
 Unfortunately, finding a needle in a haystack is about as easy as it sounds.
 START WITH NOTHING
 At the beginning, it's just you and the haystack.
 Pick through the pile piece by piece, searching for the needle and uncovering valuables hidden amongst the hay along the way.
 Sell what you find and use the money to make your impossible task slightly less impossible.
 UPGRADE YOUR SEARCH... OR DON'T
 Find valuables, sell them and buy increasingly powerful tools that let you search, move and process larger amounts of hay at once.
 The further you progress, the more ridiculous your search operation becomes.
 Or, if you want the true needle-in-a-haystack experience , play with no upgrades at all.
 No tools. No automation.
 Just you, 5,000,000 pieces of hay and 1 needle .
 FIND IT WITH FRIENDS
 You don't have to suffer alone.
 Team up with friends and search through millions of pieces of hay together.
 More players. More tools. Same needle.
 Good luck.

store.name: Find The Needle
store.short: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.
store.about:
You were a farmer.
At least, you think you were.
Now you're stuck inside a strange warehouse, standing in front of an endless haystack. You don't remember how you got here, who brought you here, or why the doors won't open.
There is only one instruction:
Find the needles.

There are some in the pile. You start by hand, with a metal detector. You end up with belts, balers, scanners and robotic arms doing the looking for you. Place real machines, wire the power, feed them by belt. Sell the hay, buy more machines, get given a bigger pile.

Nobody has said what happens when you finish. The pile
Begin By Hand
 The tools
Buy tools like shovels, buckets, wheelbarrows, pitchforks, vacuums. Anything that helps you process hay manually!
 Start Automating
Automate everything! Build robots, drones, conveyor belts, hay wrappers, paper machines, sorting machines, and advanced systems that process hay and search for needles while you focus on expanding your factory.
 Hay products
Turn ordinary hay into valuable products! Process it into hay pulp, compressed bales, eco bricks, hay paper, pellets, and much more. Build new production lines, unlock advanced machinery, and find better ways to turn your mountain of hay into profit.

 Tech tree
Progress through a huge tech tree with over 300 upgrades! Unlock new machines, improve production speed, increase efficiency, expand your factory, and discover entirely new ways to process hay.

 What happens when you collect all the needles?
- Who knows?

store.name: Mycelarium
store.short: Grow an ever-expanding fungal network in this relaxing incremental exploration game. Discover hidden resources, cultivate mushrooms that automate your production, and evolve your mycelium into a self-sustaining underground empire.
store.about:
MYCELARIUM IS A MEDITATIVE INCREMENTAL GAME
 Start with a single mushroom. Spread your mycelium through the soil, discover hidden resources, and build a thriving underground network. Automate resource production, unlock strange new mushrooms, and watch your tiny organism grow into a vast, self-sustaining fungal empire. 
 The forest is alive, but not hostile. Leaves fall and decay into food. Hedgehogs wander across the surface. Trees can become future sources of nutrients. There is no rush and no hard fail state, only the quiet pressure to expand, adapt, and connect.
 Explore an endless procedural underground filled with food pockets, water reservoirs, hard soil, and impassable stone. Build your fungal empire one thread at a time.

 FEATURES
 Grow a living underground mycelium network from a single mushroom

 Aim new growth with a slingshot-style control system

 Collect underground food pockets and connect to water reservoirs

 Improve range, width, water efficiency, node cost, budding chance, and soil penetration

 Unlock specialized mushroom mutations

 Launch wind-carried spores to create distant new growth points

 Build different mushrooms on the surface

 Parasitize trees

 Explore an endless procedural underground world

 A calm pixel-art forest

 Play at your own pace with no hard fail state

store.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
store.short: Brick By Brick is a relaxing tidy-up game you can play solo or co-op with up to 5 players. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks to rebuild a charming town. Unlock helpful abilities and watch scattered piles become finished buildings. One brick at a time!
store.about:
18,490 Bricks. One Small Town to Put Back Together.
 A little town is waiting to be put back together. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks in a relaxing first-person tidy-up game, solo or in online co-op with up to 5 players. Turn scattered pieces into buildings, and watch your work bring the town to life.

 COLLECT, SORT, AND BUILD
 Find the bricks you need by their shape and color. Follow each building’s plan and place the pieces in the right spots. Watch the piles get smaller as the walls grow taller.

 UNLOCK ABILITIES
 Unlock helpful abilities to make the work easier. Use a magnet to collect bricks, a wheelbarrow to carry them, and scaffolding to reach higher places. Spend less time carrying and more time building.

 WATCH THE TOWN CHANGE
 Turn piles of bricks into a cozy little town. Walk through the streets and enjoy the buildings you’ve finished. With every building you complete, there’s more to see.
 One brick at a time. Better together.

store.name: Defilade
store.short: Defilade is an old-school isometric RTS set in modern warfare. Command intelligent troops that take cover, rescue wounded comrades, dive from grenades, vault obstacles and dig trenches. Build your base, secure supply lines and fight across fully destructible massive battlefields that feel alive.
store.about:
I first discovered Red Alert back in the mid 90's and was instantly hooked, so many RTS games consumed me but after all these years, Red Alert, Sudden Strike 2 and Company of Heroes stuck with me, but it missed one crucial thing I kept yearning for... that was proper cover mechanics and better soldier AI logic. 

 So Defilade came along... the Idea started in early 2022, with prototyping, and 2026 was the year this idea came to its full form. 
 SOLDIERS
 The soldiers think a lot and i mean a lot! Almost every single object, vehicle even trees standing or blown off, gets used as cover. They heal, plan rescues, deep trench warfare, garrison buildings and medic teams even use stretchers to pick wounded up from the battlefield. When one of the medics gets killed the other medic will put down he's stretcher and drag the soldier. 

 PRISONER SYTEM
 Soldiers can surrender and when they do they get interrogated, and they can spill live intel on you or the enemy.  
 THE SMALL DETAILS
 Soldiers through grenades back
They will dive right before a FPV drone strike
Soldiers will try a rope rescue if a normal rescue failed.
They even take cover behind trees
They vault over low cover. 
They have realistic rag doll physics

store.name: Potato Please
store.short: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.
store.about:
Congratulations, Comrade. The nation has entrusted you with a vital responsibility: keeping the army fed. Peel the potatoes, prepare the supply, and improve your operation in service of the greater good. Work hard, work efficiently, and remember: the army is hungry.
 PEEL THE POTATOES
 Your job is simple: peel the potatoes and get them into the water. 
 Pick them up, peel them by hand, and toss them in one by one.
 FINISH THE PILE
 Clear the pile and find faster ways to get the job done. 
 What starts as manual work gradually turns into a much more efficient operation.
 AUTOMATE THE PROCESS
 Turn repetitive work into a system. 
 Collect potatoes in bulk, use machines to process them, and automate more of the job as your operation grows.

store.name: Groundwork Simulator
store.short: Dig, haul and wash for gold in an open-world heavy machinery simulator. Operate excavators, wheel loaders and bulldozers, reshape the terrain and build your washing setup. Work solo or team up in online co-op to turn untouched ground into a working site.
store.about:
WELCOME TO GROUNDWORK SIMULATOR 
 Groundwork Simulator puts you behind the controls of heavy machinery, with a landscape to reshape and gold to uncover. Dig into the hillside, haul material across your site and set up the equipment that turns a bucket of dirt into your next gold recovery. Work at your own pace or share the job with friends.

 EVERY BUCKET CHANGES THE LANDSCAPE
 Dig trenches, cut into hillsides and build up piles as you shape your worksite. Every scoop changes the ground you work on, creating new routes, steeper slopes and fresh challenges. Plan your approach, the ground you leave behind becomes the foundation for your next job.

 REALISTIC PHYSICS
 Dig with a realistic excavation engine and simulated hydraulic feedback that brings resistance to every scoop. Feel your machine respond as the bucket meets the ground and material builds up inside it. Adjust your angle and work with the available hydraulic power to cut through the terrain, fill your bucket and lift the load.

 FROM DIRT TO GOLD
 Explore the land in search of gold-rich ground. Drill and test for deposits, choose your digging spot and set up your wash plant. Excavate promising material, wash it through the sluice boxes and process the concentrate on the shaking table, from your first test hole to your next gold recovery.

 WORK SOLO OR SHARE THE SITE
 Run the operation yourself or divide the work in online co-op. Take the excavator while a friend handles transport, or keep material moving together between the digging area and the wash plant. Coordinate your machines and turn a patch of untouched...

store.name: Figure Me Out
store.short: A multiplayer FPS where you eliminate opponents by typing the numbers on their foreheads. Read theirs before they read yours, use tactical gadgets to disrupt the fight, and battle friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players.
store.about:
A multiplayer FPS where you eliminate opponents by typing the numbers on their foreheads. Read theirs before they read yours, use tactical gadgets to disrupt the fight, and battle friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players.
 Read it. Type it. Eliminate. 

 Get a clear look at an opponent’s forehead and type their number to take them out. Keep moving, watch who’s looking your way, and try to remember those digits when the pressure hits.
 Make yourself harder to read 

 Blind opponents with flashbangs, block their view with smoke grenades, and draw their attention away with distract grenades. Disrupt their next move with stun grenades, hinder their escape with slow grenades, and set traps to catch them off guard. Use your items to create an opening when getting a good look is easier said than done.
 Get a better look 

 Use binoculars to read numbers and eliminate distant targets, or snap a photo with your camera that stays visible for a few seconds. Sometimes, an extra moment to read those digits is all you need.
 Capture flags. Rack up eliminations. 

 Fight for yourself in Deathmatch, join forces in Team Deathmatch, or push for the enemy flag in Capture the Flag. Make every teammate count in round-based Team Elimination, or outlast everyone in Last Man Standing. Every mode gives you a different reason to get close... and a very good reason to watch your forehead.
 Bring your friends. Meet your next targets. 

 Play with friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players. Face off against your group or team up against the opposition. You might trust your...

store.name: Moon Sweepers
store.short: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help.
store.about:
The Moon is covered in dust. The Lunar Surface Department (LSD) has sent you and your crew to clean it up. Unfortunately, the budget only covered a toothbrush.

 Collect lunar dust, sell and use the earnings to buy better tools and upgrade your equipment. Turn an underfunded cleanup mission into a growing operation, one painfully small brushstroke at a time.

 Team up in online co-op lobbies of up to 16 players. Spread out to cover more ground or tackle the same area together. There’s enough dust to keep everyone busy. Whether everyone actually works is another matter.

 Fill your storage with lunar dust, deliver it to a depot and launch shipments to get paid. Spend your earnings on new cleaning tools and increased carrying capacity so you can take on bigger jobs between deliveries.

 Watch dusty terrain turn clean with every pass. Track your progress across the lunar surface, place depots near your work and put cleaning vehicles to use as your operation grows.

 Stop being lazy, you’ve got whole Moon to clean. Better get started.

copies.name: [UPDATE] Planetary Awakening RP [The Moon Woke Up]

store.name: Left! Left! LEFT!
store.short: 2-player asymmetrical co-op rally chaos. One drives a sloppy hatchback with almost no HUD; the other navigates from a physical tablet. Call the turns, clear the mud, survive the cabin — and pray they hear “LEFT!” in time.
store.about:
Left! Left! LEFT! is a 2-player asymmetrical co-op rally chaos game.
 One drives a highly unstable hatchback with almost no HUD and zero map. The other sits with a physical tablet — GTA-style road minimap, cabin physics, and a voice that has to cut through panic.
 There are no AI enemies. The track is narrow. The car is sloppy. The cabin fights back.

 Drive blind. Navigate loud. Survive the cabin. 
 KEY FEATURES 
 Asymmetrical co-op — Driver vs. the road; Navigator vs. the cabin

 Physical tablet navigation — grab it, hold it, drop it, lose it mid-corner

 Cabin chaos — mud on the glass, dash knob wipe, doors that won't stay shut

 Arcade wreck physics — readable, messy hatchback feel (not a sim)

 Built for online duos who talk over each other

 One car. One navigator. Zero excuses when you miss the turn.
